      const sbcl = svar==null?'pbar-bad':svar>=-5?'pbar-good':svar>=-30?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
      const svcl = svar==null?'bad':svar>=0?'good':'bad';
      const svpcl= svarp==null?'bad':svarp>=0?'good':'bad';
      if(k25===0&&k26===0) return `<div class="xv-div-card" style="opacity:.35"><div class="xv-div-name">${sn}</div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);padding:10px 0;text-align:center">Sin ventas</div></div>`;
      return `<div class="xv-div-card${isNC?' xv-nc':''}">
        <div class="xv-div-name">${sn}${isNC?' <span style="font-size:8px;color:var(--neg)">(NC)</span>':''}</div>
        <div class="xv-div-row">
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">AÑO ANT.</div><b style="font-size:10px">${k25.toFixed(1)}</b><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">KG</div></div>
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">ACTUAL</div>
            <b style="font-size:11px;color:${isNC?'var(--neg)':'var(--arc-blue)'}"> ${isNC?'−':''}${k26d.toFixed(1)}</b>
            <div style="font-size:9px"><span class="${svcl}">${isNC?'NC':svar!=null?(svar>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(svar).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</span></div></div>
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">PROY.${cfg.dias_lab}d</div>
            ${isNC?`<b style="font-size:10px;color:var(--neg)">—</b>`:`<b style="font-size:11px;color:${svpcl==='good'?'var(--pos)':svpcl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${sproy.toFixed(1)}</b><div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:${svpcl==='good'?'var(--pos)':svpcl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${svarp!=null?(svarp>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(svarp).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</div>`}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:4px 0"><div class="pbar-fill ${sbcl}" style="width:${sbw}%"></div></div>
        ${!isNC?`<div style="text-align:center">${svarp!=null&&svarp<0?`<span class="bad" style="font-size:9px">faltan ${(k25-sproy).toFixed(0)} KG</span>`:`<span class="good" style="font-size:9px">✓ supera AA</span>`}</div>`:''}
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    return `<tr class="exp-row" onclick="toggleExp('xf-${c.cod}')">
      <td class="tl">${c.nombre}</td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="vbadge">${c.vend_cod}</span>${c.vend_name.split(' ')[0]}</td>
      <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.kg26)}</td>
      <td class="tr"><span class="${proyCl}">${proy.toFixed(1)} KG</span></td>
      <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.kg25)}</td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="${rCls}">${c.rend.toFixed(0)}%</span>
        <div class="pbar-wrap"><div class="pbar-fill ${barCls}" style="width:${bar}%"></div></div>
      </td>
    </tr>
    <tr class="exp-detail" id="xf-${c.cod}"><td colspan="6"><div class="exp-inner">
      <div class="xv-divs-title">🧊 Detalle por Segmento — KG período actual · proyectado a ${cfg.dias_lab} días</div>
      <div class="xv-divs-grid">${segCards}</div>
    </div></td></tr>`;
  }).join('');

  const frzTable = `<div class="sec"><div class="sec-hdr">🧊 Rendimiento Freezer
    <small>Obj: ${D.freezer.rendimiento_obj} KG/mes · ${FRZ.length} clientes · click para desglose por segmento</small></div>
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr><th class="tl">Cliente</th><th>Vendedor</th>
        <th>KG Actual</th><th>KG Proyectado</th><th>KG AA</th><th>Rendimiento</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${frzRows2}</tbody>
    </table></div></div>`;

    el.innerHTML = kpis + charts + vtable + frzTable;

  // Selección inicial — primer vendedor
  if(V.length) setTimeout(()=>vdSelect(V[0].cod), 0);

  // Draw charts
  setTimeout(()=>{
    ventaChart('ch-venta', labels, V.map(v=>v.total));
    barChart('ch-ptok', labels, V.map(v=>v.part_tok), cfg.obj_part_tokin);
    barChart('ch-ctok', labels, V.map(v=>v.cob_tok||0), cfg.obj_cob_tokin);
    barChart('ch-cob',  labels, V.map(v=>v.cob_pct),  cfg.obj_cob_global);
  },60);
}

function toggleGlobalKG(){
  const p = document.getElementById('global-kg-panel');
  if(p) p.style.display = p.style.display==='none'?'block':'none';
}

// ── DETALLE VENDEDOR (panel lateral) ──────────────────────────
function enviarDesempWA(cod) {
  const v = D.vendors.find(x=>x.cod===cod);
  if(!v){ mostrarToast('Vendedor no encontrado'); return; }
  const cfg    = D.config;
  const factor = cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab, 1);
  const vshort = v.name.replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'');

  try {
    const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
    const pdf = new jsPDF({orientation:'p', unit:'mm', format:'a4'});
    const pW=210, pH=297, mg=10, cW=190;
    let y = mg;

    const fmt2 = val => {
      if(val==null||isNaN(val)) return '—';
      if(val>=1000000) return '$'+(val/1000000).toFixed(2)+'M';
      if(val>=1000)    return '$'+(val/1000).toFixed(0)+'K';
      return '$'+Math.round(val);
    };
    const fmtP2 = val => (val==null||isNaN(val)) ? '—' : val.toFixed(1)+'%';

    // ── HEADER ──
    pdf.setFillColor(0,31,88);
    pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 22, 'F');
    pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255);
    pdf.setFontSize(7); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
    pdf.text('ARCOR CONSUMO MASIVO — SAN FRANCISCO · SASTRE', pW/2, y+5, {align:'center'});
    pdf.setFontSize(14); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
    pdf.text('RESUMEN DE DESEMPEÑO', pW/2, y+12, {align:'center'});
    pdf.setFontSize(10); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
    pdf.setTextColor(255,209,0);
    pdf.text(v.cod+' · '+vshort.toUpperCase(), pW/2, y+18, {align:'center'});
    pdf.setFillColor(255,140,0);
    pdf.rect(mg, y+22, cW, 1.5, 'F');
    y += 26;

    // Subtítulo fecha
    pdf.setTextColor(100,120,160); pdf.setFontSize(7.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
    pdf.text('Período: '+cfg.corte+' · Día '+cfg.dias_trab+'/'+cfg.dias_lab+' laborables · Generado: '+
      new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR'), pW/2, y, {align:'center'});
    y += 6;

    // ── 6 KPIs ──
    const kpis = [
      { l:'VENTA ACUM.',    v2: fmt2(v.total),        sub: 'Proy: '+fmt2(v.total*factor),        ok: null },
      { l:'COB. GLOBAL',   v2: fmtP2(v.cob_pct),     sub: v.compradores+'/'+v.universo+' · Faltan: '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil((v.universo||0)*0.9)-(v.compradores||0)), ok: v.cob_pct>=(cfg.obj_cob_global||90) },
      { l:'PART. TOKIN',   v2: fmtP2(v.part_tok),    sub: 'Tokin: '+fmt2(v.si_tok),             ok: v.part_tok>=(cfg.obj_part_tokin||52) },
      { l:'COB. TOKIN',    v2: fmtP2(v.cob_tok),     sub: v.comp_tok+'/'+(v.universo_tok||0)+' · Faltan: '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil((v.universo_tok||0)*0.75)-(v.comp_tok||0)), ok: v.cob_tok>=(cfg.obj_cob_tokin||75) },
      { l:'FIADO %',       v2: fmtP2(v.fiado_pct),   sub: 'Lím: '+fmt2(v.limite_fiado)+' · Saldo: '+fmt2(v.saldo_tot)+' · Venc+4d: '+fmt2(v.deuda_venc), ok: (v.fiado_pct||0)<=(v.obj_fiado||35) },
      { l:'SALDO / VENC.', v2: fmt2(v.saldo_tot),    sub: 'Vencido: '+fmt2(v.deuda_venc),       ok: (v.deuda_venc||0)===0 },
    ];

    const kW = cW/3, kH = 18;
    kpis.forEach((k,i)=>{
      const col = i%3, row = Math.floor(i/3);
      const kx = mg + col*kW, ky = y + row*(kH+3);
      const ok = k.ok;
      const borderCol = ok===null ? [180,190,210] : ok ? [27,127,58] : [176,16,32];
      pdf.setDrawColor(...borderCol); pdf.setLineWidth(0.4);
      pdf.setFillColor(250,251,255);
      pdf.roundedRect(kx, ky, kW-2, kH, 2, 2, 'FD');
      // Label
      pdf.setTextColor(120,130,150); pdf.setFontSize(6.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.text(k.l, kx+3, ky+4.5);
      // Valor
      const valCol = ok===null ? [0,31,88] : ok ? [27,127,58] : [176,16,32];
      pdf.setTextColor(...valCol); pdf.setFontSize(12); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.text(k.v2, kx+3, ky+11);
      // Sub
      pdf.setTextColor(130,140,160); pdf.setFontSize(6.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
      pdf.text(k.sub, kx+3, ky+16);
      // Indicador ok/mal
      if(ok!==null){
        pdf.setFillColor(ok?27:176, ok?127:16, ok?58:32);
        pdf.circle(kx+kW-5, ky+4, 2, 'F');
      }
    });
    y += 2*kH + 2*3 + 6;

    // ── KG POR DIVISIÓN ──
    pdf.setFillColor(42,63,111);
    pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 6, 'F');
    pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255); pdf.setFontSize(8); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
    pdf.text('📦  KG VS AÑO ANTERIOR POR DIVISIÓN — PROYECTADO A '+cfg.dias_lab+' DÍAS', mg+3, y+4.2);
    y += 6;

    // Cabecera tabla divisiones
    pdf.setFillColor(220,228,245);
    pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 5, 'F');
    pdf.setTextColor(40,60,110); pdf.setFontSize(7); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
    const cols = [{t:'DIVISIÓN',x:mg+3,w:35},{t:'AÑO ANT. KG',x:mg+40,w:30},
                  {t:'ACTUAL KG',x:mg+72,w:30},{t:'VAR%',x:mg+104,w:22},
                  {t:'PROY. KG',x:mg+128,w:30},{t:'VAR PROY%',x:mg+160,w:25},{t:'',x:mg+185,w:15}];
    cols.forEach(c=>pdf.text(c.t, c.x, y+3.5));
    y += 5;

    (v.divisiones||[]).forEach((d,i)=>{
      const kg_proy = +(d.kg26*factor).toFixed(1);
      const var_proy = d.kg25>0?+((kg_proy-d.kg25)/d.kg25*100).toFixed(1):null;
      pdf.setFillColor(i%2===0?255:248, i%2===0?255:250, i%2===0?255:255);
      pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 6, 'F');
      pdf.setTextColor(10,26,58); pdf.setFontSize(8); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.text(d.div, mg+3, y+4.2);
      pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
      pdf.text(d.kg25.toFixed(1), mg+40, y+4.2);
      pdf.setTextColor(0,50,150);
      pdf.text(d.kg26.toFixed(1), mg+72, y+4.2);
      // var%
      const vp = d.var_pct;
      pdf.setTextColor(vp==null?100:vp>=0?27:176, vp==null?100:vp>=0?127:16, vp==null?100:vp>=0?58:32);
      pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.text(vp!=null?(vp>=0?'▲':'')+vp.toFixed(1)+'%':'—', mg+104, y+4.2);
      pdf.setTextColor(0,50,150);
      pdf.text(kg_proy.toFixed(1), mg+128, y+4.2);
      const vpr = var_proy;
      pdf.setTextColor(vpr==null?100:vpr>=0?27:176, vpr==null?100:vpr>=0?127:16, vpr==null?100:vpr>=0?58:32);
      pdf.text(vpr!=null?(vpr>=0?'▲':'')+vpr.toFixed(1)+'%':'—', mg+160, y+4.2);
      // badge supera/falta
      if(kg_proy>=d.kg25){
        pdf.setFillColor(220,245,225); pdf.roundedRect(mg+183,y+1,18,4,1,1,'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(27,127,58); pdf.setFontSize(6); pdf.text('✓ supera',mg+184.5,y+4);
      } else {
        pdf.setFillColor(255,235,235); pdf.roundedRect(mg+183,y+1,18,4,1,1,'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(176,16,32); pdf.setFontSize(6); pdf.text('-'+(d.kg25-kg_proy).toFixed(0)+'kg',mg+185,y+4);
      }
      pdf.setFontSize(8);
      y += 6;
    });
    y += 4;

    // ── FOOTER ──
    pdf.setTextColor(160,160,160); pdf.setFontSize(6.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
    pdf.text('Arcor Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre · '+cfg.corte+' · '+v.cod+' '+vshort, pW/2, pH-5, {align:'center'});

    // ── COMPARTIR ──
    const blob = pdf.output('blob');
    const file = new File([blob], 'desempeño_'+v.cod+'_'+vshort.split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()+'.pdf', {type:'application/pdf'});
    if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
      navigator.share({files:[file], title:'RIMSA · Desempeño '+vshort});
    } else {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url; a.download=file.name; a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setTimeout(()=>{ window.open('https://web.whatsapp.com','_blank'); mostrarToast('PDF descargado. Adjuntalo en WhatsApp.'); }, 700);
    }
  } catch(err) {
    console.error('enviarDesempWA:', err);
    mostrarToast('Error al generar PDF: '+err.message);
  }
}


function vdSelect(cod){
  const cfg = D.config;
  const V   = D.vendors;
  const v   = V.find(x=>x.cod===cod);
  if(!v) return;

  // Marcar ítem activo en el menú
  document.querySelectorAll('.vd-item').forEach(el=>{
    el.classList.toggle('vd-active', el.id==='vdi-'+cod);
  });

  const factor  = cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab,1);
  const ptCls   = clsPct(v.part_tok, cfg.obj_part_tokin);
  const ctCls   = clsPct(v.cob_tok,  cfg.obj_cob_tokin);
  const cbCls   = clsPct(v.cob_pct,  cfg.obj_cob_global);
  const fiCls   = clsPct(v.fiado_pct,100,true);
  const vshort  = v.name.replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'');

  // KG divisiones
  const divCards = (v.divisiones||[]).map(d=>{
    const kg_proy = +(d.kg26 * factor).toFixed(1);
    const var_proy= d.kg25>0?+((kg_proy-d.kg25)/d.kg25*100).toFixed(1):null;
    const gap_proy= d.kg25>0&&kg_proy<d.kg25?+(d.kg25-kg_proy).toFixed(1):0;
    const arrowCl = d.var_pct==null?'muted':d.var_pct>=0?'good':'bad';
    const proyCl  = var_proy==null?'muted':var_proy>=0?'good':'bad';
    const pctTxt  = d.var_pct!=null?((d.var_pct>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(d.var_pct).toFixed(1)+'%'):'—';
    const proyTxt = var_proy!=null?((var_proy>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(var_proy).toFixed(1)+'%'):'—';
    const proyClr = var_proy!=null?(var_proy>=0?'var(--pos)':'var(--neg)'):'var(--muted)';
    const barW    = d.kg25>0?Math.min(100,(d.kg26/d.kg25)*100):0;
    const barCl   = d.var_pct!=null&&d.var_pct>=-5?'pbar-good':d.var_pct>=-20?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
    const gapTxt  = gap_proy>0
      ?`<span class="bad" style="font-size:9px">faltan ${gap_proy.toFixed(0)} KG</span>`
      :`<span class="good" style="font-size:9px">✓ supera AA</span>`;
    return `<div class="xv-div-card">
      <div class="xv-div-name">${d.div}</div>
      <div class="xv-div-row">
        <div style="text-align:center">
          <div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">AÑO ANT.</div>
          <b style="font-size:10px">${d.kg25.toFixed(1)}</b>
          <div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">KG</div>
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:center">
          <div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">ACTUAL</div>
          <b style="font-size:11px;color:var(--arc-blue)">${d.kg26.toFixed(1)}</b>
          <div style="font-size:9px"><span class="${arrowCl}">${pctTxt}</span></div>
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:center">
          <div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">PROY. ${cfg.dias_lab}d</div>
          <b style="font-size:11px;color:${proyClr}">${kg_proy.toFixed(1)}</b>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:${proyClr};font-weight:700">${proyTxt}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:5px 0 4px">
        <div class="pbar-fill ${barCl}" style="width:${barW}%"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:center">${gapTxt}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('') || '<div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;padding:8px">Sin datos de divisiones</div>';

  // Helper barra de progreso con objetivo
  const kpiBar = (val, obj, cl, reverse=false) => {
    const w = reverse
      ? Math.min(100, val<=obj ? 100 : (obj/val*100))
      : Math.min(100, (val/obj)*100);
    const barCl = (reverse ? val<=obj : val>=obj) ? 'pbar-good'
                : (reverse ? val<=obj*1.3 : val>=obj*0.9) ? 'pbar-warn' : 'pbar-bad';
    return `<div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:3px 0 1px">
      <div class="pbar-fill ${barCl}" style="width:${w.toFixed(0)}%"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:8px;color:var(--muted)">obj ${reverse?'≤':'≥'}${obj}%</div>`;
  };

  const panel = document.getElementById('vd-panel');
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <!-- Nombre y KPIs principales -->
    <div style="margin-bottom:12px">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px">
        <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--arc-blue)">
          <span class="vbadge">${v.cod}</span>${vshort}
          <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-left:6px">${v.universo} clientes · ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días</span>
        </div>
        <button onclick="enviarDesempWA('${v.cod}')" title="Enviar resumen por WhatsApp"
          style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 14px;
          font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
          💬 WhatsApp
        </button>
        <button onclick="abrirRankingClientes('${v.cod}')" title="Ver ranking de clientes"
          style="background:#FFD100;color:#1A3A6B;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;
          font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">
          🏆 Ranking
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- 6 KPI cards -->
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px">

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Venta Acum.</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--arc-blue)">${fmt(v.total)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">Proyectado: <b style="color:var(--arc-blue)">${fmt(v.total*factor)}</b></div>
        </div>

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Cobertura Global</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800" class="${cbCls}">${fmtP(v.cob_pct)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">${v.compradores} de ${v.universo} clientes</div>
          ${kpiBar(v.cob_pct, cfg.obj_cob_global, cbCls)}
        </div>

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Part. Tokin</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800" class="${ptCls}">${fmtP(v.part_tok)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">Tokin: <b>${fmt(v.si_tok)}</b> · Otros: ${fmt(v.no_tok)}</div>
          ${kpiBar(v.part_tok, cfg.obj_part_tokin, ptCls)}
        </div>

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Cob. Tokin</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800" class="${ctCls}">${fmtP(v.cob_tok)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">${v.comp_tok} clientes con Tokin app</div>
          ${kpiBar(v.cob_tok||0, cfg.obj_cob_tokin, ctCls)}
        </div>

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Fiado %</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800" class="${fiCls}">${fmtP(v.fiado_pct)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">Lím: ${fmt(v.limite_fiado)} · obj ≤${v.obj_fiado}%</div>
          ${kpiBar(v.fiado_pct, 100, fiCls, true)}
        </div>

        <div style="background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:2px">Saldo / Vencido</div>
          <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)">${fmtSaldo(v.saldo_tot, v.deuda_venc)}</div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">Vencido: <b class="${v.deuda_venc>0?'bad':'good'}">${fmt(v.deuda_venc)}</b></div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- KG por división -->
      <div style="margin-top:4px">
        <div class="xv-divs-title" style="margin-bottom:8px">📦 KG vs Año Anterior por División · proy. a ${cfg.dias_lab} días laborales</div>
        <div class="xv-divs-grid">${divCards}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}


// ── TAB 2: BANDEJAS ──────────────────────────────────────────
let bdFilter='TODOS';
function buildBandeja(){
  const el=document.getElementById('mod-bandeja');
  const BD=D.bandeja;
  const st=BD.stats;
  const total=Object.values(st).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);

  // KPIs
  const kpis=`<div class="kpi-row">
    <div class="kpi kpi-blue"><div class="kpi-val">${total}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Total clientes</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-ok">  <div class="kpi-val">${st.CUMPLE||0}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Cumplen ≥55 KG</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-warn"><div class="kpi-val">${st.CERCA||0}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Cerca (≥38.5 KG)</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-warn"><div class="kpi-val">${(st['EN RIESGO']||0)}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">En riesgo</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-bad"> <div class="kpi-val">${st['CRÍTICO']||0}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Crítico</div></div>
  </div>`;

  // Vendor filter buttons
  const vends = [...new Set(BD.clients.map(c=>c.vend_cod).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  const fbtn  = ['TODOS',...vends].map(v=>
    `<button class="fbtn${v==='TODOS'?' active':''}" onclick="bdFilterVend('${v}')">${v==='TODOS'?'Todos':v+' - '+BD.clients.find(c=>c.vend_cod===v)?.vend_name.split(' ')[0]}</button>`
  ).join('');

  // Estado filter
  const est_fbtn = ['TODOS','CUMPLE','CERCA','EN RIESGO','CRÍTICO'].map(e=>
    `<button class="fbtn" onclick="bdFilterEst('${e}')">${e}</button>`
  ).join('');

  el.innerHTML = kpis +
    `<div class="filter-bar" id="bd-vend-filter">${fbtn}</div>
     <div class="filter-bar" id="bd-est-filter">${est_fbtn}</div>` +
    `<div id="bd-table-wrap"></div>`;

  // Set first filter buttons active
  document.getElementById('bd-vend-filter').querySelector('.fbtn').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('bd-est-filter').querySelector('.fbtn').classList.add('active');

  renderBandeja();
}

let bdVendFilter='TODOS', bdEstFilter='TODOS';
function bdFilterVend(v){
  bdVendFilter=v;
  document.querySelectorAll('#bd-vend-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>{
    b.classList.toggle('active',b.textContent.startsWith(v==='TODOS'?'Todos':v));
  });
  renderBandeja();
}
function bdFilterEst(e){
  bdEstFilter=e;
  document.querySelectorAll('#bd-est-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>{
    b.classList.toggle('active',b.textContent===e);
  });
  renderBandeja();
}
function renderBandeja(){
  const BD=D.bandeja;
  const cfg=D.config;
  const OBJ_EST = cfg.obj_bandeja    || 40;
  const OBJ_20  = cfg.obj_bandeja_2_0|| 55;

  let clients=BD.clients.filter(c=>{
    if(bdVendFilter!=='TODOS' && c.vend_cod!==bdVendFilter) return false;
    if(bdEstFilter!=='TODOS' && c.estado!==bdEstFilter) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // ── Global stats para clientes filtrados ──────────────────────────────
  const totB = BD.totals_bandeja || {};
  const filKG  = clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.kg26||0),0);
  const filBand= clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.total_bandejas||0),0);
  const filObj = clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.obj_total||0),0);
  const filRinde= filBand>0 ? (filKG/filBand).toFixed(1) : '—';
  const globalRinde = totB.all>0
    ? (BD.clients.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.kg26||0),0)/totB.all).toFixed(1)
    : '—';
  const gRindeCls = parseFloat(globalRinde)>= OBJ_EST ? 'var(--pos)' : parseFloat(globalRinde)>= OBJ_EST*0.7 ? '#D97706' : 'var(--neg)';

  // ── Global bandeja summary cards ──────────────────────────────────────
  const globalCards = `<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px">
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:130px;background:rgba(0,61,165,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center">
      <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px">Total Bandejas</div>
      <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--arc-blue)">${totB.all||0}</div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">${totB.estandar||0} est · ${totB['2_0']||0} 2.0 · ${totB.medida||0} med.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:130px;background:rgba(0,61,165,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center">
      <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px">Rinde Global</div>
      <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:${gRindeCls}">${globalRinde}</div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">KG/bandeja · obj est: ${OBJ_EST} · 2.0: ${OBJ_20}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:130px;background:rgba(0,61,165,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center">
      <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px">Obj. Total (${totB.all} unid.)</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--arc-blue)">${((totB.obj_estandar||0)+(totB.obj_2_0||0)+(totB.obj_medida||0)).toLocaleString('es-AR')} KG</div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">Est: ${totB.obj_estandar||0} · 2.0: ${totB.obj_2_0||0} · Med: ${totB.obj_medida||0}</div>
    </div>
    ${bdVendFilter!=='TODOS'?`
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:130px;background:rgba(0,61,165,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center">
      <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px">Rinde ${bdVendFilter}</div>
      <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:${parseFloat(filRinde)>=OBJ_EST?'var(--pos)':parseFloat(filRinde)>=OBJ_EST*0.7?'#D97706':'var(--neg)'}">${filRinde}</div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">${filBand} bandejas · obj: ${filObj} KG</div>
    </div>`:''}
  </div>`;

  const rows=clients.map(c=>{
    const yoy=c.yoy!=null?`<span class="${c.yoy>=0?'good':'bad'}">${c.yoy>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(c.yoy).toFixed(0)}%</span>`:'<span class="muted">—</span>';
    const objC = c.obj_total > 0 ? c.obj_total : (c.total_bandejas||1)*OBJ_EST;
    const bar=Math.min(110,pct(c.kg26, objC));
    const barCls=c.estado==='CUMPLE'?'pbar-good':c.estado==='CERCA'?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
    const plChip=c.plataforma?`<span class="st st-si" style="font-size:9px;margin-left:3px">${c.plataforma}</span>`:'';
    // Bandeja badges
    const bBadges=[];
    if((c.qty_estandar||0)>0) bBadges.push(`<span style="font-size:9px;background:rgba(0,61,165,.1);color:var(--arc-blue);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">${c.qty_estandar}×EST</span>`);
    if((c.qty_2_0||0)>0)      bBadges.push(`<span style="font-size:9px;background:rgba(22,163,74,.12);color:#15803d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">${c.qty_2_0}×2.0</span>`);
    if((c.qty_medida||0)>0)   bBadges.push(`<span style="font-size:9px;background:rgba(124,58,237,.1);color:#7c3aed;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">${c.qty_medida}×MED</span>`);
    const bTag = bBadges.length ? `<span style="margin-left:4px">${bBadges.join(' ')}</span>` : '';
    const rindeTxt = c.total_bandejas>0 ? `<span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)"> · ${c.rinde||0} KG/u</span>` : '';
    const _bn = (c.nombre||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _bv = (c.vend_name||c.vend_cod||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _bc = (c.canal||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    return `<tr class="exp-row" onclick="toggleExp('xb-${c.cod}')">
      <td class="tl">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px">
          <span>${c.nombre}${plChip}${bTag}</span>
          <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirModalBaja('${c.cod}','${_bn}','${_bc}','${c.vend_cod}','${_bv}')"
            style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;border:1px solid #FECACA;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0"
            title="Dar de baja">🚫</button>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="vbadge">${c.vend_cod}</span></td>
      <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.kg25)}</td>
      <td class="tr"><b>${fmtKG(c.kg26)}</b>${rindeTxt}
        <div class="pbar-wrap"><div class="pbar-fill ${barCls}" style="width:${bar}%"></div></div>
      </td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="${c.gap>=0?'good':'bad'}">${c.gap>=0?'+':''}${c.gap.toFixed(1)}</span></td>
      <td class="tc">${yoy}</td>
      <td class="tc">${stBadge(c.estado)}</td>
    </tr>
    <tr class="exp-detail" id="xb-${c.cod}"><td colspan="7"><div class="exp-inner">
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px">
        Vendedor: <b>${c.vend_name}</b>
        ${c.total_bandejas>0?` · <b>${c.total_bandejas}</b> bandeja${c.total_bandejas>1?'s':''} · Obj: <b>${objC} KG</b> · Rinde: <b style="color:${c.rinde>=OBJ_EST?'var(--pos)':c.rinde>=OBJ_EST*0.7?'#D97706':'var(--neg)'}">${c.rinde||0} KG/u</b>`:''}
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">
        ${BD.segs.map((s,i)=>{
          const v25=c.segs25[i]||0,v26=c.segs26[i]||0;
          if(v25===0&&v26===0) return '';
          const trend=v26>v25?'↑':v26<v25?'↓':'=';
          const cl=v26>v25?'good':v26<v25?'bad':'muted';
          return `<div style="background:rgba(0,61,165,.06);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px">
            <b style="color:var(--arc-blue)">${s.split('-')[1]?.trim()||s}</b><br>
            25: ${v25.toFixed(1)} · 26: <span class="${cl}">${v26.toFixed(1)} ${trend}</span>
          </div>`;
        }).join('')}
      </div>
    </div></td></tr>`;
  }).join('');

  const wrap=document.getElementById('bd-table-wrap');
  if(!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="sec">${globalCards}<div class="sec-hdr">🪧 Clientes con Bandeja — ${clients.length} registros
    <small>Obj: ${OBJ_EST} KG/bandeja estándar · ${OBJ_20} KG/bandeja 2.0 · Golosinas + Chocolates + Barras + Alfajores</small></div>
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr>
        <th class="tl">Cliente</th><th>Vend.</th>
        <th>KG 2025</th><th>KG 2026</th>
        <th>Gap Obj</th><th>vs AA</th><th>Estado</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table></div></div>`;
}

// ── TAB 3: PLATAFORMA ────────────────────────────────────────
let platFilter='TODOS';
function buildPlat(){
  const el=document.getElementById('mod-plat');
  const PL=D.plataforma;
  const tipos=PL.tipos;

  // KPIs por tipo
  const byTipo={};
  PL.clients.forEach(c=>{
    if(!byTipo[c.tipo]) byTipo[c.tipo]={n:0,q1_25:0,q1_26:0};
    byTipo[c.tipo].n++;
    byTipo[c.tipo].q1_25+=c.q1_25||0;
    byTipo[c.tipo].q1_26+=c.q1_26||0;
  });

  const kpis=`<div class="kpi-row">
    <div class="kpi kpi-blue"><div class="kpi-val">${PL.clients.length}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Total clientes</div></div>
    ${Object.entries(byTipo).map(([t,d])=>{
      const varQ=d.q1_25>0?((d.q1_26-d.q1_25)/d.q1_25*100).toFixed(1):null;
      const cls=varQ!=null?(+varQ>=0?'kpi-ok':'kpi-bad'):'';
      return `<div class="kpi ${cls}">
        <div class="kpi-val">${d.n}</div>
        <div class="kpi-lbl">${t}</div>
        ${varQ!=null?`<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:${+varQ>=0?'var(--pos)':'var(--neg)'}">${+varQ>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(+varQ).toFixed(1)}% Q1 aa</div>`:''}
      </div>`;
    }).join('')}
  </div>`;

  // Filter buttons
  const fbtn=['TODOS',...tipos].map(t=>
    `<button class="fbtn${t==='TODOS'?' active':''}" onclick="platFilterTipo('${t}')">${t}</button>`
  ).join('');

  el.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="filter-bar" id="plat-filter">${fbtn}</div>
    <div id="plat-table-wrap"></div>`;

  renderPlat();
}

let platFilterTipoVal='TODOS';
function platFilterTipo(t){
  platFilterTipoVal=t;
  document.querySelectorAll('#plat-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>{
    b.classList.toggle('active',b.textContent===t);
  });
  renderPlat();
}
function renderPlat(){
  const PL  = D.plataforma;
  const cfg = D.config;
  const clients = platFilterTipoVal==='TODOS' ? PL.clients : PL.clients.filter(c=>c.tipo===platFilterTipoVal);
  const rows = clients.map((c,i)=>{
    const vQ  = c.q1_25>0  ? ((c.q1_26-c.q1_25)/c.q1_25*100)  : null;
    const vA  = c.abr25>0  ? ((c.abr26-c.abr25)/c.abr25*100)   : null;
    const qCls = vQ!=null ? (vQ>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';
    const aCls = vA!=null ? (vA>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';
    const proy = +(c.abr26 * (cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab,1))).toFixed(1);
    const vP   = c.abr25>0 ? ((proy-c.abr25)/c.abr25*100) : null;
    const pCls = vP!=null ? (vP>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';

    // Division cards
    const divCards = (c.divisiones||[]).map(d=>{
      const dproy = +(d.abr26 * (cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab,1))).toFixed(1);
      const dvarp = d.abr25>0 ? +((dproy-d.abr25)/d.abr25*100).toFixed(1) : null;
      const dvarCl = d.var_pct==null?'muted':d.var_pct>=0?'good':'bad';
      const dpCl  = dvarp==null?'muted':dvarp>=0?'good':'bad';
      const dbw   = d.abr25>0 ? Math.min(100,(d.abr26/d.abr25)*100) : (d.abr26>0?100:0);
      const dbcl  = d.var_pct==null?'pbar-warn':d.var_pct>=-5?'pbar-good':d.var_pct>=-25?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
      const gapTxt = d.gap_kg>0
        ? `<span class="bad" style="font-size:9px">faltan ${d.gap_kg.toFixed(0)} KG</span>`
        : `<span class="good" style="font-size:9px">✓ supera AA</span>`;
      return `<div class="xv-div-card">
        <div class="xv-div-name">${d.div}</div>
        <div class="xv-div-row">
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">AÑO ANT.</div>
            <b style="font-size:10px">${d.abr25.toFixed(1)}</b><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">KG</div></div>
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">ACTUAL</div>
            <b style="font-size:11px;color:var(--arc-blue)">${d.abr26.toFixed(1)}</b>
            <div style="font-size:9px"><span class="${dvarCl}">${d.var_pct!=null?(d.var_pct>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(d.var_pct).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</span></div></div>
          <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">PROY.${cfg.dias_lab}d</div>
            <b style="font-size:11px;color:${dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${dproy.toFixed(1)}</b>
            <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:${dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${dvarp!=null?(dvarp>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(dvarp).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:4px 0"><div class="pbar-fill ${dbcl}" style="width:${dbw}%"></div></div>
        <div style="text-align:center">${gapTxt}</div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') || '<div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;padding:8px">Sin datos de divisiones</div>';

    const _pbn = (c.nombre||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _pbv = (D.vend_names[c.vend_cod]||c.vend_cod||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _pbt = (c.tipo||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    return `<tr class="exp-row" onclick="toggleExp('xp-${c.cod}')">
      <td class="tl"><span class="ptipo ${tipoClass(c.tipo)}">${c.tipo}</span></td>
      <td class="tl">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px">
          <span>${c.nombre}</span>
          <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirModalBaja('${c.cod}','${_pbn}','${_pbt}','${c.vend_cod}','${_pbv}')"
            style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;border:1px solid #FECACA;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0"
            title="Dar de baja">🚫</button>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="tc">${c.localidad}</td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="vbadge">${c.vend_cod}</span></td>
      <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.q1_25)}</td>
      <td class="tr"><b>${fmtKG(c.q1_26)}</b></td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="${qCls}">${vQ!=null?(vQ>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(vQ).toFixed(1)+'%':'—'}</span></td>
      <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.abr26)}</td>
      <td class="tr"><span class="${pCls}">${proy.toFixed(1)} KG</span></td>
      <td class="tc"><span class="${c.tiene_tokin?'st st-si':'st st-no'}">${c.tiene_tokin?'✓ Tokin app':'Sin Tokin app'}</span></td>
    </tr>
    <tr class="exp-detail" id="xp-${c.cod}"><td colspan="10"><div class="exp-inner">
      <div class="xv-section">
        <span class="xv-label">📊 Total</span>
        <span>Q1 2025: <b>${fmtKG(c.q1_25)}</b></span>
        <span>Q1 2026: <b class="${qCls}">${fmtKG(c.q1_26)}</b></span>
        <span>Abr actual: <b>${fmtKG(c.abr26)}</b></span>
        <span>Proy ${cfg.dias_lab}d: <b class="${pCls}">${proy.toFixed(1)} KG</b></span>
        <span class="muted">Saldo CTA: <b>${fmt(c.saldo)}</b></span>
      </div>
      <div class="xv-divs">
        <div class="xv-divs-title">📦 KG Abril por División vs Año Anterior · proyectado a ${cfg.dias_lab} días</div>
        <div class="xv-divs-grid">${divCards}</div>
      </div>
    </div></td></tr>`;
  }).join('');

  const wrap = document.getElementById('plat-table-wrap');
  if(!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="sec"><div class="sec-hdr">🏷️ Clientes de Plataforma — ${clients.length} registros
    <small>Click en fila para ver KG por División</small></div>
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr>
        <th>Tipo</th><th class="tl">Cliente</th><th>Localidad</th><th>Vend.</th>
        <th>Q1 2025</th><th>Q1 2026</th><th>Var Q1</th>
        <th>Abr Actual</th><th>Abr Proy.</th><th>Tokin</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table></div></div>`;
}

// ── TAB 4: CLIENTES IMPORTANTES ──────────────────────────────
function buildCI(){
  const el  = document.getElementById('mod-ci');
  const CI  = D.clientes_importantes;
  const cfg = D.config;
  let html  = '';

  const kpis=`<div class="kpi-row" style="margin-bottom:14px">
    ${CI.canales.map(c=>{
      const lst=CI.data[c]||[];
      const q26=lst.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x.q1_26||0),0);
      const q25=lst.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x.q1_25||0),0);
      const varQ=q25>0?((q26-q25)/q25*100):null;
      const cls=varQ!=null?(varQ>=0?'kpi-ok':'kpi-bad'):'';
      return `<div class="kpi ${cls}">
        <div class="kpi-val">${lst.length}</div>
        <div class="kpi-lbl">${c}</div>
        ${varQ!=null?`<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:${varQ>=0?'var(--pos)':'var(--neg)'}">${varQ>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(varQ).toFixed(1)}%</div>`:''}
      </div>`;
    }).join('')}
  </div>`;
  html += kpis;

  CI.canales.forEach(canal=>{
    const lst=CI.data[canal]||[];
    if(!lst.length) return;
    const rows=lst.map((c,i)=>{
      const vQ   = c.q1_25>0  ? ((c.q1_26-c.q1_25)/c.q1_25*100)  : null;
      const vA   = c.abr25>0  ? ((c.abr26-c.abr25)/c.abr25*100)   : null;
      const qCls = vQ!=null   ? (vQ>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';
      const aCls = vA!=null   ? (vA>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';
      const proy = +(c.abr26*(cfg.dias_lab/Math.max(cfg.dias_trab,1))).toFixed(1);
      const vP   = c.abr25>0  ? ((proy-c.abr25)/c.abr25*100) : null;
      const pCls = vP!=null   ? (vP>=0?'good':'bad') : 'muted';

      // Division cards for expand row
      const divCards = (c.divisiones||[]).map(d=>{
        const dproy = +(d.abr26*(cfg.dias_lab/Math.max(cfg.dias_trab,1))).toFixed(1);
        const dvarp = d.abr25>0?+((dproy-d.abr25)/d.abr25*100).toFixed(1):null;
        const dvarCl= d.var_pct==null?'muted':d.var_pct>=0?'good':'bad';
        const dpCl  = dvarp==null?'muted':dvarp>=0?'good':'bad';
        const dbw   = d.abr25>0?Math.min(100,(d.abr26/d.abr25)*100):(d.abr26>0?100:0);
        const dbcl  = d.var_pct==null?'pbar-warn':d.var_pct>=-5?'pbar-good':d.var_pct>=-25?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
        const gapTxt= d.gap_kg>0
          ? `<span class="bad" style="font-size:9px">faltan ${d.gap_kg.toFixed(0)} KG</span>`
          : `<span class="good" style="font-size:9px">✓ supera AA</span>`;
        return `<div class="xv-div-card">
          <div class="xv-div-name">${d.div}</div>
          <div class="xv-div-row">
            <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">AÑO ANT.</div>
              <b style="font-size:10px">${d.abr25.toFixed(1)}</b><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">KG</div></div>
            <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">ACTUAL</div>
              <b style="font-size:11px;color:var(--arc-blue)">${d.abr26.toFixed(1)}</b>
              <div style="font-size:9px"><span class="${dvarCl}">${d.var_pct!=null?(d.var_pct>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(d.var_pct).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</span></div></div>
            <div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">PROY.${cfg.dias_lab}d</div>
              <b style="font-size:11px;color:${dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${dproy.toFixed(1)}</b>
              <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:${dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)'}">${dvarp!=null?(dvarp>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(dvarp).toFixed(0)+'%':'—'}</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:4px 0"><div class="pbar-fill ${dbcl}" style="width:${dbw}%"></div></div>
          <div style="text-align:center">${gapTxt}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('') || '<div style="color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;padding:8px">Sin datos de divisiones</div>';

      const _cin = (c.nombre||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
      const _civ = (D.vend_names[c.vend_cod]||c.vend_cod||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
      const _cic = (canal||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
      return `<tr class="exp-row" onclick="toggleExp('xci-${canal.replace(/\s/g,'_')}-${i}')">
        <td class="tl">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px">
            <span>${c.nombre}</span>
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirModalBaja('${c.cod}','${_cin}','${_cic}','${c.vend_cod}','${_civ}')"
              style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;border:1px solid #FECACA;border-radius:4px;
              padding:2px 6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0"
              title="Dar de baja">🚫</button>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="tc"><span class="vbadge">${c.vend_cod}</span></td>
        <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.q1_25)}</td>
        <td class="tr"><b>${fmtKG(c.q1_26)}</b></td>
        <td class="tc"><span class="${qCls}">${vQ!=null?(vQ>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(vQ).toFixed(1)+'%':'—'}</span></td>
        <td class="tr">${fmtKG(c.abr26)}</td>
        <td class="tr"><span class="${pCls}">${proy.toFixed(1)} KG</span></td>
        <td class="tc"><span class="${c.tiene_tokin?'st st-si':'st st-no'}">${c.tiene_tokin?'✓':'✗'}</span></td>
        <td class="tc">${fmtSaldo(c.saldo||0,0)}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr class="exp-detail" id="xci-${canal.replace(/\s/g,'_')}-${i}"><td colspan="9"><div class="exp-inner">
        <div class="xv-section">
          <span class="xv-label">📊 Total</span>
          <span>Q1 2025: <b>${fmtKG(c.q1_25)}</b></span>
          <span>Q1 2026: <b class="${qCls}">${fmtKG(c.q1_26)}</b></span>
          <span>Abr actual: <b>${fmtKG(c.abr26)}</b></span>
          <span>Proy ${cfg.dias_lab}d: <b class="${pCls}">${proy.toFixed(1)} KG</b></span>
          <span>Saldo CTA: <b>${fmtSaldo(c.saldo||0,0)}</b></span>
        </div>
        <div class="xv-divs">
          <div class="xv-divs-title">📦 KG Abril por División vs Año Anterior · proyectado a ${cfg.dias_lab} días</div>
          <div class="xv-divs-grid">${divCards}</div>
        </div>
      </div></td></tr>`;
    }).join('');

    html+=`<div class="sec"><div class="sec-hdr">⭐ ${canal} — ${lst.length} clientes <small>(sin plataforma · click para divisiones)</small></div>
      <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">
        <thead><tr>
          <th class="tl">Cliente</th><th>Vend.</th>
          <th>Q1 2025</th><th>Q1 2026</th><th>Var Q1</th>
          <th>Abr Actual</th><th>Abr Proy.</th><th>Tokin</th><th>Saldo CTA</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table></div></div>`;
  });

  el.innerHTML=html;
}

// ── EXPAND TOGGLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleExp(id){
  const row=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!row) return;
  const isOpen=row.classList.contains('open');
  row.classList.toggle('open',!isOpen);
  row.style.display=isOpen?'none':'table-row';
}

// ── TAB 5: TAREA DEL DÍA ─────────────────────────────────────
const DIAS_ES    = ['domingo','lunes','martes','miercoles','jueves','viernes','sabado'];
const DIA_KEY    = {'miercoles':'miércoles'};  // normaliza clave sin tilde → con tilde para lookup en D.tasks
const DIAS_LABEL = {'lunes':'Lunes','martes':'Martes','miercoles':'Miércoles','jueves':'Jueves','viernes':'Viernes'};

// Which view is currently active for printing
let _printMode = 'tarea'; // 'tarea' | 'freezer' | 'bandeja'

function buildTarea(){
  const el = document.getElementById('mod-tarea');
  const today = DIAS_ES[new Date().getDay()];
  const diaActivo = (today in DIAS_LABEL) ? today : 'lunes';
  const vends = Object.keys(D.tasks).sort();

  el.innerHTML = `
  <!-- ── TOOLBAR ── -->
  <div class="t-toolbar">
    <div class="t-toolbar-group">
      <span class="t-label">Día</span>
      <div class="filter-bar" id="tarea-day-filter" style="margin:0">
        ${Object.keys(DIAS_LABEL).map(d=>`<button class="fbtn${d===diaActivo?' active':''}" id="tday-${d}" onclick="tareaSetDia('${d}')">${DIAS_LABEL[d]}</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="t-toolbar-group">
      <span class="t-label">Vendedor</span>
      <div class="filter-bar" id="tarea-vend-filter" style="margin:0">
        ${['TODOS',...vends].map(v=>`<button class="fbtn${v==='TODOS'?' active':''}" id="tvend-${v}" onclick="tareaSetVend('${v}')">${v==='TODOS'?'Todos':v+' '+( D.vend_names[v]?.split(' ')[0]||'')}</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="t-toolbar-actions">
      <div class="t-btn-group">
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-print" onclick="printView('tarea')">🖨️ Tarea</button>
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-wa" onclick="compartirPDF('tarea')" title="Enviar Tarea por WhatsApp">💬</button>
      </div>
      <div class="t-btn-group">
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-frz" onclick="printView('freezer')">🧊 Freezer</button>
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-wa" onclick="compartirPDF('freezer')" title="Enviar Freezer por WhatsApp">💬</button>
      </div>
      <div class="t-btn-group">
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-bd" onclick="printView('bandeja')">🪧 Bandeja</button>
        <button class="t-btn t-btn-wa" onclick="compartirPDF('bandeja')" title="Enviar Bandeja por WhatsApp">💬</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── CONTENIDO PRINCIPAL (tarea) ── -->
  <div id="tarea-content"></div>

  <!-- ── INFORME FREEZER (oculto, solo para imprimir) ── -->
  <div id="informe-freezer" style="display:none"></div>

  <!-- ── INFORME BANDEJA (oculto, solo para capturar) ── -->
  <div id="informe-bandeja" style="display:none"></div>

  <!-- ── INFORME TAREA (oculto, solo para capturar) ── -->
  <div id="informe-tarea" style="display:none"></div>`;

  window._tareaDia  = diaActivo;
  window._tareaVend = 'TODOS';
  renderTarea();
  buildInformeFreezer();
  buildInformeBandeja();
}

function tareaSetDia(d){
  window._tareaDia = d;
  document.querySelectorAll('#tarea-day-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.id==='tday-'+d));
  renderTarea();
}
function tareaSetVend(v){
  window._tareaVend = v;
  document.querySelectorAll('#tarea-vend-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.id==='tvend-'+v));
  renderTarea();
}

// ── RENDER TAREA ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderTarea(){
  // Fallback si el tab no fue inicializado todavía (ej: imprimir sin abrir el tab)
  if(!window._tareaDia){
    const _hoy = DIAS_ES[new Date().getDay()];
    window._tareaDia  = (_hoy in DIAS_LABEL) ? _hoy : 'lunes';
    window._tareaVend = 'TODOS';
  }
  const dia   = window._tareaDia  || 'lunes';
  const vfilt = window._tareaVend || 'TODOS';
  const vends = vfilt==='TODOS' ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort() : [vfilt];
  const cfg   = D.config;

  // ── Helpers para filas de alerta ──────────────────────────────
  function makeAlertRow(c, vend, vname, idx, tipo){
    const tKey = 'TA_' + tipo + '_' + vend + '_' + idx;
    (window._tareaMap = window._tareaMap||{})[tKey] = {
      nombre:c.nombre, canal:c.canal, kg26:c.kg26, kg25:c.kg25,
      var_kg:c.var_kg, saldo:c.saldo, vencido:c.vencido,
      no_compro:c.no_compro, sin_tokin:c.sin_tokin,
      vend_name:vname, dia:DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia
    };
    const kgTxt = c.kg26>0
      ? c.kg26.toFixed(1)+' KG'+(c.var_kg!=null?' ('+(c.var_kg>=0?'+':'')+c.var_kg.toFixed(0)+'%)':'')
      : '<span style="color:#B01020">0 KG</span>';
    const saldoTxt = fmtSaldo(c.saldo, c.vencido);
    const ofBadge  = getOfBadgeCliente(c, vend);
    const _tan = (c.nombre||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _tav = (vname||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const _tac = (c.canal||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    return `<tr class="tr-p${idx%2}">
      <td class="tc-n">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px">
          <span>${c.nombre}</span>
          <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();tareaMsg('${tKey}')"
            style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
            white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0">📱</button>
          <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirModalBaja('${c.cod}','${_tan}','${_tac}','${vend}','${_tav}')"
            style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;border:1px solid #FECACA;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
            white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0" title="Dar de baja este cliente">🚫</button>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="tc-c">${c.canal}</td>
      <td class="tc-f">${ofBadge?'&nbsp;'+ofBadge:''}</td>
      <td class="tc-kg">${kgTxt}</td>
      <td class="tc-s">${saldoTxt}</td>
      <td class="tc-d">${c.direccion||''}</td>
      <td class="tc-v"></td>
    </tr>`;
  }

  function makeSeccion(titulo, color, emoji, filas, vendedor, vname, cfg){
    if(!filas) return '';
    const vdata = D.vendors.find(v=>v.cod===vendedor)||{};
    const fiado_pct = vdata.fiado_pct||0;
    const fiado_cls = fiado_pct<=100?'#1B7F3A':fiado_pct<=130?'#D97706':'#B01020';
    return `<div class="tvb" style="margin-bottom:10px">
      <div class="tv-hdr" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,${color},${color}CC)">
        <div class="tv-hl"><div class="tv-logo">RIMSA <span style="color:#FFD100">·</span> Arcor</div><div class="tv-sub">Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre</div></div>
        <div class="tv-hc">
          <div class="tv-vn">${emoji} ${titulo} — ${vendedor} ${vname.split('-').pop().trim()}</div>
          <div class="tv-vs">${DIAS_LABEL[dia]} · ${cfg.corte} · ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días · ${filas.length} cliente${filas.length!==1?'s':''}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tv-hr">
          <div class="tv-kpi"><b>${fmt(vdata.total||0)}</b><small>Venta</small></div>
          <div class="tv-kpi"><b style="color:${fiado_cls}">${fiado_pct.toFixed(1)}%</b><small>Fiado</small></div>
          <div class="tv-kpi"><b>${(vdata.cob_pct||0).toFixed(1)}%</b><small>Cob.</small></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <table class="tv-tbl">
        <thead><tr>
          <th class="tc-n">CLIENTE</th><th class="tc-c">CANAL</th>
          <th class="tc-f">OFERTA</th><th class="tc-kg">KG ABR</th>
          <th class="tc-s">SALDO</th><th class="tc-d">DIRECCIÓN</th>
          <th class="tc-v">✓</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>${filas}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
  }

  // ── Set de cods con freezer sin compra (para cruce rápido) ──
  const frzSinCompra = new Set(
    (D.freezer.clients||[]).filter(c=>c.kg26===0).map(c=>c.cod)
  );

  // Para modo por vendedor individual — separamos por vendedor con encabezado
  const porVendor = vfilt !== 'TODOS';

  let html = '';

  if(porVendor){
    // ── Vista individual: 3 secciones del vendedor ──────────────
    const vend  = vends[0];
    const vname = D.vend_names[vend] || vend;
    const clients = (D.tasks[vend]?.[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia]) || [];

    const nc_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.no_compro);
    const st_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.sin_tokin && !c.no_compro);
    const bd_list  = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && c.kg26===0 && (c.bandeja==='CRÍTICO'||c.bandeja==='EN RIESGO'));
    const frz_list = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && frzSinCompra.has(c.cod));

    if(nc_list.length){
      const rows = nc_list.map((c,i)=>makeAlertRow(c,vend,vname,i,'nc')).join('');
      html += makeSeccion('SIN COMPRA','#B01020','🔴',rows,vend,vname,cfg);
    }
    if(st_list.length){
      const rows = st_list.map((c,i)=>makeAlertRow(c,vend,vname,i,'st')).join('');
      html += makeSeccion('SIN TOKIN','#D97706','🟠',rows,vend,vname,cfg);
    }
    if(bd_list.length){
      const rows = bd_list.map((c,i)=>makeAlertRow(c,vend,vname,i,'bd')).join('');
      html += makeSeccion('BANDEJA SIN COMPRA','#7C3AED','🨧',rows,vend,vname,cfg);
    }
    if(frz_list.length){
      const rows = frz_list.map((c,i)=>makeAlertRow(c,vend,vname,i,'frz')).join('');
      html += makeSeccion('FREEZER SIN COMPRA','#0EA5E9','🧊',rows,vend,vname,cfg);
    }
    if(!html) html=`<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">✅ Sin alertas para ${vname} este ${DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia}.</div>`;

  } else {
    // ── Vista global TODOS: tabla unificada por sección con vendedor como columna ──
    const COLOR_NC='#B01020', COLOR_ST='#D97706', COLOR_BD='#7C3AED';
    let nc_all=[], st_all=[], bd_all=[], frz_all=[];

    vends.forEach(vend=>{
      const vname   = D.vend_names[vend] || vend;
      const clients = (D.tasks[vend]?.[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia]) || [];
      clients.filter(c=>c.no_compro).forEach((c,i)=>{
        const tKey='TA_nc_'+vend+'_'+i;
        (window._tareaMap=window._tareaMap||{})[tKey]={nombre:c.nombre,canal:c.canal,kg26:c.kg26,kg25:c.kg25,var_kg:c.var_kg,saldo:c.saldo,vencido:c.vencido,no_compro:true,sin_tokin:c.sin_tokin,vend_name:vname,dia:DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia};
        nc_all.push({c,vend,vname,tKey,i});
      });
      clients.filter(c=>c.sin_tokin&&!c.no_compro).forEach((c,i)=>{
        const tKey='TA_st_'+vend+'_'+i;
        (window._tareaMap=window._tareaMap||{})[tKey]={nombre:c.nombre,canal:c.canal,kg26:c.kg26,kg25:c.kg25,var_kg:c.var_kg,saldo:c.saldo,vencido:c.vencido,no_compro:false,sin_tokin:true,vend_name:vname,dia:DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia};
        st_all.push({c,vend,vname,tKey,i});
      });
      clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro&&c.kg26===0&&(c.bandeja==='CRÍTICO'||c.bandeja==='EN RIESGO')).forEach((c,i)=>{
        const tKey='TA_bd_'+vend+'_'+i;
        (window._tareaMap=window._tareaMap||{})[tKey]={nombre:c.nombre,canal:c.canal,kg26:c.kg26,kg25:c.kg25,var_kg:c.var_kg,saldo:c.saldo,vencido:c.vencido,no_compro:false,sin_tokin:c.sin_tokin,vend_name:vname,dia:DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia};
        bd_all.push({c,vend,vname,tKey,i});
      });
      clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro&&frzSinCompra.has(c.cod)).forEach((c,i)=>{
        const tKey='TA_frz_'+vend+'_'+i;
        (window._tareaMap=window._tareaMap||{})[tKey]={nombre:c.nombre,canal:c.canal,kg26:c.kg26,kg25:c.kg25,var_kg:c.var_kg,saldo:c.saldo,vencido:c.vencido,no_compro:false,sin_tokin:c.sin_tokin,vend_name:vname,dia:DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia};
        frz_all.push({c,vend,vname,tKey,i});
      });
    });

    function makeGlobalSeccion(titulo, color, emoji, items){
      if(!items.length) return '';
      const rows = items.map(({c,vend,vname,tKey,i})=>{
        const kgTxt = c.kg26>0
          ? c.kg26.toFixed(1)+' KG'
          : '<span style="color:#B01020">0 KG</span>';
        const saldoTxt = fmtSaldo(c.saldo, c.vencido);
        const ofBadge  = getOfBadgeCliente(c, vend);
        const vshort   = vname.split('-').pop().trim().split(' ')[0];
        return `<tr class="tr-p${i%2}">
          <td class="tc-n">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px">
              <span>${c.nombre}</span>
              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();tareaMsg('${tKey}')"
                style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;
                padding:2px 7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
                white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0">📱</button>
            </div>
          </td>
          <td class="tc-c">${c.canal}</td>
          <td style="padding:3px 5px;font-size:9px"><span class="vbadge">${vend}</span> ${vshort}</td>
          <td class="tc-kg">${kgTxt}</td>
          <td class="tc-s">${saldoTxt}</td>
          <td class="tc-f">${ofBadge||'—'}</td>
          <td class="tc-v"></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('');
      return `<div class="tvb" style="margin-bottom:10px">
        <div class="tv-hdr" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,${color},${color}BB)">
          <div class="tv-hl"><div class="tv-logo">RIMSA <span style="color:#FFD100">·</span> Arcor</div><div class="tv-sub">Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre</div></div>
          <div class="tv-hc">
            <div class="tv-vn">${emoji} ${titulo} — TODOS LOS VENDEDORES</div>
            <div class="tv-vs">${DIAS_LABEL[dia]} · ${cfg.corte} · ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días · <b>${items.length}</b> cliente${items.length!==1?'s':''}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="tv-hr">
            <div class="tv-kpi"><b style="font-size:22px">${items.length}</b><small>Alertas</small></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <table class="tv-tbl">
          <thead><tr>
            <th class="tc-n">CLIENTE</th><th class="tc-c">CANAL</th>
            <th>VENDEDOR</th><th class="tc-kg">KG ABR</th>
            <th class="tc-s">SALDO</th><th class="tc-f">OFERTA</th>
            <th class="tc-v">✓</th>
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
    }

    html += makeGlobalSeccion('SIN COMPRA', COLOR_NC, '🔴', nc_all);
    html += makeGlobalSeccion('SIN TOKIN APP', COLOR_ST, '🟠', st_all);
    html += makeGlobalSeccion('BANDEJA SIN COMPRA', COLOR_BD, '🪧', bd_all);
    html += makeGlobalSeccion('FREEZER SIN COMPRA', '#0EA5E9', '🧊', frz_all);
    if(!html) html=`<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">✅ Sin alertas para el ${DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia}.</div>`;
  }

  document.getElementById('tarea-content').innerHTML = html;
  var it=document.getElementById('informe-tarea');
  if(it) it.innerHTML=html;
}

// ── INFORME FREEZER ───────────────────────────────────────────
function buildInformeFreezer(){
  const frz = D.freezer.clients.filter(c=>c.kg26===0);
  const cfg = D.config;
  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'});

  let rows = frz.map((c,i)=>{
    const vname = D.vend_names[c.vend_cod]||c.vend_cod||'—';
    const fKey = 'F_' + i;
    (window._equipoMap = window._equipoMap||{})[fKey] = {
      nombre:c.nombre, kg25:c.kg25, vend_name:vname, tipo:'freezer'
    };
    return `<tr class="tr-p${i%2}">
      <td class="tc-n">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px">
          <span>${c.nombre}</span>
          <button onclick="equipoMsg('${fKey}')"
            style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
            white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0">📱</button>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="tc-c"><span class="flag-pill fp-frz">${c.vend_cod||'—'}</span></td>
      <td class="tc-d">${vname.split(' ')[0]}</td>
      <td class="tc-kg">${c.kg25>0?c.kg25.toFixed(1)+' KG':'—'}</td>

// Helpers que leen del mapa en memoria — evitan problemas de encoding en onclick
function tareaMsg(key){
  const c = (window._tareaMap||{})[key];
  if(!c) return;
  abrirMensajeTarea(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(c)));
}
function equipoMsg(key){
  const c = (window._equipoMap||{})[key];
  if(!c) return;
  abrirMensajeEquipo(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(c)));
}

// ── FUNCIONES DE MENSAJE ─────────────────────────────────────

function abrirMensajeTarea(encoded){
  const c = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encoded));
  let situacion = '';
  if(c.no_compro)
    situacion = 'Notamos que aún no hemos registrado tu pedido en el período actual.';
  else if(c.saldo>0 && c.vencido>0)
    situacion = 'Notamos que tenés un saldo vencido de ' + fmtCC(c.vencido) + ' en tu cuenta.';
  else if(c.sin_tokin)
    situacion = 'Notamos que aún no realizaste pedidos a través de la plataforma Tokin. Tokin es la app de ventas online de Arcor donde podés hacer tus pedidos de manera rápida y conveniente. 🎁 Además, Tokin cuenta con promociones especiales y descuentos únicos disponibles solo para compradores de la app.';
  else
    situacion = 'Queremos mantenerte al día con tu cuenta.';

  const saldoLine = c.saldo>0
    ? '\nTu saldo actual es de ' + fmtCC(c.saldo) + (c.vencido>0 ? ' (vencido: ' + fmtCC(c.vencido) + ').' : '.') + '\n'
    : '';

  const datosPago = c.saldo>0 ? `
─────────────────────────────
Para regularizar tu cuenta:

🏦 Banco: Banco Credicoop
📋 CBU: 1910369755036902475600
🔑 Alias: gol.bebida.tope
👤 Beneficiario: RIM SA
🆔 CUIT: 30-71813048-0

✅ No te olvides de pasarle el comprobante de pago a tu vendedor.` : '';

  const now  = new Date();
  const hora = now.getHours();
  const saludo = hora < 12 ? 'Buenos días' : hora < 20 ? 'Buenas tardes' : 'Buenas noches';

  const msg =
`_Mensaje automático generado por RIM SA_

${saludo}! 👋

Estimado/a ${c.nombre},

${situacion}${saldoLine}${datosPago}

Tu vendedor ${c.vend_name} está disponible para atenderte los días ${(c.dias||[c.dia||"?"]).join(", ")}.

${c.saldo>0 ? 'Para poder continuar recibiendo pedidos es necesario mantener la cuenta al día. El sistema puede suspender automáticamente nuevos pedidos ante saldos impagos. Tu vendedor está disponible para ayudarte a regularizar tu situación.' : 'Recordá que podés coordinar tu pedido directamente con tu vendedor.'}

Muchas gracias por tu confianza y preferencia. Quedamos a tu disposición ante cualquier consulta. 🙏`;

  document.getElementById('msg-modal-text').value = msg;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-name').textContent = c.nombre;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal').style.display = 'flex';
  window._msgCurrent = msg;
}

function abrirMensajeEquipo(encoded){
  const c = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encoded));
  const esFreezer = c.tipo === 'freezer';
  const equipo    = esFreezer ? 'freezer' : 'bandeja exhibidora';
  const emoji     = esFreezer ? '🧊' : '🪧';
  const obj       = esFreezer ? D.freezer.rendimiento_obj + ' KG/mes' : D.bandeja.obj + ' KG/mes';
  const histLine  = c.kg25>0

  const now2  = new Date();

  const msg =
`_Mensaje automático generado por RIM SA_

${saludo2}! 👋

Estimado/a ${c.nombre},

${emoji} Notamos que tu ${equipo} no ha registrado ventas en el período actual (Abril 2026). ${histLine}

El objetivo de rendimiento es de ${obj}.

Tu vendedor ${c.vend_name} puede asesorarte sobre los productos disponibles y ayudarte a aprovechar al máximo tu equipo.

Para poder continuar recibiendo el servicio es importante mantener las ventas activas. Tu vendedor está disponible para coordinar tu próximo pedido.

Muchas gracias por tu confianza y preferencia. Quedamos a tu disposición ante cualquier consulta. 🙏`;

  document.getElementById('msg-modal-text').value = msg;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-name').textContent = c.nombre;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal').style.display = 'flex';
  window._msgCurrent = msg;
}

// ── HELPERS PDF ──────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── TAB 8: OFERTAS INTELIGENTES ──────────────────────────────
const DIV_EMOJI = {GOLOSINAS:'🍬',CHOCOLATES:'🍫',ALIMENTOS:'🥗',HARINAS:'🌾',HELADOS:'🧊'};

// Determina lista de precio del cliente según vendedor y plataforma
function getListaPrecio(vend_cod, es_aass){
  if(es_aass) return '5';
  if(['051','052','057','059','060'].includes(vend_cod)) return '7';
  if(vend_cod==='004') return '5';
  return '8';
}

// Cruza ofertas con el cliente según sus divisiones débiles y situación
function getOfertasCliente(c, vend_cod){
  const OF = D.ofertas;
  const divs = c.divisiones||[];
  const debiles = divs.filter(d=>d.var_pct!=null && d.var_pct < -15).map(d=>d.div);
  const todas   = divs.map(d=>d.div);
  const tieneFreezer = (D.freezer.clients||[]).some(f=>f.cod===c.cod);
  const tieneBandeja = c.bandeja==='CRÍTICO'||c.bandeja==='EN RIESGO';
  const sinTokin     = !c.tiene_tokin;
  const esPlat       = !!c.es_plat;

  // Divisiones relevantes para este cliente
  let divsRel = debiles.length > 0 ? debiles : todas;
  if(tieneFreezer)  divsRel = [...new Set([...divsRel,'HELADOS'])];
  if(tieneBandeja)  divsRel = [...new Set([...divsRel,'GOLOSINAS','CHOCOLATES'])];

  // Infaltables relevantes
  const infalt = OF.infaltables.filter(o=>
    divsRel.includes(o.division) || o.prioridad.includes('⭐')
  ).sort((a,b)=> (b.prioridad.includes('⭐')?1:0)-(a.prioridad.includes('⭐')?1:0));

  // Tokin exclusivos — siempre incluir para sin Tokin, y los de divisiones débiles
  const tokinEx = sinTokin
    ? OF.tokin_exclusivo  // todos como incentivo para bajar la app
    : OF.tokin_exclusivo.filter(o=>divsRel.includes(o.division));

  // Letra D — solo divisiones débiles (para plataforma e importantes)
  const letraD = OF.letra_d.filter(o=>divsRel.includes(o.division))
    .sort((a,b)=>parseFloat(b.desc_pct)-parseFloat(a.desc_pct));

  const lista = getListaPrecio(vend_cod, c.plat_tipo==='AASS SELECT');

  return {infalt, tokinEx, letraD, divsRel, debiles, sinTokin, tieneFreezer, tieneBandeja, lista};
}

// Construye mensaje WA con las ofertas del cliente
function buildOfertaMsg(c, vname, o){
  const hora   = new Date().getHours();
  const saludo = hora<12?'Buenos días':hora<20?'Buenas tardes':'Buenas noches';
  const OF     = D.ofertas;
  let msg = `_Mensaje automático generado por RIM SA_

${saludo}! 👋

Estimado/a ${c.nombre},

`;
  msg += `🎁 Tenemos ofertas especiales para vos este mes:

`;

  if(o.tokinEx.length>0){
    msg += `⚡ COMBOS EXCLUSIVOS TOKIN APP:
`;
    o.tokinEx.forEach(t=>{
      msg += `• ${t.combo} ${t.desc} — Comprando: ${t.comprando}
  👉 Regalo: ${t.regalo}
`;
    });
    if(o.sinTokin) msg += `
🔵 Descargá la app Tokin para acceder a estos combos exclusivos y más promociones especiales 🎁
`;
    msg += `
`;
  }

  // Infaltables agrupados por división
  const byDiv = {};
  o.infalt.slice(0,8).forEach(i=>{
    if(!byDiv[i.division]) byDiv[i.division]=[];
    byDiv[i.division].push(i);
  });
  Object.entries(byDiv).forEach(([div,items])=>{
    msg += `${DIV_EMOJI[div]||'📦'} ${div}:
`;
    items.forEach(i=>msg+=`  • ${i.producto} — ${i.cantidad} × ${i.precio}
`);
    msg += `
`;
  });

  msg += `Consultá con tu vendedor ${vname} para aprovechar estas promociones antes del ${OF.vigencia}.

Muchas gracias por tu preferencia! 🙏`;
  return msg;
}

function ofSetVend(v){
  _ofVend = v;
  document.querySelectorAll('#of-vend-bar .fbtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('ofv-'+v)?.classList.add('active');
  renderOfertas();
}

function renderOfertas(){
  const OF    = D.ofertas;
  const cfg   = D.config;
  const vends = _ofVend==='TODOS' ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort() : [_ofVend];
  _ofMapa = {};
  let html = '';

  // Build flat client list from tasks (all days) or KG VS AA
  // Use kg_div_client via clientes importantes + plataforma + all task clients
  const allClients = {};

  // Collect from tasks (all days)
  vends.forEach(vend=>{
    Object.values(D.tasks[vend]||{}).forEach(dayClients=>{
      dayClients.forEach(c=>{
        if(!allClients[c.cod||c.nombre]){
          allClients[c.cod||c.nombre] = {...c, vend_cod: vend};
        }
      });
    });
  });

  // Also add plataforma and clientes importantes
  (D.plataforma?.clients||[]).forEach(c=>{
    if(!allClients[c.cod]) allClients[c.cod]={...c, vend_cod:c.vend_cod, es_plat:true, plat_tipo:c.tipo};
  });
  Object.values(D.clientes_importantes?.data||{}).forEach(lst=>lst.forEach(c=>{
    if(!allClients[c.cod]) allClients[c.cod]={...c, vend_cod:c.vend_cod, es_imp:true};
  }));

  vends.forEach(vend=>{
    const vname   = D.vend_names[vend]||vend;
    const clients = Object.values(allClients).filter(c=>c.vend_cod===vend);
    if(!clients.length) return;

    // Score clients: sin tokin > división débil > bandeja crítico
    const scored = clients.map(c=>{
      const o = getOfertasCliente(c, vend);
      const score = (o.sinTokin?30:0) + (o.debiles.length*10) + (o.tieneBandeja?15:0) + (o.tieneFreezer?10:0);
      return {c, o, score};
    }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);

    const rows = scored.map((item,i)=>{
      const c = item.c, o = item.o;
      const key = 'OF_'+vend+'_'+i;
      _ofMapa[key] = {c, vend_cod:vend, vname};

      // Priority chips
      let chips = '';
      if(o.sinTokin)      chips += `<span class="flag-pill" style="background:#EEF;color:#003DA5;font-size:8px">🔵 Sin Tokin app</span>`;
      if(o.debiles.length) chips += o.debiles.map(d=>`<span class="flag-pill fp-bd" style="font-size:8px">📉 ${d}</span>`).join('');
      if(o.tieneBandeja)  chips += `<span class="flag-pill fp-bd" style="font-size:8px">🪧 Bandeja</span>`;
      if(o.tieneFreezer)  chips += `<span class="flag-pill" style="background:#E0F2FE;color:#0369A1;font-size:8px">🧊 Freezer</span>`;

      // Summary of offers to show
      const nOfs = o.tokinEx.length + Math.min(o.infalt.length,4);
      const ofSummary = [
        o.tokinEx.length  ? `<span style="color:#006AFF;font-weight:700;font-size:9px">⚡${o.tokinEx.length} Tokin</span>` : '',
        o.infalt.length   ? `<span style="color:#1B7F3A;font-weight:700;font-size:9px">📋${o.infalt.length} Infalt.</span>` : '',
        o.letraD.length   ? `<span style="color:#D97706;font-weight:700;font-size:9px">🏷️${o.letraD.length} Letra D</span>` : '',
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' &nbsp;');

      return `<tr class="exp-row" onclick="ofToggle('${key}')">
        <td class="tl" style="max-width:180px"><b>${c.nombre}</b>
          <div style="margin-top:2px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px">${chips}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="tc"><span class="muted" style="font-size:9px">Lista ${o.lista}</span></td>
        <td class="tc">${ofSummary}</td>
        <td class="tc">
          <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();ofEnviarWA('${key}')"
            style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;
            padding:2px 6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">📱 WA</button>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr class="exp-detail" id="xof-${key}"><td colspan="4"><div class="exp-inner">
        ${renderOfertasCliente(c, o, vend)}
      </div></td></tr>`;
    }).join('');

    html += `<div class="sec" style="margin-bottom:10px">
      <div class="sec-hdr" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between">
        <span><span class="vbadge">${vend}</span><b>${vname}</b>
          <span class="muted" style="font-size:10px;margin-left:6px">${scored.length} clientes</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">
        <thead><tr>
          <th class="tl">Cliente</th>
          <th style="width:70px">Lista</th>
          <th>Ofertas aplicables</th>
          <th style="width:70px">Enviar</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table></div>
    </div>`;
  });

  if(!html) html = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">Sin datos de clientes.</div>';
  document.getElementById('of-content').innerHTML = html;
}

        ${o.sinTokin?'<span style="background:#B91C1C;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:8px;margin-left:6px">⭐ INCENTIVO PARA BAJAR LA APP</span>':''}
      </div>
      ${o.tokinEx.map(t=>`
