          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between">
            <span style="font-weight:800;font-size:11px;color:#003DA5">${t.combo}</span>
            <span style="background:#006AFF;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;
              padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px">${t.desc}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;color:#4A6080;margin-top:4px">
            <b>Comprando:</b> ${t.comprando}
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#1B7F3A;margin-top:3px">
            🎁 Regalo: ${t.regalo}
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:8px;color:#6B7280;margin-top:2px">División: ${DIV_EMOJI[t.division]||''} ${t.division} · Solo pedidos por app Tokin</div>
        </div>
      `).join('')}
    </div>`;
  }

  // ── Infaltables del mes ──
  if(o.infalt.length>0){
    const byDiv = {};
    o.infalt.forEach(inf=>{ if(!byDiv[inf.division]) byDiv[inf.division]=[]; byDiv[inf.division].push(inf); });
    html += `<div style="background:#F0FFF0;border:1px solid #86EFAC;border-radius:8px;
      padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:10px">
      <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#166534;margin-bottom:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px">
        📋 Infaltables del Mes — Sugerido venta al público
      </div>
      ${Object.keys(byDiv).map(function(div){
        const items = byDiv[div];
        return '<div style="margin-bottom:6px">'
          +'<div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#15803D;margin-bottom:3px">'
          +(DIV_EMOJI[div]||'📦')+' '+div+(o.debiles.includes(div)?' <span style="background:#FEF2F2;color:#DC2626;border-radius:3px;padding:0 4px;font-size:8px">📉 div. débil</span>':'')
          +'</div><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px">'
          +items.map(function(inf){
            return '<div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #D1FAD1;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:9px;min-width:130px">'
              +'<div style="font-weight:700;color:#0A1A3A">'+inf.producto+'</div>'
              +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:2px">'
              +'<span style="color:#6B7280">'+inf.cantidad+'</span>'
              +'<span style="color:#1B7F3A;font-weight:800">'+inf.precio+'</span></div>'
              +(inf.obs&&inf.obs!=='Precio unitario'?'<div style="color:#9CA3AF;font-size:8px">'+inf.obs+'</div>':'')
              +'</div>';
          }).join('')
          +'</div></div>';
      }).join('')}
      <div style="font-size:8px;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:4px">Canal: Tokin + ArcorJEV · Lista ${o.lista}</div>
    </div>`;
  }

  // ── Letra D (top 5 por descuento) ──
  if(o.letraD.length>0){
    html += `<div style="background:#FFFBEB;border:1px solid #FCD34D;border-radius:8px;
      padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:6px">
      <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#92400E;margin-bottom:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px">
        🏷️ Letra D — Descuentos sobre precio de lista
      </div>
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:9px">
        <thead><tr style="background:#FEF3C7">
          <th style="text-align:left;padding:3px 5px">Producto</th>
          <th style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center">Div.</th>
          <th style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center">U/B</th>
          <th style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center;color:#D97706">Desc. %</th>
          <th style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:left;font-size:8px">Condición</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${o.letraD.slice(0,8).map(function(ld,ri){
            return '<tr style="background:'+(ri%2?'#fff':'#FFFEF0')+'">'
              +'<td style="padding:3px 5px;font-weight:600">'+ld.producto.substring(0,35)+'</td>'
              +'<td style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center">'+(DIV_EMOJI[ld.division]||'')+'</td>'
              +'<td style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center;color:#6B7280">'+(ld.ub||'—')+'</td>'
              +'<td style="padding:3px 5px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;color:#D97706">'+ld.desc_pct+'</td>'
              +'<td style="padding:3px 5px;font-size:8px;color:#6B7280">'+(ld.tipo==='1+1 sin cargo'?'1+1 sin cargo':(ld.obs?.substring(0,30)||ld.tipo))+'</td>'
              +'</tr>';
          }).join('')}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div style="font-size:8px;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:4px">Canal: Tokin + ArcorJEV · Sobre precio Lista ${o.lista}</div>
    </div>`;
  }

  if(!html) html = '<div style="color:var(--muted);padding:8px;font-size:10px">No hay ofertas específicas para este cliente en el período actual.</div>';
  return html;
}

function ofToggle(key){
  const row = document.getElementById('xof-'+key);
  if(!row) return;
  const open = row.style.display!=='none'&&row.style.display!=='';
  // Close all
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="xof-"]').forEach(r=>r.style.display='none');
  if(!open) row.style.display='table-row';
}

function ofEnviarWA(key){
  const entry = _ofMapa[key];
  if(!entry) return;
  const {c, vend_cod, vname} = entry;
  const o = getOfertasCliente(c, vend_cod);
  // Guardar contexto para que el selector pueda reconstruir el mensaje
  window._ofContext = {c, vend_cod, vname, o};

  // Mostrar y configurar el selector de tipo
  const wrap = document.getElementById('msg-tipo-wrap');
  const sel  = document.getElementById('msg-tipo-sel');
  wrap.style.display = 'block';
  sel.value = 'todas';
  sel.querySelector('[value="tokin"]').disabled  = o.tokinEx.length === 0;
  sel.querySelector('[value="infalt"]').disabled = o.infalt.length  === 0;
  sel.querySelector('[value="letrad"]').disabled = o.letraD.length  === 0;
  sel.querySelector('[value="tokin_cta"]').disabled = !o.sinTokin;

  const msg = buildOfertaMsg(c, vname, o);
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-title').textContent = '🎁 Ofertas — ' + c.nombre.split(' ')[0];
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-text').value  = msg;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-name').textContent = c.nombre;
  document.getElementById('msg-modal').style.display = 'flex';
  window._msgCurrent = msg;
}

// ── SELECTOR DE TIPO DE MENSAJE EN MODAL ─────────────────────
function msgCambiarTipo(){
  const ctx = window._ofContext;
  if(!ctx) return;
  const {c, vname, o} = ctx;
  const tipo = document.getElementById('msg-tipo-sel').value;
  let msg;
  switch(tipo){
    case 'todas':    msg = buildOfertaMsg(c, vname, o);   break;
    case 'tokin':    msg = _buildMsgTokin(c, vname, o);   break;
    case 'infalt':   msg = _buildMsgInfalt(c, vname, o);  break;
    case 'letrad':   msg = _buildMsgLetraD(c, vname, o);  break;
    case 'tokin_cta':msg = _buildMsgTokinCTA(c, vname);   break;
    default:         msg = buildOfertaMsg(c, vname, o);
  }
  document.getElementById('msg-modal-text').value = msg;
  window._msgCurrent = msg;
}

function _saludoHora(){
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  return h<12?'Buenos días':h<20?'Buenas tardes':'Buenas noches';
}

function _buildMsgTokin(c, vname, o){
  if(!o.tokinEx.length) return '(No hay combos Tokin Exclusivos para este cliente.)';
  const OF = D.ofertas;
  let msg = `_Mensaje automático — RIMSA S.A._\n\n${_saludoHora()}! 👋\n\nEstimado/a ${c.nombre},\n\n`;
  msg += `⚡ *COMBOS EXCLUSIVOS TOKIN APP* — vigencia al ${OF.vigencia}\n\n`;
  o.tokinEx.forEach(t=>{
    msg += `• *${t.combo}* ${t.desc}\n  Comprando: ${t.comprando}\n  👉 Regalo: ${t.regalo}\n\n`;
  });
  msg += `Consultá con tu vendedor ${vname} para más detalles.\nMuchas gracias por tu preferencia! 🙏`;
  return msg;
}

function _buildMsgInfalt(c, vname, o){
  if(!o.infalt.length) return '(No hay infaltables aplicables para este cliente.)';
  const OF = D.ofertas;
  let msg = `_Mensaje automático — RIMSA S.A._\n\n${_saludoHora()}! 👋\n\nEstimado/a ${c.nombre},\n\n`;
  msg += `🌟 *PRODUCTOS INFALTABLES* — vigencia al ${OF.vigencia}\n\n`;
  const byDiv = {};
  o.infalt.slice(0,10).forEach(i=>{ if(!byDiv[i.division]) byDiv[i.division]=[]; byDiv[i.division].push(i); });
  Object.entries(byDiv).forEach(([div,items])=>{
    msg += `${DIV_EMOJI[div]||'📦'} *${div}*\n`;
    items.forEach(i=>{ msg += `  • ${i.producto} — ${i.cantidad} × ${i.precio}\n`; });
    msg += '\n';
  });
  msg += `Consultá con tu vendedor ${vname} para más detalles.\nMuchas gracias por tu preferencia! 🙏`;
  return msg;
}

function _buildMsgLetraD(c, vname, o){
  if(!o.letraD.length) return '(No hay ofertas Letra D aplicables para este cliente.)';
  const OF = D.ofertas;
  let msg = `_Mensaje automático — RIMSA S.A._\n\n${_saludoHora()}! 👋\n\nEstimado/a ${c.nombre},\n\n`;
  msg += `🏷️ *OFERTAS LETRA D* sobre Lista ${o.lista} — vigencia al ${OF.vigencia}\n\n`;
  o.letraD.slice(0,12).forEach(ld=>{
    msg += `• ${ld.producto} — *${ld.desc_pct} OFF* (${ld.obs||ld.tipo})\n`;
  });
  msg += `\nConsultá con tu vendedor ${vname} para más detalles.\nMuchas gracias por tu preferencia! 🙏`;
  return msg;
}

function _buildMsgTokinCTA(c, vname){
  let msg = `_Mensaje automático — RIMSA S.A._\n\n${_saludoHora()}! 👋\n\nEstimado/a ${c.nombre},\n\n`;
  msg += `📱 *¡Descargá la app TOKIN y accedé a ofertas exclusivas!*\n\n`;
  msg += `Con Tokin podés:\n✅ Ver y hacer pedidos desde el celular\n✅ Acceder a combos y descuentos exclusivos\n✅ Seguir el estado de tus entregas\n\n`;
  msg += `Consultá con tu vendedor ${vname} para que te ayude a activar tu cuenta.\n\nMuchas gracias por tu preferencia! 🙏`;
  return msg;
}

// También agregar badge de ofertas en la tarea del día
function getOfBadgeCliente(c, vend_cod){
  if(!D.ofertas||!D.ofertas.infaltables?.length) return '';
  const o = getOfertasCliente(c, vend_cod);
  const tot = o.tokinEx.length + o.infalt.length;
  if(!tot) return '';
  const col = o.tokinEx.length>0?'#006AFF':'#1B7F3A';
  return `<span class="flag-pill" style="background:${col}20;color:${col};font-size:8px;border:1px solid ${col}40;cursor:pointer"
    onclick="event.stopPropagation();ofVerCliente('${c.cod||c.nombre}','${vend_cod}')">🎁 ${tot} ofertas</span>`;
}

function ofVerCliente(cod_or_nombre, vend_cod){
  // Switch to ofertas tab and filter by vendor
  showTab('ofertas');
  ofSetVend(vend_cod);
  // Find and open the client row
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#of-content .exp-row');
    rows.forEach(row=>{
      if(row.textContent.includes(cod_or_nombre)||row.querySelector('b')?.textContent.includes(cod_or_nombre)){
        row.click();
        row.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
      }
    });
  }, 300);
}

  const cfg    = D.config;
  const factor = cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab, 1);
  const vends  = (!vfilt||vfilt==='TODOS') ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort() : [vfilt];

                    'JULIO','AGOSTO','SEPTIEMBRE','OCTUBRE','NOVIEMBRE','DICIEMBRE'];
  const cParts = cfg.corte.split('/');
  const mesNum = cParts.length>1?parseInt(cParts[1]):4;
  const MES    = mesNames[mesNum]||'ABRIL';
  const ANO    = cParts.length>2?cParts[2]:'2026';
  const DIA_LABEL = (DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia).toUpperCase();
  const todayStr  = new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'});

  // Set de cods con freezer sin compra
  const frzSinCompraPDF = new Set(
    (D.freezer.clients||[]).filter(c=>c.kg26===0).map(c=>c.cod)
  );

  const base = `<div style="width:760px;background:#fff;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:9px;color:#0A1A3A;padding:0">

      .kpi-val.green{color:#1B7F3A}.kpi-val.orange{color:#D97706}.kpi-val.red{color:#B01020}.kpi-val.blue{color:#003DA5}

      .s-main{font-weight:700;font-size:9px;color:#001F58;margin-right:4px}
      .sbadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-weight:600}
      .sq{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:1px;display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0}
      table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:8.5px;margin-bottom:2px}
      thead tr{background:#2A3F6F;color:#fff}
      th{padding:4px 5px;font-weight:700;font-size:7.5px;text-align:center;
        letter-spacing:.3px;border:1px solid #3A4F7E;white-space:nowrap}
      th.tl{text-align:left}
      tbody tr{border-bottom:1px solid #E5E7EB}
      tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#F8FAFF}
      td{padding:4px 5px;vertical-align:middle;border:1px solid #E5E7EB}
      .pbadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 6px;
        border-radius:3px;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
      .pb-nocomp{background:#FDECEA;color:#B71C1C;border:1px solid #FCA5A5}
      .pb-st    {background:#FFF7ED;color:#C2410C;border:1px solid #FDBA74}
      .pb-bd    {background:#EDE9FE;color:#4C1D95;border:1px solid #C4B5FD}
      .pb-frz   {background:#E0F2FE;color:#0C4A6E;border:1px solid #7DD3FC}
      .pbsq{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:1px;flex-shrink:0}
      .tc{text-align:center}.tr{text-align:right}.tl{text-align:left}
      .vdown{color:#B01020;font-weight:700}.vup{color:#1B7F3A;font-weight:700}
      .kg25{font-size:7.5px;color:#6B7280}.kg26{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#001F58}
      .kg26b{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#B01020}
      .quote{text-align:center;padding:5px 8px;font-style:italic;font-size:8.5px;
        color:#4A6080;border-top:2px solid #FFD100;border-bottom:2px solid #FFD100;margin-top:7px}
      .footer{text-align:center;font-size:7px;color:#9CA3AF;padding:4px 0 2px;margin-top:3px}
      .no-alerts{text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#6B7280;font-size:10px}
    </style>`;

  // ── Por cada vendedor, construimos una página ──
  let pages = '';

  vends.forEach(vend=>{
    const clients = (D.tasks[vend]?.[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia]) || [];
    const vname   = D.vend_names[vend] || vend;
    const vdata   = D.vendors.find(v=>v.cod===vend)||{};
    const fp      = vdata.fiado_pct||0;

    // Filtros de alerta — igual que la vista en pantalla
    const nc_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.no_compro);
    const st_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.sin_tokin && !c.no_compro);
    const bd_list  = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && c.kg26===0 && (c.bandeja==='CR\u00cdTICO'||c.bandeja==='EN RIESGO'));
    const frz_list = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && frzSinCompraPDF.has(c.cod));

    const total_alertas = nc_list.length + st_list.length + bd_list.length + frz_list.length;

    // KPI values para el encabezado
    const venta_proy = (vdata.total||0) * factor;
    const fpCl = fp<=35?'green':fp<=60?'orange':'red';
    const ptCl = (vdata.part_tok||0)>=52?'green':'red';
    const cbCl = (vdata.cob_pct||0)>=90?'green':'red';

    // ── Helper: genera filas de una sección ──
    function makeRows(list, pbg, psq, ptxt){
      return list.map((c,i)=>{
        const kgTxt = c.kg26>0
          ? `<span class="kg26">${c.kg26.toFixed(1)} kg</span>${c.var_kg!=null?' <span class="'+(c.var_kg>=0?'vup':'vdown')+'">'+(c.var_kg>=0?'+':'')+c.var_kg.toFixed(0)+'%</span>':''}`
          : `<span class="kg26b">0 kg</span>`;
        const saldoTxt = c.saldo>0
          ? `<span style="color:${c.vencido>0?'#B01020':'#001F58'};font-weight:700">${fmt(c.saldo)}${c.vencido>0?' ▲':''}</span>`
          : '<span style="color:#9CA3AF">—</span>';
        return `<tr>
          <td style="white-space:nowrap"><span class="pbadge ${pbg}"><span class="pbsq" style="background:${psq}"></span>${ptxt}</span></td>
          <td class="tl" style="font-weight:600">${c.nombre}</td>
          <td class="tc">${c.canal}</td>
          <td class="tc">${kgTxt}</td>
          <td class="tc">${saldoTxt}</td>
          <td style="font-size:7.5px;color:#6B7280">${c.direccion||'—'}</td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // ── Helper: bloque de sección ──
    function makeSecPDF(titulo, hdrCls, list, pbg, psq, ptxt){
      if(!list.length) return '';
      return `<div class="sec-hdr ${hdrCls}">${titulo} · ${list.length} cliente${list.length!==1?'s':''}</div>
      <table>
        <thead><tr>
          <th style="width:14%">TIPO</th>
          <th class="tl" style="width:28%">CLIENTE</th>
          <th style="width:12%">CANAL</th>
          <th style="width:14%">KG ABR</th>
          <th style="width:14%">SALDO</th>
          <th style="width:18%">DIRECCIÓN</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>${makeRows(list, pbg, psq, ptxt)}</tbody>
      </table>`;
    }

    const sectionsHtml =
      makeSecPDF('🔴 SIN COMPRA',         'sec-hdr-nc',  nc_list,  'pb-nocomp', '#B01020', 'SIN COMPRA') +
      makeSecPDF('🟠 SIN TOKIN APP',       'sec-hdr-st',  st_list,  'pb-st',     '#C2410C', 'SIN TOKIN') +
      makeSecPDF('🪧 BANDEJA SIN COMPRA',  'sec-hdr-bd',  bd_list,  'pb-bd',     '#7C3AED', 'BANDEJA') +
      makeSecPDF('🧊 FREEZER SIN COMPRA',  'sec-hdr-frz', frz_list, 'pb-frz',    '#0EA5E9', 'FREEZER');

    const noAlerts = total_alertas===0
      ? `<div class="no-alerts">✅ Sin alertas para este vendedor el ${DIA_LABEL}</div>`
      : '';

    pages += `<div class="page">
      <div class="hdr-main">
        <div class="hdr-sup">ARCOR CONSUMO MASIVO — SAN FRANCISCO · SASTRE</div>
        <div class="hdr-title">⚠ ALERTAS DEL DÍA — ${DIA_LABEL} ${cfg.corte}</div>
        <div class="hdr-vend">${vend} · ${vname}</div>
        <div class="hdr-sub">Mes: ${MES} ${ANO} · Día ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} · Generado: ${todayStr}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hdr-orange"></div>
      <div class="kpi-row">
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">VENTA ACUM.</div>
          <div class="kpi-val blue">${fmt(vdata.total||0)}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj">Acum. mes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">VTA PROYECT.</div>
          <div class="kpi-val blue">${fmt(venta_proy)}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj">Proy. ${cfg.dias_lab} días</div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">COB. TOKIN</div>
          <div class="kpi-val ${(vdata.cob_tok||0)>=75?'green':'red'}">${fmtP(vdata.cob_tok||0)}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj" style="line-height:1.5">
            ${vdata.comp_tok||0}/${vdata.universo_tok||0}<br>
            <span style="color:${Math.max(0,Math.ceil((vdata.universo_tok||0)*0.75)-(vdata.comp_tok||0))>0?'#B01020':'#1a7a4a'}">
              Faltan: ${Math.max(0,Math.ceil((vdata.universo_tok||0)*0.75)-(vdata.comp_tok||0))}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">COB. GLOBAL</div>
          <div class="kpi-val ${cbCl}">${fmtP(vdata.cob_pct||0)}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj" style="line-height:1.5">
            ${vdata.compradores||0}/${vdata.universo||0}<br>
            <span style="color:${((vdata.universo||0)-(vdata.compradores||0))>0?'#B01020':'#1a7a4a'}">
              Faltan: ${Math.max(0,Math.ceil((vdata.universo||0)*0.9)-(vdata.compradores||0))}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">FIADO %</div>
          <div class="kpi-val ${fpCl}">${fmtP(fp)}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj" style="line-height:1.5">
            Lím: ${fmt(vdata.limite_fiado||0)}<br>
            Saldo: ${fmt(vdata.saldo_tot||0)}<br>
            <span style="color:${(vdata.deuda_venc||0)>0?'#B01020':'#6b7280'}">Venc +4d: ${fmt(vdata.deuda_venc||0)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-cell">
          <div class="kpi-head">ALERTAS HOY</div>
          <div class="kpi-val ${total_alertas>0?'red':'green'}">${total_alertas}</div>
          <div class="kpi-obj">del día</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="summary">
        <span class="s-main">Alertas ${DIA_LABEL} · ${vend} ${vname.split('-').pop().trim().split(' ')[0]}</span>
        ${nc_list.length?`<span class="sbadge"><span class="sq" style="background:#B01020"></span>Sin Compra: ${nc_list.length}</span>`:''}
        ${st_list.length?`<span class="sbadge"><span class="sq" style="background:#D97706"></span>Sin Tokin: ${st_list.length}</span>`:''}
        ${bd_list.length?`<span class="sbadge"><span class="sq" style="background:#7C3AED"></span>Bandeja: ${bd_list.length}</span>`:''}
        ${frz_list.length?`<span class="sbadge"><span class="sq" style="background:#0EA5E9"></span>Freezer: ${frz_list.length}</span>`:''}
      </div>
      ${sectionsHtml}${noAlerts}
      <div class="quote">"Cada visita es una oportunidad. Cada oportunidad, un resultado."</div>
      <div class="footer">Arcor Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre · ${DIA_LABEL} ${cfg.corte} · ${vend} ${vname} · ¡Buen día de trabajo!</div>
    </div>`;
  });

  // Si no hay pages (ej. vendedor sin clientes ese día), al menos poner página vacía
  if(!pages) pages = `<div class="page"><div class="no-alerts">Sin clientes asignados para el ${DIA_LABEL}.</div></div>`;

  return base + pages + '</div>';
}


async function _capturarPDF(htmlStr, filename, titulo, btn) {
  // Create hidden container with fixed A4 width
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;width:794px;background:#fff;z-index:-1';
  wrap.innerHTML = htmlStr;
  document.body.appendChild(wrap);

  try {
    const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;

    // Capture each .page element separately (one per A4 page)
    const pages = wrap.querySelectorAll('.page');
    if(!pages.length) throw new Error('Sin páginas');

    const pdf = new jsPDF({ orientation:'p', unit:'mm', format:'a4' });
    const pageW = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();   // 210mm
    const pageH = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();  // 297mm
    const margin = 5; // mm

    for(let i=0; i<pages.length; i++){
      if(i>0) pdf.addPage();
      const canvas = await html2canvas(pages[i], {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
        logging: false,
        width: 780,
      });
      const imgW   = pageW - margin*2;
      const ratio  = imgW / canvas.width;
      const imgH   = canvas.height * ratio;
      // If content taller than page, scale down
      const finalH = Math.min(imgH, pageH - margin*2);
      const finalW = finalH < imgH ? imgW * (finalH/imgH) : imgW;
      const xOff   = (pageW - finalW) / 2;
      pdf.addImage(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92), 'JPEG', xOff, margin, finalW, finalH);
    }

    const pdfBlob = pdf.output('blob');
    const file    = new File([pdfBlob], filename, { type:'application/pdf' });

    if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[file] })){
      await navigator.share({ files:[file], title:'RIMSA · '+titulo, text:titulo+' — Dashboard RIMSA' });
    } else {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);
      const a   = document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url; a.download=filename; a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setTimeout(()=>{
        window.open('https://web.whatsapp.com','_blank');
        mostrarToast('PDF descargado. Adjuntalo en WhatsApp Web.');
      }, 700);
    }
  } finally {
    document.body.removeChild(wrap);
    if(btn){ btn.innerHTML=btn._origTxt||'💬'; btn.disabled=false; }
  }
}

function _generarTareaPDFDirecto(dia, vfilt, dia_label, vname, btn) {
  try {
    const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
    const cfg    = D.config;
    const factor = cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab, 1);
    const vends  = (!vfilt||vfilt==='TODOS') ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort() : [vfilt];
    const frzSin = new Set((D.freezer.clients||[]).filter(c=>c.kg26===0).map(c=>c.cod));

    const pdf = new jsPDF({orientation:'p', unit:'mm', format:'a4'});
    const pW = 210, pH = 297, mg = 8;
    const cW = pW - mg*2;
    let isFirst = true;

    const fmt2 = v => {
      if(v==null||isNaN(v)) return '—';
      if(v>=1000000) return '$'+(v/1000000).toFixed(1)+'M';
      if(v>=1000)    return '$'+(v/1000).toFixed(0)+'K';
      return '$'+Math.round(v);
    };

    vends.forEach(vend => {
      const clients = (D.tasks[vend]?.[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia]) || [];
      const vname_full = D.vend_names[vend] || vend;
      const vdata  = D.vendors.find(v=>v.cod===vend)||{};
      const nc_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.no_compro);
      const st_list  = clients.filter(c=>c.sin_tokin && !c.no_compro);
      const bd_list  = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && c.kg26===0 && (c.bandeja==='CRÍTICO'||c.bandeja==='EN RIESGO'));
      const frz_list = clients.filter(c=>!c.no_compro && frzSin.has(c.cod));
      // No compradores de HELADO con freezer — cruzado con ventas mobiliarios
      const conMap   = window._CONMAP || {};
      const hel_list = clients.filter(c => {
        const cod = String(parseInt(c.cod));
        const con = conMap[cod];
        return con && con.nc_helado === true;
      });
      const total_al = nc_list.length + st_list.length + bd_list.length + frz_list.length + hel_list.length;

      if(!isFirst) pdf.addPage();
      isFirst = false;

      let y = mg;

      // Header
      pdf.setFillColor(0, 31, 88);
      pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 18, 'F');
      pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255);
      pdf.setFontSize(7); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
      pdf.text('ARCOR CONSUMO MASIVO — SAN FRANCISCO · SASTRE', pW/2, y+4, {align:'center'});
      pdf.setFontSize(12); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.text('ALERTAS DEL DÍA — '+dia_label+' '+cfg.corte, pW/2, y+9, {align:'center'});
      pdf.setFontSize(9); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
      pdf.setTextColor(255, 209, 0);
      pdf.text(vend+' · '+vname_full, pW/2, y+14, {align:'center'});
      pdf.setFillColor(255, 140, 0);
      pdf.rect(mg, y+18, cW, 1.5, 'F');
      y += 22;

      // KPIs
      const kpis = [
        {l:'VENTA ACUM.', v:fmt2(vdata.total||0)},
        {l:'VTA PROY.',   v:fmt2((vdata.total||0)*factor)},
        {l:'PART.TOKIN',  v:((vdata.part_tok||0).toFixed(1))+'%'},
        {l:'COB.GLOBAL',  v:((vdata.cob_pct||0).toFixed(1))+'%'},
        {l:'FIADO %',     v:((vdata.fiado_pct||0).toFixed(1))+'%'},
        {l:'ALERTAS',     v:String(total_al)},
      ];
      const kW = cW/kpis.length;
      kpis.forEach((k,i)=>{
        const kx = mg + i*kW;
        pdf.setFillColor(42,63,111);
        pdf.rect(kx, y, kW, 5, 'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255); pdf.setFontSize(6); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
        pdf.text(k.l, kx+kW/2, y+3.5, {align:'center'});
        pdf.setFillColor(255,255,255);
        pdf.rect(kx, y+5, kW, 7, 'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(0,31,88); pdf.setFontSize(9); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
        pdf.text(k.v, kx+kW/2, y+10, {align:'center'});
      });
      y += 14;

      // Función para imprimir una sección
      function imprimirSeccion(titulo, color, lista) {
        if(!lista.length) return;
        // Header sección
        pdf.setFillColor(color[0],color[1],color[2]);
        pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 5, 'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255); pdf.setFontSize(7); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
        pdf.text(titulo+' · '+lista.length+' cliente'+(lista.length!==1?'s':''), mg+2, y+3.5);
        y += 5;
        // Cabecera tabla
        pdf.setFillColor(42,63,111);
        pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 4.5, 'F');
        pdf.setTextColor(255,255,255); pdf.setFontSize(6.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','bold');
        pdf.text('CLIENTE',    mg+2,   y+3);
        pdf.text('CANAL',      mg+75,  y+3);
        pdf.text('KG ABR',     mg+105, y+3);
        pdf.text('SALDO',      mg+130, y+3);
        pdf.text('DIRECCIÓN',  mg+155, y+3);
        y += 4.5;
        lista.forEach((c,i)=>{
          if(y > pH - mg - 6) { pdf.addPage(); y = mg; }
          pdf.setFillColor(i%2===0 ? 255 : 248, i%2===0 ? 255 : 250, i%2===0 ? 255 : 255);
          pdf.rect(mg, y, cW, 5, 'F');
          pdf.setTextColor(10,26,58); pdf.setFontSize(7); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
          const nom = (c.nombre||'').substring(0,32);
          const can = (c.canal||'').substring(0,14);
          const kg  = c.kg26>0 ? c.kg26.toFixed(1)+' kg' : '0 kg';
          const sal = c.saldo>0 ? fmt2(c.saldo) : '—';
          const dir = (c.direccion||'—').substring(0,20);
          pdf.text(nom, mg+2,   y+3.5);
          pdf.text(can, mg+75,  y+3.5);
          pdf.setTextColor(c.kg26>0?0:176, c.kg26>0?31:16, c.kg26>0?88:32);
          pdf.text(kg,  mg+105, y+3.5);
          pdf.setTextColor(c.saldo>0&&c.vencido>0?176:10, c.saldo>0&&c.vencido>0?16:26, c.saldo>0&&c.vencido>0?32:58);
          pdf.text(sal, mg+130, y+3.5);
          pdf.setTextColor(100,110,130);
          pdf.text(dir, mg+155, y+3.5);
          y += 5;
        });
      }

      imprimirSeccion('🔴 SIN COMPRA',        [176,16,32],  nc_list);
      imprimirSeccion('🟠 SIN TOKIN APP',      [217,119,6],  st_list);
      imprimirSeccion('🪧 BANDEJA SIN COMPRA', [124,58,237], bd_list);
      imprimirSeccion('🧊 FREEZER SIN COMPRA', [14,165,233], frz_list);
      imprimirSeccion('🍦 SIN COMPRA HELADOS (con Freezer)', [236,72,153], hel_list);

      if(total_al===0) {
        pdf.setTextColor(100,130,100); pdf.setFontSize(9); pdf.setFont('helvetica','italic');
        pdf.text('✅ Sin alertas para este vendedor el '+dia_label, pW/2, y+10, {align:'center'});
      }

      // Footer
      pdf.setTextColor(150,150,150); pdf.setFontSize(6.5); pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');
      pdf.text('Arcor Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre · '+dia_label+' '+cfg.corte+' · '+vend+' '+vname_full, pW/2, pH-4, {align:'center'});
    });

    const blob = pdf.output('blob');
    const file = new File([blob], 'tarea_'+dia+'_'+vname+'.pdf', {type:'application/pdf'});
    if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
      navigator.share({files:[file], title:'RIMSA · Tarea '+dia_label});
    } else {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url; a.download=file.name; a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setTimeout(()=>{ window.open('https://web.whatsapp.com','_blank'); mostrarToast('PDF descargado. Adjuntalo en WhatsApp.'); }, 700);
    }
  } catch(err) {
    console.error('_generarTareaPDFDirecto:', err);
    mostrarToast('Error al generar PDF: '+err.message);
  } finally {
    if(btn){ btn.innerHTML=btn._origTxt||'💬'; btn.disabled=false; }
  }
}


async function compartirPDF(modo) {
  const btn = event?.target?.closest('button');
  if(btn){ btn._origTxt=btn.innerHTML; btn.innerHTML='⏳'; btn.disabled=true; }

  try {
    if(modo === 'tarea') {
      const dia    = window._tareaDia  || 'lunes';
      const vfilt  = window._tareaVend || 'TODOS';
      const dia_label = (DIAS_LABEL[dia]||dia).toUpperCase();
      const vname  = vfilt==='TODOS' ? 'todos' : (D.vend_names[vfilt]||vfilt).replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'').split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
      // Generar PDF con jsPDF directo (sin html2canvas — no funciona desde file://)
      _generarTareaPDFDirecto(dia, vfilt, dia_label, vname, btn);
      return;

    } else if(modo === 'freezer') {
      buildInformeFreezer();
      const el = document.getElementById('informe-freezer');
      el.style.display='block';
      const canvas = await html2canvas(el, {scale:2,useCORS:true,backgroundColor:'#ffffff',logging:false});
      el.style.display='none';
      await _blobFromCanvas(canvas,'freezer_sin_compra.pdf','Freezer Sin Compra',btn);

    } else if(modo === 'bandeja') {
      buildInformeBandeja();
      const el = document.getElementById('informe-bandeja');
      el.style.display='block';
      const canvas = await html2canvas(el, {scale:2,useCORS:true,backgroundColor:'#ffffff',logging:false});
      el.style.display='none';
      await _blobFromCanvas(canvas,'bandeja_sin_compra.pdf','Bandeja Sin Compra',btn);
    }

  } catch(err) {
    console.error('compartirPDF:',err);
    mostrarToast('Error al generar. Intentá de nuevo.');
  } finally {
    if(btn){ btn.innerHTML=btn._origTxt||'💬'; btn.disabled=false; }
  }
}

// ── GENERAR PDF TAREA — DESCARGA DIRECTA (jsPDF, sin html2canvas) ──────────
function generarTareaPDF() {
  const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
  const dia    = window._tareaDia  || 'lunes';
  const vfilt  = window._tareaVend || 'TODOS';
  const cfg    = D.config;
  const vends  = (vfilt==='TODOS') ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort() : [vfilt];
  const DIAS_L = {lunes:'LUNES',martes:'MARTES',miercoles:'MIÉRCOLES',jueves:'JUEVES',viernes:'VIERNES'};
  const diaLbl = DIAS_L[dia] || dia.toUpperCase();
  const cParts = cfg.corte.split('/');
  const mesNum = cParts.length>1 ? parseInt(cParts[1]) : 4;
  const mesNom = ['','ENE','FEB','MAR','ABR','MAY','JUN','JUL','AGO','SEP','OCT','NOV','DIC'][mesNum]||'ABR';

  const pdf = new jsPDF({orientation:'p', unit:'mm', format:'a4'});
  const PW  = 210; // page width mm
  const PH  = 297;
  const ML  = 8;   // margin left
  const MR  = 8;   // margin right
  const CW  = PW - ML - MR; // content width
  let firstPage = true;

  vends.forEach(vend => {
    const clients = (D.tasks[vend]?.[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia]) || [];
    if (!clients.length) return;

    if (!firstPage) pdf.addPage();
    firstPage = false;

    const vname  = (D.vend_names[vend]||vend).replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'');
    const vdata  = D.vendors.find(v=>v.cod===vend) || {};
    const divs   = vdata.divisiones || [];
    const factor = cfg.dias_lab / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab, 1);

    // ── HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const col  = (r,g,b) => pdf.setTextColor(r,g,b);
    const fill = (r,g,b) => pdf.setFillColor(r,g,b);
    const draw = (r,g,b) => pdf.setDrawColor(r,g,b);
    const fs   = n => pdf.setFontSize(n);
    const fw   = s => pdf.setFont('helvetica', s==='bold'?'bold':'normal');
    const tx   = (t,x,y,opts) => pdf.text(String(t??''),x,y,opts||{});
    const rect = (x,y,w,h,style) => pdf.rect(x,y,w,h,style);
    const line = (x1,y1,x2,y2) => pdf.line(x1,y1,x2,y2);
    const fmtM = n => n==null?'—':'$'+(+n/1e6).toFixed(2)+'M';
    const fmtP = n => n==null?'—':(+n).toFixed(1)+'%';
    const fmtK = n => n==null||n<=0?'0':Math.round(n).toString();
    const clamp= (t,maxW) => {
      while(pdf.getStringUnitWidth(t)*fs_cur/pdf.internal.scaleFactor > maxW && t.length>4)
        t = t.slice(0,-1);
      return t;
    };
    let fs_cur = 9;
    pdf.setFont('helvetica','normal');

    let y = 8;

    // ── 1. HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    fill(0,31,88); rect(ML,y,CW,16,'F');
    fill(255,209,0); rect(ML,y+16,CW,1.5,'F');

    col(255,255,255);
    fw('bold'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
    tx('ARCOR CONSUMO MASIVO — SAN FRANCISCO - SASTRE', PW/2, y+4, {align:'center'});
    fs(13); fs_cur=13;
    tx('■ TAREAS DEL DÍA — ' + diaLbl, PW/2, y+10, {align:'center'});
    fs(9); fs_cur=9;
    tx(vend + ' ' + vname.toUpperCase() + ' • ' + diaLbl + ', ' + cfg.corte, PW/2, y+15, {align:'center'});

    y += 19;

    // ── 2. KPI ROW ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const kpis = [
      ['VENTA ACUMULADA',    fmtM(vdata.total)],
      ['PROYECCIÓN CIERRE',  fmtM((vdata.total||0)*factor)],
      [`% Uso lím. fiado (≤${vdata.obj_fiado}%)`,      fmtP(vdata.fiado_pct)],
      ['PART. TOKIN',        fmtP(vdata.part_tok)],
      ['COB. TOKIN',         fmtP(vdata.cob_tok)],
      ['COB. GLOBAL',        fmtP(vdata.cob_pct)],
    ];
    const kw = CW / kpis.length;
    const kh = 10;
    kpis.forEach((k,i) => {
      const kx = ML + i*kw;
      fill(42,63,111); rect(kx,y,kw,4,'F');
      draw(180,180,200); rect(kx,y,kw,kh,'S');
      col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(5.5); fs_cur=5.5;
      tx(k[0], kx+kw/2, y+3, {align:'center'});
      // Value color
      const val = parseFloat(k[1]);
      if(i===2) col(val<=35?27:val<=60?200:176, val<=35?127:val<=60?100:16, val<=35?58:val<=60?0:32);
      else if(i===3) col(val>=52?27:176, val>=52?127:16, val>=52?58:32);
      else if(i===4) col(val>=68?27:176, val>=68?127:16, val>=68?58:32);
      else if(i===5) col(val>=90?27:176, val>=90?127:16, val>=90?58:32);
      else col(0,45,120);
      fw('bold'); fs(11); fs_cur=11;
      tx(k[1], kx+kw/2, y+8.5, {align:'center'});
    });
    col(80,96,120); fw('normal'); fs(5.5); fs_cur=5.5;
    tx(`${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días trabajados a ${cfg.dias_lab} días laborales`, ML, y+kh+3);
    tx('Obj. fiado ≤35% | Part.Tokin ≥52% | Cob.Tokin ≥68% | Cob.Global ≥90%', ML+CW, y+kh+3, {align:'right'});
    y += kh + 5;

    // ── 3. CLIENT TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────
    fill(30,58,110); rect(ML,y,CW,5,'F');
    col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(7); fs_cur=7;
    const nc_n = clients.filter(c=>c.no_compro).length;
    const st_n = clients.filter(c=>c.sin_tokin&&!c.no_compro).length;
    tx(`■ CLIENTES DEL DÍA — ${diaLbl} (${clients.length} clientes${nc_n?' | '+nc_n+' sin compra':''}${st_n?' | '+st_n+' sin tokin':''})`, ML+2, y+3.5);
    y += 5;

    // Table header
    const cols_c = [
      {lbl:'#',     w:6,  al:'center'},
      {lbl:'CLIENTE', w:60, al:'left'},
      {lbl:'ESTADO',  w:22, al:'center'},
      {lbl:'DEUDA VENC.', w:22, al:'center'},
      {lbl:'VENCIM.', w:16, al:'center'},
      {lbl:'TENDENCIA / INFO', w:CW-6-60-22-22-16, al:'center'},
    ];
    fill(42,63,111); rect(ML,y,CW,4.5,'F');
    let cx = ML;
    cols_c.forEach(c => {
      col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(6); fs_cur=6;
      tx(c.lbl, cx+(c.al==='center'?c.w/2:2), y+3.2, {align:c.al==='left'?'left':'center'});
      cx += c.w;
    });
    y += 4.5;

    // Rows
    const frzRows = (D.freezer.clients||[]).filter(c=>c.kg26===0&&c.vend_cod===vend);
    const allRows = [...clients, ...frzRows.map(c=>{
      const vn = (D.vend_names[c.vend_cod]||'').replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'');
      return {nombre:c.nombre, estado:'FREEZER S/H', saldo:0, vencido:0,
               kg26:0, kg25:c.kg25, var_kg:c.kg25>0?-100:null, _freezer:true};
    })];

    allRows.forEach((c,idx) => {
      const rh = 4;
      if(y + rh > PH - 15) { pdf.addPage(); y = 8; }

      // Row bg
      if(idx%2===0) { fill(248,250,255); rect(ML,y,CW,rh,'F'); }
      else { fill(255,255,255); rect(ML,y,CW,rh,'F'); }

      // Estado label & color
      let estado = '', ec = [100,116,139];
      if(c._freezer)           { estado='FREEZER S/H'; ec=[12,74,110]; }
      else if(c.no_compro)     { estado='NO COMPRÓ'; ec=[176,16,32]; }
      else if(c.es_plat)       { estado='PLATAFORMA'; ec=[76,29,149]; }
      else if(c.es_imp)        { estado='IMPORTANTE'; ec=[113,63,18]; }
      else if(c.sin_tokin)     { estado='SIN TOKIN'; ec=[194,65,12]; }
      else if(c.bandeja)       { estado='BANDEJA'; ec=[12,74,110]; }

      // Deuda vencida
      const dv  = c.vencido>0 ? '$'+(c.vencido/1e3).toFixed(0)+'K' : (c.saldo<0?'NC':'—');
      const dvCl = c.vencido>0?[176,16,32]:(c.saldo<0?[27,127,58]:[156,163,175]);

      // Días vencimiento
      const diasV = c.vencido>0 ? (c.dias_vto!=null?'< '+c.dias_vto+'d':'—') : '—';

      // Tendencia
      let tend = '';
      if(c.var_kg!=null) {
        const k25 = c.kg25>0?fmtK(c.kg25):'0';
        const k26 = c.kg26>0?fmtK(c.kg26):'0';
        tend = k25+'→'+k26+' kg ('+(c.var_kg>=0?'+':'')+c.var_kg.toFixed(0)+'%)';
      }
      if(c._freezer && c.kg25>0) tend = fmtK(c.kg25)+'→0 kg helado';

      draw(220,225,235); rect(ML,y,CW,rh,'S');
      fs(7.5); fs_cur=7.5; fw('normal');
      cx = ML;
      // #
      col(100,116,139); fw('bold');
      tx(String(idx+1), cx+3, y+2.8, {align:'center'}); cx+=cols_c[0].w;
      // Nombre
      col(10,26,58); fw('bold');
      tx(clamp(c.nombre,55), cx+1, y+2.8); cx+=cols_c[1].w;
      // Estado
      col(...ec); fw('bold'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
      tx(estado, cx+cols_c[2].w/2, y+2.8, {align:'center'}); cx+=cols_c[2].w;
      // Deuda
      col(...dvCl); fw('bold'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
      tx(dv, cx+cols_c[3].w/2, y+2.8, {align:'center'}); cx+=cols_c[3].w;
      // Días vto
      col(100,116,139); fw('normal'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
      tx(diasV, cx+cols_c[4].w/2, y+2.8, {align:'center'}); cx+=cols_c[4].w;
      // Tendencia
      const tCl = c.var_kg==null?[156,163,175]:c.var_kg>=0?[27,127,58]:[176,16,32];
      col(...tCl); fw('normal'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
      tx(tend, cx+1, y+2.8);

      y += rh;
    });

    // ── 4. KG DIVISION TABLE ──────────────────────────────────────
    if(divs.length) {
      if(y + 8 + divs.length*4 + 8 > PH - 10) { pdf.addPage(); y = 8; }
      y += 3;
      fill(45,90,45); rect(ML,y,CW,5,'F');
      col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(7); fs_cur=7;
      tx(`■ KG vs AÑO ANTERIOR — POR DIVISIÓN (${mesNom} ${cParts[2]||'2026'} · día ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab})`, ML+2, y+3.5);
      y += 5;

      const cols_d = [
        {lbl:'DIVISIÓN',    w:40, al:'left'},
        {lbl:'KG 2025',     w:22, al:'center'},
        {lbl:'KG 2026',     w:22, al:'center'},
        {lbl:'VAR KG',      w:22, al:'center'},
        {lbl:'VAR %',       w:18, al:'center'},
        {lbl:'PROYECCIÓN',  w:CW-40-22-22-22-18, al:'center'},
      ];
      fill(45,90,45); rect(ML,y,CW,4,'F');
      cx=ML; cols_d.forEach(c=>{
        col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(6); fs_cur=6;
        tx(c.lbl, cx+(c.al==='center'?c.w/2:2), y+2.8, {align:c.al==='left'?'left':'center'});
        cx+=c.w;
      });
      y+=4;

      let kg25tot=0,kg26tot=0;
      divs.forEach((d,i)=>{
        const proy = +(d.kg26*factor).toFixed(0);
        const va   = d.var_pct;
        const gapK = d.kg25>0?Math.round(d.kg25-d.kg26):0;
        kg25tot+=d.kg25; kg26tot+=d.kg26;
        if(i%2===0) { fill(240,255,240); rect(ML,y,CW,4,'F'); }
        else { fill(255,255,255); rect(ML,y,CW,4,'F'); }
        draw(209,250,209); rect(ML,y,CW,4,'S');
        cx=ML; fs(8); fs_cur=8;
        col(10,26,58); fw('bold'); tx('■ '+d.div, cx+2, y+2.8); cx+=cols_d[0].w;
        col(100,116,139); fw('normal'); tx(fmtK(d.kg25), cx+cols_d[1].w/2, y+2.8,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[1].w;
        col(0,45,120); fw('bold'); tx(fmtK(d.kg26), cx+cols_d[2].w/2, y+2.8,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[2].w;
        col(va>=0?27:176, va>=0?127:16, va>=0?58:32); fw('bold');
        tx((gapK>0?'-':'')+fmtK(Math.abs(gapK)), cx+cols_d[3].w/2, y+2.8,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[3].w;
        tx((va>=0?'+':'')+va.toFixed(1)+'%', cx+cols_d[4].w/2, y+2.8,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[4].w;
        col(0,45,120); fw('bold'); tx(fmtK(proy), cx+cols_d[5].w/2, y+2.8,{align:'center'});
        y+=4;
      });
      // Total row
      const kgVar = kg25tot>0?((kg26tot-kg25tot)/kg25tot*100).toFixed(1):null;
      const kgProy= +(kg26tot*factor).toFixed(0);
      fill(26,58,26); rect(ML,y,CW,4.5,'F');
      col(255,255,255); fw('bold'); fs(8); fs_cur=8;
      cx=ML;
      tx('■ TOTAL', cx+2, y+3.2); cx+=cols_d[0].w;
      tx(fmtK(kg25tot), cx+cols_d[1].w/2, y+3.2,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[1].w;
      tx(fmtK(kg26tot), cx+cols_d[2].w/2, y+3.2,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[2].w;
      const gapTot=Math.round(kg25tot-kg26tot);
      tx((gapTot>0?'-':'')+fmtK(Math.abs(gapTot)), cx+cols_d[3].w/2, y+3.2,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[3].w;
      tx(kgVar!=null?kgVar+'%':'—', cx+cols_d[4].w/2, y+3.2,{align:'center'}); cx+=cols_d[4].w;
      tx(fmtK(kgProy), cx+cols_d[5].w/2, y+3.2,{align:'center'});
      y+=4.5;
    }

    // ── 5. FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y += 3;
    fill(255,209,0); rect(ML,y,CW,0.8,'F');
    y += 2.5;
    col(100,116,139); fw('normal'); fs(6.5); fs_cur=6.5;
    tx(`Generado automáticamente el ${diaLbl}, ${cfg.corte} — Arcor Consumo Masivo · San Francisco - Sastre`, PW/2, y, {align:'center'});
  });

  if(firstPage) { mostrarToast('Sin clientes para este día/vendedor.'); return; }

  const filename = `tarea_${dia}_${vfilt==='TODOS'?'todos':vfilt}.pdf`;
  pdf.save(filename);
  mostrarToast('✅ PDF guardado: ' + filename);
}

// ── ENVIAR TAREA POR WHATSAPP (TEXTO) ────────────────────────────
function enviarTareaWA() {
  const dia   = window._tareaDia  || 'lunes';
  const vfilt = window._tareaVend || 'TODOS';
  const cfg   = D.config;

  const DIAS_LABEL_LOCAL = {
    lunes:'LUNES', martes:'MARTES', miercoles:'MIÉRCOLES',
    jueves:'JUEVES', viernes:'VIERNES'
  };
  const diaLabel = DIAS_LABEL_LOCAL[dia] || dia.toUpperCase();

  // Determinar vendedores a incluir
  const vends = (vfilt === 'TODOS')
    ? Object.keys(D.tasks).sort()
    : [vfilt];

  let mensajes = [];

  vends.forEach(vend => {
    const vname    = (D.vend_names[vend] || vend).replace(/^\d+ - /,'');
    const tareas   = (D.tasks[vend] || {})[DIA_KEY[dia]||dia] || [];
    const vdata    = D.vendors.find(v => v.cod === vend) || {};

    if(!tareas.length) return;

    // ── KPIs del mes ──
    const venta    = vdata.total || 0;
    const partTok  = (vdata.part_tok || 0).toFixed(1);
    const cobTok   = (vdata.cob_tok  || 0).toFixed(1);
    const cobGlob  = (vdata.cob_pct  || 0).toFixed(1);
    const fiadoPct = (vdata.fiado_pct || 0).toFixed(1);
    const fiadoObj = vdata.obj_fiado || 35;
    const okTok    = parseFloat(partTok)  >= cfg.obj_part_tokin;
    const okCobT   = parseFloat(cobTok)   >= cfg.obj_cob_tokin;
    const okCobG   = parseFloat(cobGlob)  >= cfg.obj_cob_global;
    const okFiado  = parseFloat(fiadoPct) <= 100;

    // KG divisiones totales del vendedor
    const divs = vdata.divisiones || [];
    const kgLines = divs.map(d => {
      const gap = d.gap_kg > 0 ? ` (-${d.gap_kg.toFixed(0)} KG)` : ' ✅';
      return `  • ${d.div}: ${d.kg26.toFixed(0)} KG vs ${d.kg25.toFixed(0)} AA (${d.var_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.var_pct.toFixed(1)}%)${gap}`;
    }).join('\n');

    // ── Clientes del día ──
    const nc    = tareas.filter(c => c.no_compro);
    const st    = tareas.filter(c => c.sin_tokin && !c.no_compro);
    const plat  = tareas.filter(c => c.es_plat   && !c.no_compro && !c.sin_tokin);
    const imp   = tareas.filter(c => c.es_imp    && !c.no_compro && !c.sin_tokin && !c.es_plat);
    const otros = tareas.filter(c => !c.no_compro && !c.sin_tokin && !c.es_plat && !c.es_imp);

    const fmtClientes = (lista, titulo) => {
      if (!lista.length) return '';
      return `\n${titulo}\n` + lista.map(c => `  → ${c.nombre} (${c.canal})${c.saldo>0?' 💰':''}`).join('\n');
    };

    const hoy = new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR', {day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'});

    const msg =
`━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📋 ACTIVIDAD DEL DÍA — ${diaLabel} ${hoy}
${vend} | ${vname}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📈 AVANCE DEL MES (${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días)
  Venta acum.: ${(venta/1e6).toFixed(2)}M
  Part. Tokin: ${partTok}% ${okTok?'✅':'🔴'} (obj ≥${cfg.obj_part_tokin}%)
  Cob. Tokin:  ${cobTok}% ${okCobT?'✅':'🔴'} (obj ≥${cfg.obj_cob_tokin}%)
  Cob. Global: ${cobGlob}% ${okCobG?'✅':'🔴'} (obj ≥${cfg.obj_cob_global}%)
  Fiado:       ${fiadoPct}% ${okFiado?'✅':'🔴'} (obj ≤${fiadoObj}%)

📦 KG POR DIVISIÓN vs AÑO ANTERIOR
${kgLines || '  (sin datos)'}

🗓️ CLIENTES — ${tareas.length} visitas${fmtClientes(nc,'🔴 SIN COMPRA:')}${fmtClientes(st,'🟠 SIN TOKIN APP:')}${fmtClientes(plat,'🏷️ PLATAFORMA:')}${fmtClientes(imp,'⭐ IMPORTANTES:')}${fmtClientes(otros,'📍 OTROS:')}

¡Buen día de trabajo! 💪
_Dashboard RIMSA · Arcor Consumo Masivo_`;

    mensajes.push(msg);
  });

  if (!mensajes.length) {
    mostrarToast('Sin clientes para este día/vendedor.');
    return;
  }

  const texto = mensajes.join('\n\n' + '═'.repeat(30) + '\n\n');
  window.open('https://wa.me/?text=' + encodeURIComponent(texto), '_blank');
}

async function _blobFromCanvas(canvas, filename, titulo, btn) {
  const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
  const pdf  = new jsPDF({orientation:'p',unit:'mm',format:'a4'});
  const margin = 5;
  const pageW  = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth()-margin*2;
  const pageH  = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight()-margin*2;
  const ratio  = pageW/canvas.width;
  const imgH   = canvas.height*ratio;
  // Paginate
  const slicePx = pageH/ratio;
  let y=0, pg=0;
  while(y<canvas.height){
    if(pg>0) pdf.addPage();
    const h = Math.min(slicePx,canvas.height-y);
    const sc=document.createElement('canvas');
    sc.width=canvas.width; sc.height=h;
    sc.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas,0,-y,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    pdf.addImage(sc.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.92),'JPEG',margin,margin,pageW,h*ratio);
    y+=h; pg++;
  }
  const blob = pdf.output('blob');
  const file = new File([blob],filename,{type:'application/pdf'});
  if(navigator.canShare&&navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
    await navigator.share({files:[file],title:'RIMSA · '+titulo});
  } else {
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url; a.download=filename; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setTimeout(()=>{window.open('https://web.whatsapp.com','_blank');
      mostrarToast('PDF descargado. Adjuntalo en WhatsApp Web.');
    },700);
  }
  if(btn){ btn.innerHTML=btn._origTxt||'💬'; btn.disabled=false; }
}

function mostrarToast(msg) {
  let t = document.getElementById('rimsa-toast');
  if(!t) {
    t = document.createElement('div');
    t.id = 'rimsa-toast';
    t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);' +
      'background:#001F58;color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;' +
      'font-weight:600;z-index:9999;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:opacity .3s;' +
      'max-width:90%;text-align:center';
    document.body.appendChild(t);
  }
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.opacity = '1';
  clearTimeout(t._timer);
  t._timer = setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; }, 4000);
}
function printView(mode){
  _printMode = mode;
  if(mode==='tarea'){
    if(!window._tareaDia){
      var _hoy=DIAS_ES[new Date().getDay()];
      window._tareaDia  = (_hoy in DIAS_LABEL)?_hoy:'lunes';
      window._tareaVend = 'TODOS';
    }
    // Usar la misma función que usa compartirPDF — genera el HTML limpio para imprimir
    buildInformeTarea(window._tareaDia||'lunes', window._tareaVend||'TODOS');
  }
  document.body.dataset.printing = mode;
  window.print();
  setTimeout(function(){ delete document.body.dataset.printing; }, 1000);
}
function buildFiado(){
  const el  = document.getElementById('mod-fiado');
  const FV  = D.fiado_vencido;
  const vends        = Object.keys(FV).sort();
  const total_global = vends.reduce((a,v)=>a+Math.abs(FV[v].total),0);
  const n_global     = vends.reduce((a,v)=>a+FV[v].facturas.length,0);

  const kpis = `<div class="kpi-row">
    <div class="kpi kpi-bad"><div class="kpi-val">${n_global}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Facturas &gt;4d vencidas</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-bad"><div class="kpi-val">${fmtCC(total_global)}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Total vencido</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-blue"><div class="kpi-val">${vends.length}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Vendedores</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-val" style="font-size:14px">${D.config.corte}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Corte</div></div>
  </div>`;

  const fbtn = ['TODOS',...vends].map(v=>
    `<button class="fbtn${v==='TODOS'?' active':''}" id="fv-btn-${v}"
      onclick="fiadoSetVend('${v}')">${v==='TODOS'?'Todos':v+' — '+(FV[v]?.name||v)}</button>`
  ).join('');

  el.innerHTML = kpis
    + `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px">
         <div class="filter-bar" id="fv-filter" style="margin:0">${fbtn}</div>
         <button onclick="fiadoPrint()" class="t-btn t-btn-print" style="margin-left:auto">🖨️ Imprimir PDF</button>
       </div>
       <div id="fv-content"></div>
       <div id="informe-fv" style="display:none"></div>`;

  window._fiadoVendActivo = 'TODOS';
  renderFiado('TODOS');
}

function fiadoSetVend(v){
  window._fiadoVendActivo = v;
  document.querySelectorAll('#fv-filter .fbtn').forEach(b=>
    b.classList.toggle('active', b.id==='fv-btn-'+v));
  renderFiado(v);
}

function fmtCC(n){
  if(n==null) return '—';
  const abs = Math.abs(+n);
  return '$'+abs.toLocaleString('es-AR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
}

function groupByClient(facturas){
  const m={};
  facturas.forEach(f=>{
    if(!m[f.razon]) m[f.razon]={facturas:[],subtotal:0};
    m[f.razon].facturas.push(f);
    m[f.razon].subtotal+=f.saldo;
  });
  return m;
}

function buildFVRows(byClient, forPrint){
  let rows=''; let idx=0;
  Object.keys(byClient).sort().forEach(cli=>{
    const cd=byClient[cli];
    cd.facturas.forEach((f,fi)=>{
      const isFirst=fi===0, isLast=fi===cd.facturas.length-1;
      const isNC = f.saldo < 0;
      const urgCl=isNC?'#15803d':f.dias>30?'#B01020':f.dias>14?'#D97706':'#4A6080';
      const bg=isNC?(idx%2===0?'#f0fdf4':'#dcfce7'):(idx%2===0?'#F8FAFF':'#fff');
      const bdBot=isLast?'border-bottom:2px solid #DBEAFE':'border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2FF';

      // Client cell: name + send button (only on screen, not print)
      let cliCell = '';
      if(isFirst){
        if(!forPrint){
          const safeKey = encodeURIComponent(cli);
          // Buscar cod del cliente en D para el modal de baja
          const _cliEntry = Object.entries(D.fiado_vencido||{}).flatMap(([vc,d])=>
            (d.facturas||[]).filter(f=>f.razon===cli).map(()=>({vc,name:d.name}))
          )[0];
          const _bajaVend = _cliEntry?.vc || '';
          const _bajaVname = (D.vend_names[_bajaVend]||_bajaVend).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
          const _bajaCod = (cli.match(/^\d+/)||[''])[0];
          const _bajaCli  = cli.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
          cliCell = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px">
            <b style="font-size:10px;color:#0A1A3A">${cli}</b>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0">
              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirMensajeCta('${safeKey}')"
                style="background:#003DA5;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;
                padding:3px 8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
                white-space:nowrap" title="Resumen cuenta corriente">💳 Cta. Cte.</button>
              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirMensaje('${safeKey}')"
                style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;
                padding:3px 8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
                white-space:nowrap" title="Comunicado cierre fiado">📢 Cierre fiado</button>
              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();abrirModalBaja('${_bajaCod}','${_bajaCli}','fiado','${_bajaVend}','${_bajaVname}')"
                style="background:#FEE2E2;color:#991B1B;border:1px solid #FECACA;border-radius:5px;
                padding:3px 8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
                white-space:nowrap" title="Dar de baja">🚫</button>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        } else {
          cliCell = `<b style="font-size:8px;color:#0A1A3A">${cli}</b>`;
        }
      }

      rows+=`<tr style="background:${bg};${bdBot}">
        <td style="padding:${forPrint?'3px 8px':'5px 10px'};border-right:2px solid #DBEAFE;
          min-width:${forPrint?'160':'180'}px;vertical-align:top;
          ${isFirst&&!forPrint?'padding-top:7px':''}">${cliCell}</td>
        <td style="padding:${forPrint?'3px 8px':'5px 10px'};text-align:center;
          font-size:${forPrint?'8':'10'}px;color:#4A6080">
          ${isNC?`<span style="background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;margin-right:3px">NC</span>`:''}${f.numero}
        </td>
        <td style="padding:${forPrint?'3px 8px':'5px 10px'};text-align:center;
          font-size:${forPrint?'8':'10'}px;color:#4A6080">${f.fvto}</td>
        <td style="padding:${forPrint?'3px 8px':'5px 10px'};text-align:center;
          font-size:${forPrint?'8':'10'}px;font-weight:700;color:${urgCl}">${isNC?'—':f.dias+'d'}</td>
        <td style="padding:${forPrint?'3px 10px':'5px 12px'};text-align:right;
          font-size:${forPrint?'9':'11'}px;font-weight:600;
          font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;color:${isNC?'#15803d':'inherit'}">${fmtCC(f.saldo)}</td>
      </tr>`;
      if(isLast&&cd.facturas.length>1){
        const ncCount=cd.facturas.filter(x=>x.saldo<0).length;
        const subColor=cd.subtotal<0?'#15803d':'#003DA5';
        rows+=`<tr style="background:#EEF4FF;border-bottom:2px solid #DBEAFE">
          <td style="border:none;padding:2px"></td>
          <td colspan="3" style="padding:${forPrint?'2':'3'}px 8px;font-size:${forPrint?'7':'9'}px;
            color:${subColor};text-align:right;font-weight:600">Subtotal ${cli}${ncCount?` <span style="font-size:8px;background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px">${ncCount} NC</span>`:''}</td>
          <td style="padding:${forPrint?'2':'3'}px 10px;text-align:right;
            font-size:${forPrint?'8':'10'}px;font-weight:800;color:${subColor};
            font-family:'Syne',sans-serif">${fmtCC(cd.subtotal)}</td>
        </tr>`;
      }
      idx++;
    });
  });
  return rows;
}

// Guarda el mapa cli→datos al renderizar para poder recuperarlo al hacer click
window._fvClientMap = {};

function buildClientMap(byClient){
  Object.keys(byClient).forEach(cli=>{
    window._fvClientMap[encodeURIComponent(cli)] = {name:cli, data:byClient[cli]};
  });
}

Te acercamos el resumen de cuenta:

${detalle}
─────────────────────────────

🏦 Banco: Banco Credicoop
📋 CBU: 1910369755036902475600
🔑 Alias: gol.bebida.tope
👤 Beneficiario: RIM SA
🆔 CUIT: 30-71813048-0

✅ No te olvides de pasarle el comprobante de pago a tu vendedor.

Muchas gracias por tu confianza y preferencia. Quedamos a tu disposición ante cualquier consulta. 🙏`;

function cerrarMensaje(){
  document.getElementById('msg-modal').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('msg-tipo-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  window._ofContext = null;
}

function copiarMensaje(){
  const txt = window._msgCurrent || '';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(()=>{
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-copiar');
    btn.textContent = '✅ Copiado!';
    setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = '📋 Copiar'; }, 2000);
  }).catch(()=>{
    document.getElementById('msg-modal-text').select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
  });
}

function enviarWhatsApp(){
  const txt = window._msgCurrent || '';
  window.open('https://wa.me/?text=' + encodeURIComponent(txt), '_blank');
}

// ── TAB 7: NO COMPRADORES ────────────────────────────────────
let _ncTipo = 'sin_tokin';
let _ncVend = 'TODOS';

function buildNoComp(){
  const el  = document.getElementById('mod-nocomp');
  const cfg = D.config;

  // Construir lista general de no compradores desde tasks (c.no_compro === true)
  const NC_GEN = {};
  Object.keys(D.tasks||{}).forEach(vend=>{
    const seen = {};
    const lst = [];
    Object.values(D.tasks[vend]).forEach(dia=>{
      dia.forEach(c=>{
        if (c.no_compro && !seen[c.cod]) { seen[c.cod]=1; lst.push(c); }
      });
    });
    if (lst.length) NC_GEN[vend] = lst;
  });
  window._NC_GENERAL = NC_GEN;

  const totGen = Object.values(NC_GEN).reduce((a,v)=>a+v.length,0);

  // Calcular no compradores de helado con freezer desde concesiones
  const conMap = window._CONMAP || {};
  let NC_HEL = {};
  Object.keys(D.tasks||{}).forEach(vend => {
    const seen = {};
    const lst = [];
    Object.values(D.tasks[vend]).forEach(dia => {
      dia.forEach(c => {
        const cod = String(parseInt(c.cod));
        const con = conMap[cod];
        if (con && con.nc_helado === true && !seen[c.cod]) {
          seen[c.cod] = 1;
          lst.push(Object.assign({}, c, {nom_concesion: con.nom}));
        }
      });
    });
    if (lst.length) NC_HEL[vend] = lst;
  });
  window._NC_HELADO = NC_HEL;
  const totHel = Object.values(NC_HEL).reduce((a,v)=>a+v.length,0);

  const kpis = `<div class="kpi-row">
    <div class="kpi kpi-bad"><div class="kpi-val">${totGen}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Clientes sin compra este mes</div></div>
    <div class="kpi kpi-warn"><div class="kpi-val">${totHel}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">🍦 Sin helado (con freezer)</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-val" style="font-size:14px">${cfg.corte}</div><div class="kpi-lbl">Corte</div></div>
  </div>`;

  el.innerHTML = kpis
    + `<div class="filter-bar" style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <button class="fbtn active" id="nc-btn-general" onclick="ncSetTipoExt('general')">🔴 Sin compra (${totGen})</button>
        <button class="fbtn" id="nc-btn-helado" onclick="ncSetTipoExt('helado')">🍦 Sin helado con freezer (${totHel})</button>
       </div>`
    + `<div id="nc-vend-bar" class="filter-bar" style="margin-bottom:12px"></div>`
    + `<div id="nc-content"></div>`;

  _ncTipo = 'general';
  _ncVend = 'TODOS';
  ncRebuildVendFilter();
  renderNoComp();
}

function ncSetTipo(tipo){
  _ncTipo = tipo;
  _ncVend = 'TODOS';
  document.querySelectorAll('#nc-tipo-bar .fbtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  const map = {'sin_tokin':'nc-tok','sin_bandeja':'nc-bd','sin_helado':'nc-frz'};
  document.getElementById(map[tipo])?.classList.add('active');
  ncRebuildVendFilter();
  renderNoComp();
}

function ncSetVend(v){
  _ncVend = v;
  document.querySelectorAll('#nc-vend-bar .fbtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('ncv-'+v)?.classList.add('active');
  renderNoComp();
}


function ncSetTipoExt(tipo) {
  _ncTipo = tipo;
  _ncVend = 'TODOS';
  document.querySelectorAll('#nc-btn-general,#nc-btn-helado').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); });
  var btn = document.getElementById('nc-btn-'+tipo);
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  ncRebuildVendFilter();
  renderNoComp();
}
function ncRebuildVendFilter(){
  const data  = _ncTipo==='general' ? (window._NC_GENERAL||{}) : _ncTipo==='helado' ? (window._NC_HELADO||{}) : (D.no_compradores[_ncTipo]||{});
  const vends = Object.keys(data).sort();
  const total = vends.reduce((a,v)=>a+(data[v]||[]).length,0);
  const bar   = document.getElementById('nc-vend-bar');
  if(!bar) return;
  let html = `<button class="fbtn active" id="ncv-TODOS" onclick="ncSetVend('TODOS')">Todos (${total})</button>`;
  vends.forEach(vcod=>{
    const n    = (data[vcod]||[]).length;
    const name = (D.vend_names[vcod]||vcod).split(' ')[0];
    html += `<button class="fbtn" id="ncv-${vcod}" onclick="ncSetVend('${vcod}')">${vcod} ${name} (${n})</button>`;
  });
  bar.innerHTML = html;
}

function renderNoComp(){
  const data  = _ncTipo==='general' ? (window._NC_GENERAL||{}) : _ncTipo==='helado' ? (window._NC_HELADO||{}) : (D.no_compradores[_ncTipo]||{});
  const cfg   = D.config;
  const allVends = Object.keys(data).sort();
  const vends    = _ncVend==='TODOS' ? allVends : [_ncVend];

  const tipoLabel = {
    general:    '🔴 Sin compra este mes',
    helado:     '🍦 Sin helado con freezer',
    sin_tokin:  '🟠 Sin Tokin (app)',
    sin_bandeja:'🪧 Sin Compra de Bandeja',
    sin_helado: '🧊 Sin Compra de Freezer',
  }[_ncTipo] || _ncTipo;

  let html = '';

  vends.forEach(vcod=>{
    const lst   = data[vcod]||[];
    if(!lst.length) return;
    const vname = D.vend_names[vcod]||vcod;

    // Build WhatsApp message
    const waMsg    = _buildNoCompMsg(vcod, vname, lst, tipoLabel, cfg);
    const waMsgEnc = encodeURIComponent(waMsg);

    // Register clients in map for individual send button
    window._ncMap = window._ncMap||{};
    lst.forEach((c,i)=>{
      const key = 'NC_'+vcod+'_'+i;
      window._ncMap[key] = {nombre:c.nombre, vend_name:vname, saldo:0, vencido:0, dia:'',
        sin_tokin:(_ncTipo==='sin_tokin'), no_compro:(_ncTipo!=='sin_tokin')};
    });

    // Table rows — sin_tokin: show venta sin tokin for priority context
    const rows = lst.map((c,i)=>{
      const key  = 'NC_'+vcod+'_'+i;
      let extra  = '';
      if(_ncTipo==='sin_tokin'){
        const ventaStr = c.no>0?`<span class="muted" style="font-size:9px">${fmt(c.no)}</span>`:'';
        const platChip = c.plat?`<span class="flag-pill fp-pl" style="font-size:8px">${c.plat}</span>`:'';
        extra = (ventaStr||platChip)?`${ventaStr}&nbsp;${platChip}`:'';
      }
      if(_ncTipo==='sin_bandeja') extra = `<span class="muted" style="font-size:9px">${c.estado||''}</span>`;
      if(_ncTipo==='sin_helado')  extra = c.kg25>0?`<span class="muted" style="font-size:9px">AA: ${c.kg25?.toFixed(1)} KG</span>`:'';
      return `<tr class="tr-p${i%2}">
        <td class="tc-n">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px">
            <span style="flex:1">${c.nombre}${extra?'&nbsp;':''}${extra}</span>
            <button onclick="ncEnviarCliente('${key}')"
              style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;
              padding:2px 5px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0">📱</button>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');

    html += `<div class="sec" style="margin-bottom:10px">
      <div class="sec-hdr" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">
        <span>
          <span class="vbadge">${vcod}</span>
          <b style="font-size:12px">${vname}</b>
          <span class="muted" style="font-size:10px;margin-left:6px">${lst.length} clientes</span>
        </span>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
          <button onclick="ncCopiarVend('${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}')"
            style="background:#003DA5;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;
            padding:5px 12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">
            📋 Copiar lista
          </button>
          <button onclick="window.open('https://wa.me/?text=${waMsgEnc}','_blank')"
            style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;
            padding:5px 12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">
            💬 WhatsApp
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tbl-wrap" style="max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto">
        <table class="tbl">
          <thead><tr>
            <th class="tl">Cliente${_ncTipo==='sin_tokin'?' — clientes sin pedidos por app Tokin (mayor venta primero)':''}</th>
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  });

  if(!html) html='<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">Sin datos.</div>';
  document.getElementById('nc-content').innerHTML = html;
}

function _buildNoCompMsg(vcod, vname, lst, tipoLabel, cfg){
  const now    = new Date();
  const hora   = now.getHours();
  const saludo = hora<12?'Buenos días':hora<20?'Buenas tardes':'Buenas noches';
  const today  = now.toLocaleDateString('es-AR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'});

  let detalle = '';
  lst.forEach((c,i)=>{ detalle += `  ${i+1}. ${c.nombre}\n`; });

  const descr = {
    sin_tokin:   'aún no realizaron pedidos a través de la plataforma Tokin (app de ventas online de Arcor) en el período actual. Recordá que Tokin cuenta con promociones especiales y descuentos únicos exclusivos para compradores de la app 🎁',
    sin_bandeja: 'tienen bandeja exhibidora pero no registraron compras en el período actual',
    sin_helado:  'tienen freezer pero no registraron compras de helado en el período actual',
  }[_ncTipo] || '';

  return `_Mensaje automático generado por RIM SA_

${saludo}! 👋

Resumen de clientes — ${tipoLabel}
Vendedor: ${vcod} ${vname}
Corte: ${cfg.corte} · ${cfg.dias_trab}/${cfg.dias_lab} días trabajados
Generado: ${today}

Los siguientes ${lst.length} clientes ${descr}:

${detalle}
Total: ${lst.length} cliente${lst.length>1?'s':''}.

Por favor coordinar visita o contacto para recuperar estas ventas.`;
}

function ncEnviarCliente(key){
  const c = (window._ncMap||{})[key];
  if(!c) { mostrarToast('No se encontró el cliente. Recargá la lista.'); return; }
  abrirMensajeTarea(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(c)));
}

function ncCopiarVend(encodedMsg){
  const msg = decodeURIComponent(encodedMsg);
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(msg).then(()=>{
    mostrarToast('Lista copiada al portapapeles ✅');
  }).catch(()=>{
    mostrarToast('No se pudo copiar. Intentá desde el celular.');
  });
}

async function jbinGuardar(data) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(SUPA_URL+'/rest/v1/rimsa_data',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':SUPA_KEY,'Authorization':'Bearer '+SUPA_KEY,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
      body:JSON.stringify({id:1,data:data})
    });
    if(res.ok||res.status===201){console.log('✅ Supabase OK');return true;}
  }catch(e){if(location.protocol!=='file:') console.warn('jbinGuardar:',e.message);}
  return false;
}
