async function compartirImagenWA() {
  // Capturar .ficha-pdf (el contenido real, sin recorte del modal)
  const el = document.querySelector('#modal-body .ficha-pdf') || document.getElementById('modal-body');
  if (!el) { toast('⚠️ Nada que compartir', 'error'); return; }
  if (typeof html2canvas === 'undefined') {
    toast('⏳ Cargando herramienta... intentá de nuevo en 2 seg', 'info');
    const sc = document.createElement('script');
    sc.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js';
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
    return;
  }
  toast('📸 Generando imagen...', 'info');
  try {
    // Captura sin límite de altura — el elemento completo
    const canvas = await html2canvas(el, {
      scale: 2,
      useCORS: true,
      allowTaint: true,
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      logging: false,
      windowWidth: 600,
      scrollX: 0,
      scrollY: 0,
      height: el.scrollHeight,
      width: el.scrollWidth
    });
    canvas.toBlob(async function(blob) {
      const file = new File([blob], 'ficha_arcor.png', {type:'image/png'});
      try {
        if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({files:[file]})) {
          await navigator.share({files:[file], title:'Fichas Arcor', text:(config.empresa||'Distribuidora')+' — Arcor'});
          toast('✅ Compartido!','ok');
        } else {
          _descargaImg(canvas);
          toast('💡 Imagen descargada. Adjuntala en WhatsApp.','ok');
        }
      } catch(e) {
        _descargaImg(canvas);
        toast('💡 Imagen guardada. Adjuntala en WhatsApp.','ok');
      }
    }, 'image/png');
  } catch(e) { toast('❌ Error: '+e.message,'error'); }
}
function _descargaImg(canvas) {
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.download = 'ficha_arcor_'+Date.now()+'.png';
  a.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  a.click();
}

function cerrarModal(e) { if (e.target===document.getElementById('modal-pdf')) cerrarModalBtn(); }
function cerrarModalBtn() { document.getElementById('modal-pdf').classList.remove('open'); }

function fm(n) {
  if (!n && n!==0) return '—';
  return parseFloat(n).toLocaleString('es-AR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
}
function toast(msg, tipo='info') {
  const el = document.getElementById('toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.className = 'toast show'+(tipo==='ok'?' ok':'');
  setTimeout(()=>el.className='toast', 3500);
}


// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  RIM S.A. — AUTH SYSTEM (clean, no function overrides)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

window.rimUser = null; // { usuario, nombre, rol, listas[] }

function rimHash(s) {
  // Simple, reliable hash - consistent across all JS engines
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h = (Math.imul(31, h) + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  }
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8,'0') + s.length.toString(16);
}

const RIM_HASH_VERSION = 'v2'; // bump this to force reset on hash change

function rimGetUsers() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('rim_usuarios');
    const ver = localStorage.getItem('rim_hash_ver');
    if (raw && ver === RIM_HASH_VERSION) return JSON.parse(raw);
    // Version mismatch or first run: clear and recreate
    localStorage.removeItem('rim_usuarios');
  } catch(e) {}
  const def = [{
    usuario: 'admin', nombre: 'Administrador',
    passHash: rimHash('admin123'), rol: 'admin',
    listas: ['05','07','08'], activo: true
  }];
  localStorage.setItem('rim_usuarios', JSON.stringify(def));
  localStorage.setItem('rim_hash_ver', RIM_HASH_VERSION);
  return def;
}
function rimSaveUsers(u) {
  localStorage.setItem('rim_usuarios', JSON.stringify(u));
  localStorage.setItem('rim_hash_ver', RIM_HASH_VERSION);
  if(Array.isArray(u)) u.forEach(function(usr){ supaGuardarUsuario(usr); });
}

// ── LOGIN ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function rimDoLogin() {
  const usuario = (document.getElementById('rl-user').value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const pass    = document.getElementById('rl-pass').value||'';
  const errEl   = document.getElementById('rl-err');
  errEl.textContent = '';
  if (!usuario || !pass) { errEl.textContent = '⚠️ Completá usuario y contraseña'; return; }
  const users = rimGetUsers();
  const u = users.find(x => x.usuario.toLowerCase() === usuario);
  if (!u)          { errEl.textContent = '❌ Usuario no encontrado'; return; }
  if (!u.activo)   { errEl.textContent = '❌ Usuario desactivado'; return; }
  if (u.passHash !== rimHash(pass)) { errEl.textContent = '❌ Contraseña incorrecta'; return; }
  window.rimUser = { usuario: u.usuario, nombre: u.nombre, rol: u.rol, listas: u.listas || [] };
  localStorage.setItem('rim_session', JSON.stringify(window.rimUser));
  rimOnLogin();
}

function rimOnLogin() {
  supaRegistrarLog('LOGIN','Acceso al dashboard');
  // Hide login
  const ls = document.getElementById('rim-login');
  if (ls) ls.classList.add('rim-out');
  setTimeout(() => { if (ls) ls.style.display = 'none'; }, 350);

  // Update chip
  const chipNom = document.getElementById('rim-chip-nombre');
  const chipAv  = document.getElementById('rim-chip-avatar');
  if (chipNom) chipNom.textContent = window.rimUser.nombre;
  if (chipAv)  chipAv.textContent  = window.rimUser.nombre.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  // Show/hide admin elements
  if (window.rimUser.rol === 'admin') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.rim-admin').forEach(el => {
      el.style.removeProperty('display');
      el.classList.remove('rim-admin');
      el.classList.add('rim-admin-on');
    });
    document.getElementById('rim-nav-usuarios').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('tab-actualizar').style.display = '';
    const btnG = document.getElementById('btn-modal-guardar');
    if (btnG) btnG.style.removeProperty('display');
  } else {
    // Vendedor: keep admin sections hidden
    document.getElementById('rim-nav-usuarios').style.display = 'none';
    // rim-admin elements stay hidden via CSS class
  }

  // Apply lista restrictions
  rimAplicarListas();

  // Start app
  init();
}

function rimAplicarListas() {
  if (!window.rimUser || window.rimUser.rol === 'admin') return;
  const ok = window.rimUser.listas || [];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lista]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.style.display = ok.includes(btn.dataset.lista) ? '' : 'none';
  });
  if (ok.length > 0) {
    const first = document.querySelector(`[data-lista="${ok[0]}"]`);
    if (first) setLista(ok[0], first);
  }
}

// ── LOGOUT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function rimLogout() {
  if (!confirm('¿Cerrar sesión?')) return;
  localStorage.removeItem('rim_session');
  location.reload();
}

// ── GUARD: call this at start of any admin-only action ────────────
function rimRequireAdmin(accion) {
  if (window.rimUser && window.rimUser.rol === 'admin') return true;
  toast('⛔ Solo el administrador puede ' + (accion||'realizar esta acción'), 'error');
  return false;
}

// ── USERS CRUD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function rimRenderUsers() {
  const users = rimGetUsers();
  const el = document.getElementById('badge-usuarios');
  if (el) el.textContent = users.length;
  const tbody = document.getElementById('tbody-usuarios');
  if (!tbody) return;
  tbody.innerHTML = users.map(u => `
    <tr>
      <td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">${u.usuario}</td>
      <td style="font-weight:600">${u.nombre}</td>
      <td><span style="background:${u.rol==='admin'?'var(--lp-gold-pale)':'var(--lp-blue-pale)'};color:${u.rol==='admin'?'var(--lp-gold-dark)':'var(--lp-blue-mid)'};padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">${u.rol}</span></td>
      <td style="font-size:12px">${(u.listas||[]).map(l=>'L'+l).join(' · ')||'—'}</td>
      <td><span style="background:${u.activo?'#E8F5E9':'#FFEBEE'};color:${u.activo?'#1A7A4A':'#C0392B'};padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">${u.activo?'Activo':'Inactivo'}</span></td>
      <td style="white-space:nowrap;display:flex;gap:4px">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="rimEditUser('${u.usuario}')">✏️</button>
        ${u.usuario!=='admin'?`
          <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="rimToggleUser('${u.usuario}')">${u.activo?'🚫':'✅'}</button>
          <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="rimDeleteUser('${u.usuario}')" style="color:var(--lp-danger)">🗑</button>
        `:''}
      </td>
    </tr>`).join('');
}

function rimEditUser(usuario) {
  const u = rimGetUsers().find(x => x.usuario === usuario);
  if (!u) return;
  document.getElementById('u-user').value  = u.usuario;
  document.getElementById('u-nombre').value= u.nombre;
  document.getElementById('u-pass').value  = '';
  document.getElementById('u-rol').value   = u.rol;
  document.getElementById('u-l05').checked = (u.listas||[]).includes('05');
  document.getElementById('u-l07').checked = (u.listas||[]).includes('07');
  document.getElementById('u-l08').checked = (u.listas||[]).includes('08');
}

function rimGuardarUsuario() {
  if (!rimRequireAdmin('gestionar usuarios')) return;
  const usuario = (document.getElementById('u-user').value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nombre  = (document.getElementById('u-nombre').value||'').trim();
  const pass    = document.getElementById('u-pass').value||'';
  const rol     = document.getElementById('u-rol').value;
  const listas  = ['05','07','08'].filter(l => document.getElementById('u-l'+l).checked);
  if (!usuario || !nombre) { toast('⚠️ Completá usuario y nombre', 'error'); return; }
  if (rol === 'vendedor' && !listas.length) { toast('⚠️ Seleccioná al menos una lista', 'error'); return; }
  const users = rimGetUsers();
  const idx   = users.findIndex(x => x.usuario === usuario);
  if (idx >= 0) {
    users[idx].nombre = nombre; users[idx].rol = rol; users[idx].listas = listas;
    if (pass) users[idx].passHash = rimHash(pass);
  } else {
    if (!pass) { toast('⚠️ Contraseña obligatoria para usuarios nuevos', 'error'); return; }
    users.push({ usuario, nombre, passHash: rimHash(pass), rol, listas, activo: true });
  }
  rimSaveUsers(users);
  rimRenderUsers();
  rimLimpiarForm();
  toast('✅ Usuario guardado', 'ok');
}

function rimToggleUser(usuario) {
  if (!rimRequireAdmin('gestionar usuarios')) return;
  const users = rimGetUsers();
  const u = users.find(x => x.usuario === usuario);
  if (!u) return;
  u.activo = !u.activo;
  rimSaveUsers(users);
  rimRenderUsers();
  toast(u.activo ? '✅ Usuario activado' : '🚫 Usuario desactivado', 'ok');
}

function rimDeleteUser(usuario) {
  if (!rimRequireAdmin('eliminar usuarios')) return;
  if (usuario === 'admin') { toast('No se puede eliminar el admin principal', 'error'); return; }
  if (!confirm('¿Eliminar usuario "' + usuario + '"?')) return;
  rimSaveUsers(rimGetUsers().filter(x => x.usuario !== usuario));
  rimRenderUsers();
  toast('🗑 Usuario eliminado', 'ok');
}

function rimLimpiarForm() {
  ['u-user','u-nombre','u-pass'].forEach(id => { const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.value=''; });
  const rol = document.getElementById('u-rol'); if(rol) rol.value = 'vendedor';
  ['u-l05','u-l07','u-l08'].forEach(id => { const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.checked=false; });
}

function rimCambiarPass() {
  const actual = document.getElementById('rp-actual').value||'';
  const nueva  = document.getElementById('rp-nueva').value||'';
  const conf   = document.getElementById('rp-conf').value||'';
  const users  = rimGetUsers();
  const me = users.find(x => x.usuario === window.rimUser.usuario);
  if (!me) return;
  if (me.passHash !== rimHash(actual)) { toast('❌ Contraseña actual incorrecta', 'error'); return; }
  if (nueva.length < 6) { toast('❌ Mínimo 6 caracteres', 'error'); return; }
  if (nueva !== conf)   { toast('❌ Las contraseñas no coinciden', 'error'); return; }
  me.passHash = rimHash(nueva);
  rimSaveUsers(users);
  ['rp-actual','rp-nueva','rp-conf'].forEach(id => { const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.value=''; });
  toast('✅ Contraseña cambiada', 'ok');
}

// ── Hook showPage to render users table ───────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const origSP = window.showPage;
  if (origSP) {
    window.showPage = function(page, btn) {
      origSP(page, btn);
      if (page === 'usuarios') rimRenderUsers();
    };
  }

  // Intercept admin-only buttons for non-admins
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (window.rimUser && window.rimUser.rol === 'admin') return;
    const btn = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    const blocked = ['imp-file','oferta-file','bk-file'];
    const guardedOnclicks = ['importarExcel','procesarExcel','importarOfertas','guardarModalLog','agregarBonif','exportarBackup','importarBackup'];
    const oc = btn.getAttribute('onclick')||'';
    if (guardedOnclicks.some(fn => oc.includes(fn))) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      toast('⛔ Solo el administrador puede realizar esta acción', 'error');
    }
  }, true);

  // Check existing session
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('rim_session');
    if (saved) {
      window.rimUser = JSON.parse(saved);
      rimOnLogin();
    } else {
      // Mostrar login si no hay sesión
      var rl = document.getElementById('rim-login');
      if (rl) { rl.style.display='flex'; rl.style.zIndex='9999'; }
    }
  } catch(e) { localStorage.removeItem('rim_session'); 
    var rl = document.getElementById('rim-login');
    if (rl) { rl.style.display='flex'; rl.style.zIndex='9999'; }
  }

<script>
function rimShowActualizar(btn) {
  // Ocultar todos los tabs activos
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.remove('active'); });
  if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  // Mostrar overlay
  var o = document.getElementById('overlay-actualizar');
  if(o) o.style.display = 'block';
}
function rimHideActualizar() {
  var o = document.getElementById('overlay-actualizar');
  if(o) o.style.display = 'none';
  // Volver al tab anterior (Desempeño)
  showTab('desemp');
}
</script>

// ── Cargar Materiales/Concesiones desde Excel Maestro ───────────────────
function matHandleFile(file) {
  if (!file) return;
  var res = document.getElementById('mat-resultado');
  if (res) res.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#7c3aed;font-size:12px">⏳ Procesando hojas MATERIALES, segmentacion y ventas mobiliarios...</div>';
  if (!window.XLSX) {
    var sc = document.createElement('script');
    sc.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js';
    sc.onload = function(){ matLeerExcel(file); };
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
    return;
  }
  matLeerExcel(file);
}

function matLeerExcel(file) {
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e) {
    try {
      var wb = XLSX.read(e.target.result, {type:'array'});
      var shSeg = wb.Sheets['segmentacion'];
      var shMat = wb.Sheets['MATERIALES'];
      var shVen = wb.Sheets['ventas mobiliarios'];
      if (!shSeg || !shMat || !shVen) {
        throw new Error('Faltan hojas: se necesitan "segmentacion", "MATERIALES" y "ventas mobiliarios"');
      }

      // ── 1. SEGMENTACIÓN: categoría → tipo ──
      var rowsSeg = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(shSeg, {header:1, defval:''});
      var CAT_TO_TIPO = {};
      var TIPO_COLS = {0:'bandeja', 1:'freezer', 2:'exhibidora_saladix'};
      rowsSeg.slice(4).forEach(function(row) {
        [0,1,2].forEach(function(ci) {
          var val = String(row[ci]||'').trim();
          if (val && val !== 'Total general') CAT_TO_TIPO[val] = TIPO_COLS[ci];
        });
      });

      // ── 2. MATERIALES: cliente → lista de materiales ──
      var DESC_TO_TIPO = {
        'AASS SELECT':'plataforma','CLUB ARCOR':'plataforma','SUPER ALMACEN':'plataforma',
        'BANDEJA 2.0':'bandeja','Bandeja ESTANDAR a Medida (serie)':'bandeja','Bandeja Estandar  (serie)':'bandeja',
        'EXHIBIDOR SALADIX AASS GRANDE':'exhibidora_saladix','EXHIBIDOR SALADIX HORNEADOS':'exhibidora_saladix','EXHIBIDORES SALADIX AASS':'exhibidora_saladix',
        'FREEZER 3 CANASTOS ARCOR':'freezer','FREEZER 4 CANASTOS ARCOR':'freezer','FREEZER 5 CANASTOS ARCOR':'freezer','FREEZER 6 CANASTOS ARCOR':'freezer','FREZER VERTICAL ARCOR':'freezer',
        'GANCHERA MASTI':'ganchera_masti','GANCHERA MOGUL':'ganchera_mogul'
      };
      var rowsMat = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(shMat, {header:1, defval:''});
      var matsPorCliente = {};
      rowsMat.slice(1).forEach(function(row) {
        var desc = String(row[1]||'').trim();
        var clienteRaw = String(row[5]||'').trim();
        if (!desc || !clienteRaw) return;
        var tipo = DESC_TO_TIPO[desc] || 'otro';
        var m = clienteRaw.match(/^(\d+)\s*-\s*(.+)$/);
        if (!m) return;
        var cod = m[1].replace(/^0+/,'') || '0';
        var nom = m[2].trim();
        if (!matsPorCliente[cod]) matsPorCliente[cod] = {nom:nom, loc:row[8]||'', prov:row[9]||'', dir:row[7]||'', mats:[]};
        matsPorCliente[cod].mats.push({desc:desc, tipo:tipo});
      });

      // ── 3. VENTAS MOBILIARIOS (jerárquico) ──
      var rowsVen = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(shVen, {header:1, defval:''});
      var regsPorCliente = {};
      var curCod=null, curDiv=null, curVend=null;
      rowsVen.slice(5).forEach(function(row) {
        var c0 = row[0];
        if (c0===null||c0===undefined||c0==='') return;
        c0 = String(c0).trim();
        if (c0.toLowerCase().indexOf('total')===0) return;

        var mCliente = c0.match(/^(.+?)\s*\((\d+)\)$/);
        var mCategoria = c0.match(/^(\d{4})\s*-\s*(.+)$/);
        var mDivision = c0.match(/^(\d{2})\s*-\s*(.+)$/);
        var mVendedor = c0.match(/^(\d+)\s*-\s*(.+)$/);

        if (mCliente) {
          curCod = mCliente[2].replace(/^0+/,'') || '0';
          curDiv = null; curVend = null;
        } else if (mCategoria) {
          var v25=row[1]||0, kg25=row[2]||0, v26=row[3]||0, kg26=row[4]||0;
          if (!regsPorCliente[curCod]) regsPorCliente[curCod]=[];
          regsPorCliente[curCod].push({cat:c0, division:curDiv, vendedor:curVend, v25:v25,kg25:kg25,v26:v26,kg26:kg26});
        } else if (mDivision && mDivision[1].length===2) {
          curDiv = mDivision[2].trim();
        } else if (mVendedor) {
          curVend = mVendedor[2].trim();
        }
      });

      // ── 4. CRUZAR ──
      var DIV_TO_FIELD = {GOLOSINAS:'gol', CHOCOLATES:'choc', HARINAS:'har', ALIMENTOS:'com', HELADOS:'hel'};
      var CLI = [];
      Object.keys(matsPorCliente).forEach(function(cod) {
        var info = matsPorCliente[cod];
        var regs = regsPorCliente[cod] || [];
        var vendSet = {};
        regs.forEach(function(r){ if(r.vendedor) vendSet[r.vendedor]=1; });
        var vend = Object.keys(vendSet)[0] || '';

        var tiposPresentes = {};
        info.mats.forEach(function(m){
          if (!tiposPresentes[m.tipo]) tiposPresentes[m.tipo]=[];
          tiposPresentes[m.tipo].push(m.desc);
        });

        var matsOut = [];
        var plataformaOut = null;

        Object.keys(tiposPresentes).forEach(function(tipo) {
          if (tipo==='otro') return;
          var descs = tiposPresentes[tipo];
          if (tipo==='plataforma') {
            var tot = {gol25:0,gol26:0,choc25:0,choc26:0,har25:0,har26:0,com25:0,com26:0,total25:0,total26:0};
            regs.forEach(function(r) {
              var field = DIV_TO_FIELD[(r.division||'').toUpperCase()];
              if (field && ['gol','choc','har','com'].indexOf(field)>=0) {
                tot[field+'25'] += r.v25; tot[field+'26'] += r.v26;
              }
              tot.total25 += r.v25; tot.total26 += r.v26;
            });
            var varP = tot.total25>0 ? Math.round((tot.total26-tot.total25)/tot.total25*1000)/10 : null;
            plataformaOut = Object.assign({}, tot, {material:descs[0], var:varP});
            return;
          }
          var v25=0,v26=0,gol25=0,gol26=0,choc25=0,choc26=0;
          regs.forEach(function(r) {
            if (CAT_TO_TIPO[r.cat] !== tipo) return;
            v25+=r.v25; v26+=r.v26;
            var d=(r.division||'').toUpperCase();
            if (d==='GOLOSINAS'){gol25+=r.v25;gol26+=r.v26;}
            else if (d==='CHOCOLATES'){choc25+=r.v25;choc26+=r.v26;}
          });
          var varP = v25>0 ? Math.round((v26-v25)/v25*1000)/10 : null;
          descs.forEach(function(desc) {
            matsOut.push({desc:desc, tipo:tipo, uso:'', v25:Math.round(v25*100)/100, v26:Math.round(v26*100)/100,
              gol25:Math.round(gol25*100)/100, gol26:Math.round(gol26*100)/100,
              choc25:Math.round(choc25*100)/100, choc26:Math.round(choc26*100)/100, var:varP});
          });
        });

        // Calcular venta de helados (para detectar no compradores con freezer)
        var CAT_FREEZER = {'0120 - HELADOS IMPULSO':1, '0159 - FRUTAS CON CHOCOLATE':1, '0165 - HELADOS HOGAR':1};
        var v26_helado = 0;
        regs.forEach(function(r){ if (CAT_FREEZER[r.cat]) v26_helado += (r.v26||0); });

        var entry = {cod:cod, nom:info.nom, loc:info.loc, prov:info.prov, vend:vend, mats:matsOut, v26_helado:Math.round(v26_helado*100)/100};
        if (plataformaOut) entry.plataforma = plataformaOut;
        CLI.push(entry);
      });

      var PLAT = [];
      CLI.forEach(function(c) {
        if (c.plataforma) {
          var p = Object.assign({}, c.plataforma, {cod:c.cod, nombre:c.nom, localidad:c.loc});
          PLAT.push(p);
        }
      });

      // ── 5. Guardar en memoria + Supabase ──
      window._CONCESIONES = CLI;
      window._CONMAP = {};
      CLI.forEach(function(c){ window._CONMAP[String(parseInt(c.cod))] = c; });
      window._PLATDET = PLAT;

      fetch(SUPA_URL+'/rest/v1/rimsa_data', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':SUPA_KEY,'Authorization':'Bearer '+SUPA_KEY,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
        body: JSON.stringify({id:2, data:{concesiones:CLI, plataforma_detalle:PLAT}})
      }).then(function(r){
        var res = document.getElementById('mat-resultado');
        if (res) res.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#f5f3ff;border:1px solid #c4b5fd;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#5b21b6;font-size:13px;font-weight:600">'
          + '✅ Materiales actualizados: <b>'+CLI.length+' clientes</b> con materiales, <b>'+PLAT.length+' con plataforma</b>.'
          + '</div>';
        mostrarToast('✅ Materiales: '+CLI.length+' clientes actualizados', 'ok');
        // refrescar vista si está en esa pestaña
        if (typeof buildMatDash === 'function') buildMatDash();
        if (typeof _cuCache !== 'undefined') _cuCache = null; // invalidar cache de Clientes
      }).catch(function(err){
        var res = document.getElementById('mat-resultado');
        if (res) res.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#991b1b;font-size:13px">⚠️ Datos cargados localmente pero no se pudo sincronizar con Supabase: '+err.message+'</div>';
      });

    } catch(err) {
      var res = document.getElementById('mat-resultado');
      if (res) res.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#991b1b;font-size:13px">❌ Error: '+err.message+'</div>';
    }
  };
  reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
}



// ── Pestaña Materiales — réplica completa de ConcesionPro ───────────────
var TL_MAT = {bandeja:"Bandeja", freezer:"Freezer", exhibidora_saladix:"Exhibidor Saladix", ganchera_masti:"Ganchera Masti", ganchera_mogul:"Ganchera Mogul"};
var _matSubTab = 'lista';
var _matRankTab = 'bandeja';
var _matChartTop = null;
var _matChartRub = null;

function _matPlatLabel(m) {
  m = m || '';
  if (m.indexOf('AASS')>=0 || m.indexOf('SELECT')>=0) return 'AASS Select';
  if (m.indexOf('CLUB')>=0) return 'Club Arcor';
  if (m.indexOf('MUEBLE')>=0) return 'Mueble Grande';
  return m;
}
function _matFmtV(v) {
  if ((!v && v !== 0) || isNaN(v)) return '<span style="color:#9ca3af">--</span>';
  var cl = v >= 0 ? '#1a7a4a' : '#B01020';
  return '<span style="color:'+cl+';font-weight:600">'+(v>=0?'+':'')+v.toFixed(1)+'%</span>';
}
function _matFmt(n) {
  if (!n) return '--';
  return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('es-AR');
}
function _matIni(nom) {
  var p = (nom||'').trim().split(/\s+/);
  return ((p[0]||'')[0]||'') + ((p[1]||'')[0]||'');
}

function buildMatDash() {
  var con  = window._CONCESIONES || [];
  var wrap = document.getElementById('mod-matdash');
  if (!wrap) return;

  if (!con.length) {
    wrap.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:60px;color:#999">'
      + '<div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:10px">📦</div>'
      + 'No hay datos de materiales cargados todavía.'
      + '</div>';
    return;
  }

  var totalMats = 0;
  con.forEach(function(c){ (c.mats||[]).forEach(function(m){ if(m.tipo!=='otro') totalMats++; }); });
  totalMats += (window._PLATDET||[]).length;

  wrap.innerHTML = '<div style="margin-bottom:10px">'
    + '<div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1A3A6B">📦 Materiales en concesión</div>'
    + '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280">'+totalMats+' materiales asignados</div>'
    + '</div>'
    + '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;border-bottom:2px solid #e5e7eb">'
      + _matSubBtn('lista', '📋 Lista')
      + _matSubBtn('ranking', '🏆 Ranking')
      + _matSubBtn('graficos', '📊 Gráficos')
    + '</div>'
    + '<div id="matdash-content"></div>';

  _matRenderSubTab();
}

function _matSubBtn(tab, label) {
  var active = _matSubTab === tab;
  return '<button onclick="_matSetSubTab(\''+tab+'\')" style="background:none;border:none;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:'+(active?'700':'500')+';'
    + 'color:'+(active?'#1A3A6B':'#6b7280')+';border-bottom:2px solid '+(active?'#1A3A6B':'transparent')+';margin-bottom:-2px;cursor:pointer">'+label+'</button>';
}

function _matSetSubTab(tab) {
  _matSubTab = tab;
  buildMatDash();
}

function _matRenderSubTab() {
  if (_matSubTab === 'lista')    _matRenderLista();
  if (_matSubTab === 'ranking')  _matRenderRanking();
  if (_matSubTab === 'graficos') _matRenderGraficos();
}

    + '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px">'
      + '<div id="mat-count" style="font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af"></div>'
      + '<button onclick="enviarMaterialesWA()" style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">💬 Enviar informe</button>'
    + '</div>';
  filtrarMat();
}

function filtrarMat() {
  var con  = window._CONCESIONES || [];
  var plat = window._PLATDET || [];
  var q = ((document.getElementById('q-mat')||{}).value || '').toLowerCase();
  var tipo = (document.getElementById('f-mat-tipo')||{}).value || '';
  var rows = [];

  if (tipo === 'plataforma' || !tipo) {
    plat.forEach(function(p) {
      var nom = (p.nombre||'').toLowerCase();
      var mat = (p.material||'').toLowerCase();
      if (q && nom.indexOf(q) < 0 && mat.indexOf(q) < 0) return;
      rows.push({desc: _matPlatLabel(p.material), nom: p.nombre, loc: p.localidad||'', vend:'', v26:p.total26, v25:p.total25, varp:p.var});
    });
  }
  if (tipo !== 'plataforma') {
    con.forEach(function(c) {
      (c.mats||[]).forEach(function(m) {
        if (m.tipo === 'otro') return;
        if (tipo && m.tipo !== tipo) return;
        var nom = (c.nom||'').toLowerCase();
        var desc = (m.desc||'').toLowerCase();
        if (q && nom.indexOf(q) < 0 && desc.indexOf(q) < 0) return;
        var vname = (c.vend||'').replace(/^\d+\s*-?\s*/,'').trim();
        rows.push({desc: m.desc, nom: c.nom, loc: c.loc||'', vend: vname, v26:m.v26, v25:m.v25, varp:m.var});
      });
    });
  }
  rows.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.v26||0) - (a.v26||0); });
  var total = rows.length;
  rows = rows.slice(0, 200);
  var html = rows.map(function(r) {
    return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f0f4ff">'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;font-size:11px">'+(r.desc||'')+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500">'+(r.nom||'')+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">'+(r.loc||'')+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">'+(r.vend||'')+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;text-align:right;font-weight:600">'+_matFmt(r.v26)+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;text-align:right;color:#6b7280">'+_matFmt(r.v25)+'</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:7px 8px;text-align:right">'+_matFmtV(r.varp)+'</td>'
      + '</tr>';
  }).join('');
  var tbody = document.getElementById('mat-tbody');
  if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html || '<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#999">Sin resultados</td></tr>';
  var cnt = document.getElementById('mat-count');
  if (cnt) cnt.textContent = 'Mostrando ' + rows.length + ' de ' + total + ' materiales';
}

// ════════════════ RANKING ════════════════
function _matRenderRanking() {
  var el = document.getElementById('matdash-content');
  if (!el) return;
  var tabs = [['bandeja','Bandeja total'],['chocolates','Chocolates'],['golosinas','Golosinas'],['plataforma','Plataforma'],['freezer','Freezer']];
  el.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px">'
    + tabs.map(function(t){
        var active = _matRankTab === t[0];
        return '<button onclick="_matSetRankTab(\''+t[0]+'\')" style="background:'+(active?'#1A3A6B':'#f3f4f6')+';color:'+(active?'#fff':'#374151')+';border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer">'+t[1]+'</button>';
      }).join('')
    + '</div>'
    + '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:14px" id="rank-content"></div>'
    + '<div style="text-align:right;margin-top:10px">'
      + '<button onclick="enviarRankingMatWA()" style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer">💬 Enviar ranking</button>'
    + '</div>';
  _matRenderRankContent();
}

function _matSetRankTab(tab) { _matRankTab = tab; _matRenderRanking(); }

function _matComputeRank(tab) {
  var con  = window._CONCESIONES || [];
  var plat = window._PLATDET || [];
  var sc = [];
  if (tab === 'plataforma') {
    plat.forEach(function(p){ sc.push({nom:p.nombre, loc:p.localidad||'', val:p.total26, sub:_matPlatLabel(p.material)}); });
  } else {
    con.forEach(function(c) {
      var val = 0;
      if (tab==='bandeja')    (c.mats||[]).filter(function(m){return m.tipo==='bandeja';}).forEach(function(b){ val += (b.v26||0); });
      else if (tab==='chocolates') (c.mats||[]).filter(function(m){return m.tipo==='bandeja';}).forEach(function(b){ val += (b.choc26||0); });
      else if (tab==='golosinas')  (c.mats||[]).filter(function(m){return m.tipo==='bandeja';}).forEach(function(b){ val += (b.gol26||0); });
      else if (tab==='freezer')    (c.mats||[]).filter(function(m){return m.tipo==='freezer';}).forEach(function(b){ val += (b.v26||0); });
      if (val > 0) sc.push({nom:c.nom, loc:c.loc||'', val:val, sub:(c.vend||'').replace(/^\d+\s*-?\s*/,'').trim()});
    });
  }
  sc.sort(function(a,b){ return b.val - a.val; });
  return sc;
}

function _matRenderRankContent() {
  var sc = _matComputeRank(_matRankTab);
  var max = sc[0] ? sc[0].val : 1;
  var html = sc.slice(0, 30).map(function(item, i) {
    var medal = i===0?'🥇':i===1?'🥈':i===2?'🥉':(i+1)+'.';
    var pct = Math.round((item.val/max)*100);
    return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f4ff">'
      + '<div style="width:28px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;color:#1A3A6B">'+medal+'</div>'
      + '<div style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#e0e7ff;color:#1A3A6B;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700">'+_matIni(item.nom)+'</div>'
      + '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0">'
        + '<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+item.nom+'</div>'
        + '<div style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">'+item.loc+' · '+item.sub+'</div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div style="width:100px;background:#f0f4ff;border-radius:4px;height:6px;overflow:hidden"><div style="background:#1A3A6B;height:100%;width:'+pct+'%"></div></div>'
      + '<div style="min-width:90px;text-align:right;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#1A3A6B">'+_matFmt(item.val)+'</div>'
      + '</div>';
  }).join('');
  var rc = document.getElementById('rank-content');
  if (rc) rc.innerHTML = html || '<div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#999">Sin datos</div>';
}

// ════════════════ GRÁFICOS ════════════════
function _matRenderGraficos() {
  var el = document.getElementById('matdash-content');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px">'
    + '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb">'
      + '<div style="font-weight:700;color:#1A3A6B;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px">🏆 Top 10 clientes — Bandeja (actual)</div>'
      + '<div style="position:relative;height:280px"><canvas id="matChartTop"></canvas></div>'
    + '</div>'
    + '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb">'
      + '<div style="font-weight:700;color:#1A3A6B;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px">🏷️ Plataforma — distribución por rubro</div>'
      + '<div style="position:relative;height:280px"><canvas id="matChartRub"></canvas></div>'
    + '</div>'
  + '</div>';

  setTimeout(function(){
    if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

    // Top 10 clientes bandeja
    var topData = _matComputeRank('bandeja').slice(0, 10);
    var ctx1 = document.getElementById('matChartTop');
    if (ctx1) {
      if (_matChartTop) _matChartTop.destroy();
      _matChartTop = new Chart(ctx1, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: topData.map(function(t){ return t.nom.split(' ').slice(0,2).join(' '); }),
          datasets: [{ label: 'Bandeja $', data: topData.map(function(t){ return t.val; }), backgroundColor: '#166534', borderRadius: 4 }]
        },
        options: { indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins:{legend:{display:false}}, scales:{x:{beginAtZero:true}} }
      });
    }

    // Plataforma por rubro
    var plat = window._PLATDET || [];
    var rub = {gol:0, choc:0, har:0, com:0};
    plat.forEach(function(p){ rub.gol+=p.gol26||0; rub.choc+=p.choc26||0; rub.har+=p.har26||0; rub.com+=p.com26||0; });
    var ctx2 = document.getElementById('matChartRub');
    if (ctx2) {
      if (_matChartRub) _matChartRub.destroy();
      _matChartRub = new Chart(ctx2, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: ['Golosinas','Chocolates','Harinas','Comestibles'],
          datasets: [{ data: [rub.gol, rub.choc, rub.har, rub.com], backgroundColor: ['#FFD100','#7c3aed','#0369a1','#166534'] }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins:{legend:{position:'bottom',labels:{font:{size:10}}}} }
      });
    }
  }, 60);
}

// ════════════════ ENVÍO POR WHATSAPP (PDF) ════════════════
async function enviarMaterialesWA() {
  if (typeof window.jspdf === 'undefined' && typeof jsPDF === 'undefined') {
    mostrarToast('⏳ Cargando generador de PDF...', 'info');
    return;
  }
  try {
    var jsPDFlib = (window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF) || window.jsPDF;
    var doc = new jsPDFlib({unit:'mm', format:'a4'});
    var rows = [];
    var con = window._CONCESIONES || [];
    var plat = window._PLATDET || [];
    con.forEach(function(c){
      (c.mats||[]).forEach(function(m){
        if (m.tipo==='otro') return;
        rows.push([m.desc||'', c.nom||'', c.loc||'', (c.vend||'').replace(/^\d+\s*-?\s*/,'').trim(), _matFmt(m.v26).replace('$',''), m.var!=null?(m.var>=0?'+':'')+m.var.toFixed(1)+'%':'--']);
      });
    });
    plat.forEach(function(p){
      rows.push([_matPlatLabel(p.material), p.nombre, p.localidad||'', '', _matFmt(p.total26).replace('$',''), p.var!=null?(p.var>=0?'+':'')+p.var.toFixed(1)+'%':'--']);
    });
    rows.sort(function(a,b){ return parseFloat((b[4]||'0').replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.')) - parseFloat((a[4]||'0').replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.')); });

    doc.setFontSize(14); doc.setTextColor(26,58,107);
    doc.text('RIMSA — Informe de Materiales en Concesión', 14, 15);
    doc.setFontSize(9); doc.setTextColor(100);
    doc.text(rows.length + ' materiales · ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR'), 14, 21);

    if (doc.autoTable) {
      doc.autoTable({
        startY: 26,
        head: [['Material','Cliente','Localidad','Vendedor','Actual $','Var%']],
        body: rows.slice(0, 80),
        styles: {fontSize:7, cellPadding:2},
        headStyles: {fillColor:[26,58,107]}
      });
    }

    var blob = doc.output('blob');
    var file = new File([blob], 'materiales_rimsa.pdf', {type:'application/pdf'});
    if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({files:[file]})) {
      await navigator.share({files:[file], title:'Informe de Materiales'});
    } else {
      doc.save('materiales_rimsa.pdf');
      mostrarToast('💡 PDF descargado. Adjuntalo en WhatsApp.', 'ok');
    }
  } catch(e) { mostrarToast('❌ Error: '+e.message, 'error'); }
}

async function enviarRankingMatWA() {
  var labels = {bandeja:'Bandeja total', chocolates:'Chocolates', golosinas:'Golosinas', plataforma:'Plataforma', freezer:'Freezer'};
  var sc = _matComputeRank(_matRankTab).slice(0, 20);
  var texto = '*RIMSA — Ranking de ' + labels[_matRankTab] + '*\n\n';
  sc.forEach(function(item, i) {
    var medal = i===0?'🥇':i===1?'🥈':i===2?'🥉':(i+1)+'.';
    texto += medal + ' ' + item.nom + ' — ' + _matFmt(item.val) + '\n';
  });
  texto += '\n_RIMSA · ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-AR') + '_';
  if (navigator.share) {
    try { await navigator.share({title:'Ranking '+labels[_matRankTab], text:texto}); } catch(e){}
  } else {
    window.open('https://wa.me/?text=' + encodeURIComponent(texto), '_blank');
  }
}





// ── Ranking de clientes por KG 2026 ──────────────────────────────────────
function abrirRankingClientes(codVend) {
  var todos = {};
  var tasks = D.tasks || {};

  Object.keys(tasks).forEach(function(vend) {
    if (codVend && vend !== codVend) return;
    Object.values(tasks[vend]).forEach(function(lista) {
      lista.forEach(function(c) {
        var key = c.cod;
        if (!todos[key]) {
          todos[key] = {
            cod: c.cod,
            nombre: c.nombre || '',
            canal: c.canal || '',
            kg25: 0, kg26: 0,
            vend: vend,
            vend_nombre: (D.vend_names && D.vend_names[vend]) || vend
          };
        }
        todos[key].kg25 += (c.kg25 || 0);
        todos[key].kg26 += (c.kg26 || 0);
      });
    });
  });

  var lista = Object.values(todos)
    .filter(function(c){ return c.kg26 > 0; })
    .sort(function(a,b){ return b.kg26 - a.kg26; })
    .slice(0, 50);

  var titulo = codVend
    ? 'Top 50 Clientes — ' + ((D.vend_names && D.vend_names[codVend]) || codVend).replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'')
    : 'Top 50 Clientes — Global';

  var rows = lista.map(function(c, i) {
    var var_kg = c.kg25 > 0 ? ((c.kg26 - c.kg25) / c.kg25 * 100).toFixed(1) : null;
    var varColor = var_kg === null ? '#999' : (parseFloat(var_kg) >= 0 ? '#1a7a4a' : '#B01020');
    var varTxt = var_kg === null ? '—' : (parseFloat(var_kg) >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼') + Math.abs(var_kg) + '%';
    var medal = i === 0 ? '🥇' : i === 1 ? '🥈' : i === 2 ? '🥉' : (i+1)+'.';
    return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f0f4ff;' + (i%2===0?'background:#fff':'background:#f8faff') + '">'
      + '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-weight:700;color:#1A3A6B;text-align:center">' + medal + '</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px">' + c.nombre + '</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">' + c.canal + '</td>'
      + (!codVend ? '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">' + (c.vend_nombre||'').replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'').split(' ')[0] + '</td>' : '')
      + '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-weight:700;text-align:right">' + Math.round(c.kg26).toLocaleString('es-AR') + ' kg</td>'
      + '<td style="padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px;text-align:right;color:' + varColor + '">' + varTxt + '</td>'
      + '</tr>';
  }).join('');

  var thVend = !codVend ? '<th style="padding:8px;text-align:left">Vendedor</th>' : '';

  var html = '<div style="padding:16px">'
    + '<h3 style="margin:0 0 12px;color:#1A3A6B;font-size:15px">🏆 ' + titulo + '</h3>'
    + '<div style="overflow-x:auto">'
    + '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px">'
    + '<thead><tr style="background:#1A3A6B;color:#fff">'
    + '<th style="padding:8px;width:40px">#</th>'
    + '<th style="padding:8px;text-align:left">Cliente</th>'
    + '<th style="padding:8px;text-align:left">Canal</th>'
    + thVend
    + '<th style="padding:8px;text-align:right">KG 2026</th>'
    + '<th style="padding:8px;text-align:right">vs AA</th>'
    + '</tr></thead>'
    + '<tbody>' + rows + '</tbody>'
    + '</table></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;color:#999;text-align:right">'
    + lista.length + ' clientes con compra · ordenados por KG acumulado</div>'
    + '</div>';

  var modal = document.getElementById('modal-ranking');
  if (!modal) {
    modal = document.createElement('div');
    modal.id = 'modal-ranking';
    modal.style.cssText = 'display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:16px;overflow-y:auto';
    modal.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:12px;width:100%;max-width:700px;margin:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(15,25,60,.4)">'
      + '<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A3A6B,#2155A3);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">'
      + '<span style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px">Ranking de Clientes</span>'
      + '<button onclick="document.getElementById(\'modal-ranking\').style.display=\'none\'" style="background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer">✕</button>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div id="modal-ranking-body"></div>'
      + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(modal);
    modal.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===modal) modal.style.display='none'; });
  }
  document.getElementById('modal-ranking-body').innerHTML = html;
  modal.style.display = 'flex';
}



// ── CLIENTES UNIFICADOS v4 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
var _cuCache = null;
var _cuFiltrados = [];
var _cuPagina = 0;
var _cuPorPagina = 100;

function _cuBuildCache() {
  var result = {};
  var tasks = D.tasks || {};

  // Mapas por código (fuente original — flags simples)
  var frzMap  = {};
  ((D.freezer||{}).clients||[]).forEach(function(c){ frzMap[c.cod]=c; });
  var platMap = {};
  ((D.plataforma||{}).clients||[]).forEach(function(c){ platMap[c.cod]=c; });
  var bndMap  = {};
  ((D.bandeja||{}).clients||[]).forEach(function(c){
    bndMap[c.cod]=c;
    bndMap[String(c.cod).padStart(10,'0')]=c;
  });
  var impMap = {};
  ((D.clientes_importantes||{}).clients||[]).forEach(function(c){ impMap[c.cod]=c; });

  // Mapa de concesiones (ConcesionPro) — fuente rica con materiales y plataforma detallada
  var conMap = window._CONMAP || {};

  Object.keys(tasks).forEach(function(vend) {
    var vnom = ((D.vend_names||{})[vend]||vend).replace(/^\d+\s*-\s*/,'').split(' ')[0];
    Object.values(tasks[vend]).forEach(function(lista) {
      lista.forEach(function(c) {
        if (result[c.cod]) return;
        var codKey = String(parseInt(c.cod));
        var con = conMap[codKey] || null;

        // Materiales desde ConcesionPro, agrupados por tipo
        var mats = con ? (con.mats||[]) : [];
        var matsByTipo = {};
        mats.forEach(function(m){
          if (m.tipo === 'otro') return;
          if (!matsByTipo[m.tipo]) matsByTipo[m.tipo] = m; // tomar el primero de cada tipo
        });

        result[c.cod] = {
          cod:      c.cod,
          nombre:   c.nombre||'',
          canal:    c.canal||'',
          vend:     vend,
          vend_nom: vnom,
          kg26:     c.kg26||0,
          kg25:     c.kg25||0,
          var_kg:   c.var_kg,
          no_compro:!!c.no_compro,
          sin_tokin:!!c.sin_tokin,
          saldo:    c.saldo||0,
          vencido:  c.vencido||0,
          score:    c.score||0,
          frz:  matsByTipo.freezer || frzMap[c.cod]  || null,
          plat: (con && con.plataforma) || platMap[c.cod] || null,
          bnd:  matsByTipo.bandeja || bndMap[c.cod]  || null,
          imp:  impMap[c.cod]  || null,
          exhib:  matsByTipo.exhibidora_saladix || null,
          ganch_m: matsByTipo.ganchera_masti || null,
          ganch_mo: matsByTipo.ganchera_mogul || null,
          con_loc: con ? con.loc : '',
        };
      });
    });
  });
  return Object.values(result);
}

function buildClientesUnif() {
  if (!_cuCache) _cuCache = _cuBuildCache();
  var userVend = window.rimUser && window.rimUser.cod_vend;

  // Poblar selects
  var sv = document.getElementById('cu-vend');
  if (sv && sv.options.length <= 1) {
    var vm = {};
    _cuCache.forEach(function(c){ vm[c.vend]=c.vend_nom; });
    Object.keys(vm).sort().forEach(function(v){
      var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=v; o.textContent=v+' — '+vm[v]; sv.appendChild(o);
    });
  }
  var sc = document.getElementById('cu-canal');
  if (sc && sc.options.length <= 1) {
    var cm = {};
    _cuCache.forEach(function(c){ if(c.canal) cm[c.canal]=1; });
    Object.keys(cm).sort().forEach(function(cn){
      var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=cn; o.textContent=cn; sc.appendChild(o);
    });
  }

  var busq   = ((document.getElementById('cu-buscar')||{}).value||'').toLowerCase();
  var vendF  = (document.getElementById('cu-vend')||{}).value||'';
  var canalF = (document.getElementById('cu-canal')||{}).value||'';
  var filtro = (document.getElementById('cu-filtro')||{}).value||'';
  var sort   = (document.getElementById('cu-sort')||{}).value||'nombre';

  _cuFiltrados = _cuCache.filter(function(c) {
    if (userVend && c.vend !== userVend) return false;
    if (busq   && !c.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(busq) && !c.cod.includes(busq)) return false;
    if (vendF  && c.vend  !== vendF)  return false;
    if (canalF && c.canal !== canalF) return false;
    if (filtro==='bandeja'    && !c.bnd)          return false;
    if (filtro==='freezer'    && !c.frz)          return false;
    if (filtro==='plataforma' && !c.plat)         return false;
    if (filtro==='tokin'      && c.sin_tokin)     return false;
    if (filtro==='sin_tokin'  && !c.sin_tokin)   return false;
    if (filtro==='sin_compra' && !c.no_compro)   return false;
    if (filtro==='vencido'    && !(c.vencido>0)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  _cuFiltrados.sort(function(a,b){
    if (sort==='kg26')    return b.kg26-a.kg26;
    if (sort==='saldo')   return b.saldo-a.saldo;
    if (sort==='vencido') return b.vencido-a.vencido;
    if (sort==='score')   return b.score-a.score;
    return a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre,'es');
  });

  _cuPagina = 0;
  _cuRenderPagina();
}

function _cuRenderPagina() {
  var cfg    = D.config || {};
  var total  = _cuFiltrados.length;
  var ini    = _cuPagina * _cuPorPagina;
  var fin    = Math.min(ini + _cuPorPagina, total);
  var pagina = _cuFiltrados.slice(ini, fin);
  var factor = (cfg.dias_lab||22) / Math.max(cfg.dias_trab||1, 1);

  var cnt = document.getElementById('cu-count');
  if (cnt) cnt.textContent = total+' clientes · pág '+(_cuPagina+1)+'/'+Math.ceil(total/_cuPorPagina);

  var fmtKG = function(n){ return n>0 ? (+(+n).toFixed(1)).toLocaleString('es-AR') : '—'; };
  var fmt   = function(n){ return n>=1e6?(n/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M':n>=1e3?(n/1e3).toFixed(0)+'k':Math.round(n).toString(); };

  var rows = pagina.map(function(c) {
    var varCl = c.var_kg==null?'muted':c.var_kg>=0?'good':'bad';
    var proy  = +(c.kg26 * factor).toFixed(1);
    var vP    = c.kg25>0 ? ((proy-c.kg25)/c.kg25*100) : null;
    var pCl   = vP==null?'muted':vP>=0?'good':'bad';

    // ── Divisiones: solo si es de plataforma (único dato por cliente disponible)
    var divCards = '';
    if (c.plat && c.plat.divisiones && c.plat.divisiones.length) {
      divCards = c.plat.divisiones.map(function(d){
        var dproy = +(d.abr26 * factor).toFixed(1);
        var dvarp = d.abr25>0 ? +((dproy-d.abr25)/d.abr25*100).toFixed(1) : null;
        var dvarCl = d.var_pct==null?'muted':d.var_pct>=0?'good':'bad';
        var dpCl   = dvarp==null?'muted':dvarp>=0?'good':'bad';
        var dbw    = d.abr25>0 ? Math.min(100,(d.abr26/d.abr25)*100) : (d.abr26>0?100:0);
        var dbcl   = d.var_pct==null?'pbar-warn':d.var_pct>=-5?'pbar-good':d.var_pct>=-25?'pbar-warn':'pbar-bad';
        var gapTxt = d.gap_kg>0
          ? '<span class="bad" style="font-size:9px">faltan '+d.gap_kg.toFixed(0)+' KG</span>'
          : '<span class="good" style="font-size:9px">✓ supera AA</span>';
        return '<div class="xv-div-card">'
          +'<div class="xv-div-name">'+d.div+'</div>'
          +'<div class="xv-div-row">'
            +'<div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">MES AA</div>'
              +'<b style="font-size:10px">'+d.abr25.toFixed(1)+'</b><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">KG</div></div>'
            +'<div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">ACTUAL</div>'
              +'<b style="font-size:11px;color:var(--arc-blue)">'+d.abr26.toFixed(1)+'</b>'
              +'<div style="font-size:9px"><span class="'+dvarCl+'">'+(d.var_pct!=null?(d.var_pct>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(d.var_pct).toFixed(0)+'%':'—')+'</span></div></div>'
            +'<div style="text-align:center"><div class="muted" style="font-size:8px">PROY.'+cfg.dias_lab+'d</div>'
              +'<b style="font-size:11px;color:'+(dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)')+'">'+dproy.toFixed(1)+'</b>'
              +'<div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:'+(dpCl==='good'?'var(--pos)':dpCl==='bad'?'var(--neg)':'var(--warn)')+'">'+( dvarp!=null?(dvarp>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(dvarp).toFixed(0)+'%':'—')+'</div></div>'
          +'</div>'
          +'<div class="pbar-wrap" style="margin:4px 0"><div class="pbar-fill '+dbcl+'" style="width:'+dbw+'%"></div></div>'
          +'<div style="text-align:center">'+gapTxt+'</div>'
          +'</div>';
      }).join('');
    }

    // ── Badges en columna Estado
    var fmtM2 = function(n){ return n>=1e6?(n/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M':n>=1e3?(n/1e3).toFixed(0)+'k':Math.round(n).toString(); };
    var badges = '';
    if (c.frz)  badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#e0f9ff;color:#0369a1;display:block">❄️ Frz: '+(c.frz.v26!=null?'$'+fmtM2(c.frz.v26):fmtKG(c.frz.kg26)+' kg')+'</span>';
    if (c.bnd)  badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#f0fdf4;color:#166534;display:block">🪧 '+(c.bnd.desc||'Bandeja')+(c.bnd.v26!=null?': $'+fmtM2(c.bnd.v26):'')+'</span>';
    if (c.plat) badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#fef9c3;color:#854d0e;display:block">🏷️ '+(c.plat.material||c.plat.tipo||'Plataforma')+'</span>';
    if (c.exhib) badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#ede9fe;color:#5b21b6;display:block">🗄️ Exhib. Saladix</span>';
    if (c.ganch_m) badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#fff7ed;color:#9a3412;display:block">🪝 Ganchera Masti</span>';
    if (c.ganch_mo) badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#fff7ed;color:#9a3412;display:block">🪝 Ganchera Mogul</span>';
    if (c.imp)  badges += '<span class="st" style="background:#fce7f3;color:#9d174d;display:block">⭐ Imp</span>';
    if (c.no_compro) badges += '<span class="st st-no" style="display:block">✗ Sin compra</span>';

    // ── Fila + detalle expandible
    return '<tr class="exp-row" onclick="toggleExp(\'xcu-'+c.cod+'\')">'
      +'<td class="tl"><span class="vbadge">'+c.vend+'</span> '+c.vend_nom+'</td>'
      +'<td class="tl" style="white-space:nowrap">'
        +'<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-family:monospace">'+c.cod.replace(/^0+/,'')+'</div>'
        +c.nombre
      +'</td>'
      +'<td class="tc" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)">'+c.canal+'</td>'
      +'<td class="tr">'+fmtKG(c.kg25)+'</td>'
      +'<td class="tr"><b>'+fmtKG(c.kg26)+'</b></td>'
      +'<td class="tc"><span class="'+varCl+'">'+(c.var_kg!=null?(c.var_kg>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(c.var_kg).toFixed(1)+'%':'—')+'</span></td>'
      +'<td class="tr"><span class="'+pCl+'">'+proy.toFixed(1)+'</span></td>'
      +'<td class="tc"><span class="'+(c.sin_tokin?'st st-no':'st st-si')+'">'+(c.sin_tokin?'Sin Tokin':'✓ Tokin')+'</span></td>'
      +'<td class="tl">'+badges+'</td>'
    +'</tr>'
    // ── Detalle expandible
    +'<tr class="exp-detail" id="xcu-'+c.cod+'"><td colspan="9"><div class="exp-inner">'
      // KG total del mes
      +'<div class="xv-section">'
        +'<span class="xv-label">📊 KG Mes en curso</span>'
        +'<span>Mes AA: <b>'+fmtKG(c.kg25)+'</b></span>'
        +'<span>Actual: <b class="'+varCl+'">'+fmtKG(c.kg26)+'</b></span>'
        +'<span>Proy '+cfg.dias_lab+'d: <b class="'+pCl+'">'+proy.toFixed(1)+' KG</b></span>'
        +(c.saldo>0?'<span class="muted">Saldo: <b>$'+fmt(c.saldo)+'</b></span>':'')
        +(c.vencido>0?'<span class="bad">Venc+4d: <b>$'+fmt(c.vencido)+'</b></span>':'')
      +'</div>'
      // Bandeja — soporta datos ricos ConcesionPro (v25/v26/var/obj/choc/gol) o flags simples (kg25/kg26)
      +(c.bnd?'<div class="xv-section"><span class="xv-label">🪧 '+(c.bnd.desc||'Bandeja')+'</span>'
        +(c.bnd.v25!=null
          ? '<span>Mes AA: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.bnd.v25)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Actual: <b class="'+(c.bnd.var>=0?'good':'bad')+'">$'+fmtM2(c.bnd.v26)+'</b></span>'
            +(c.bnd.var!=null?'<span>Var: <b class="'+(c.bnd.var>=0?'good':'bad')+'">'+(c.bnd.var>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(c.bnd.var)+'%</b></span>':'')
            +(c.bnd.obj!=null?'<span class="muted">Obj: <b>'+c.bnd.obj+'</b></span>':'')
            +(c.bnd.gol26!=null?'<span class="muted">Gol: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.bnd.gol26)+'</b></span>':'')
            +(c.bnd.choc26!=null?'<span class="muted">Choc: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.bnd.choc26)+'</b></span>':'')
          : '<span>Mes AA: <b>'+fmtKG(c.bnd.kg25)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Actual: <b>'+fmtKG(c.bnd.kg26)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Proy: <b>'+(+(c.bnd.kg26*factor).toFixed(1)).toLocaleString('es-AR')+' KG</b></span>'
            +(c.bnd.estado?'<span class="muted">Estado: <b>'+c.bnd.estado+'</b></span>':''))
      +'</div>':'')
      // Freezer — mismo soporte dual
      +(c.frz?'<div class="xv-section"><span class="xv-label">❄️ Freezer</span>'
        +(c.frz.v25!=null
          ? '<span>Mes AA: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.frz.v25)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Actual: <b class="'+(c.frz.var>=0?'good':'bad')+'">$'+fmtM2(c.frz.v26)+'</b></span>'
            +(c.frz.var!=null?'<span>Var: <b class="'+(c.frz.var>=0?'good':'bad')+'">'+(c.frz.var>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(c.frz.var)+'%</b></span>':'')
            +(c.frz.obj!=null?'<span class="muted">Obj: <b>'+c.frz.obj+'</b></span>':'')
          : '<span>Mes AA: <b>'+fmtKG(c.frz.kg25)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Actual: <b>'+fmtKG(c.frz.kg26)+'</b></span>'
            +'<span>Proy: <b>'+(+(c.frz.kg26*factor).toFixed(1)).toLocaleString('es-AR')+' KG</b></span>')
      +'</div>':'')
      // Exhibidor Saladix
      +(c.exhib?'<div class="xv-section"><span class="xv-label">🗄️ Exhibidor Saladix</span>'
        +(c.exhib.v25!=null?'<span>Mes AA: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.exhib.v25)+'</b></span><span>Actual: <b>$'+fmtM2(c.exhib.v26)+'</b></span>':'')
        +(c.exhib.var!=null?'<span>Var: <b class="'+(c.exhib.var>=0?'good':'bad')+'">'+(c.exhib.var>=0?'▲':'▼')+Math.abs(c.exhib.var)+'%</b></span>':'')
      +'</div>':'')
      // Gancheras
      +((c.ganch_m||c.ganch_mo)?'<div class="xv-section"><span class="xv-label">🪝 Gancheras</span>'
        +(c.ganch_m?'<span>Masti: <b>'+(c.ganch_m.v26!=null?'$'+fmtM2(c.ganch_m.v26):'sí')+'</b></span>':'')
        +(c.ganch_mo?'<span>Mogul: <b>'+(c.ganch_mo.v26!=null?'$'+fmtM2(c.ganch_mo.v26):'sí')+'</b></span>':'')
      +'</div>':'')
      // Divisiones solo para clientes de plataforma
      +(divCards?'<div class="xv-divs"><div class="xv-divs-title">📦 KG por División vs mes anterior · proy. a '+cfg.dias_lab+' días</div>'
        +'<div class="xv-divs-grid">'+divCards+'</div></div>':'')
    +'</div></td></tr>';
  }).join('');

  // Paginador
  var totalPags = Math.ceil(total/_cuPorPagina);
  var pager = '';
  if (totalPags > 1) {
    pager = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="padding:10px;text-align:center;background:#f8faff">';
    if (_cuPagina>0) pager += '<button onclick="_cuPagina--;_cuRenderPagina()" style="margin:0 4px;padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff">← Anterior</button>';
    pager += '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;margin:0 10px">Página '+(_cuPagina+1)+' de '+totalPags+' ('+total+' clientes)</span>';
    if (_cuPagina<totalPags-1) pager += '<button onclick="_cuPagina++;_cuRenderPagina()" style="margin:0 4px;padding:5px 14px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff">Siguiente →</button>';
    pager += '</td></tr>';
  }

  if (!rows) rows = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:#999">Sin resultados</td></tr>';

  var wrap = document.getElementById('cu-wrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec">'
    +'<div class="sec-hdr">👥 Clientes — '+total+' registros <small>Click en fila para ver detalle y divisiones</small></div>'
    +'<div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl">'
    +'<thead><tr>'
    +'<th class="tl">Vendedor</th>'
    +'<th class="tl">Cód. / Cliente</th>'
    +'<th>Canal</th>'
    +'<th>KG mes AA</th>'
    +'<th>KG actual</th>'
    +'<th>Var</th>'
    +'<th>Proy.</th>'
    +'<th>Tokin</th>'
    +'<th class="tl">Frz / Bnd / Plat</th>'
    +'</tr></thead>'
    +'<tbody>'+rows+pager+'</tbody>'
    +'</table></div></div>';
}


</script>
